Junjun k'inhib'alil yet' junjun yemk'uhalil syik'anb'at swa'el winh nok' joj chi' yet' schib'ej, haxo jun ha ha' chi' syuk' winh.
Palta ix k'och stiempo'al ix tup ha ha' chi' yujto maxtzak yak'laj nhab'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi':
--Elanh t'a tik, ixikkan t'a chonhab' Sarepta t'a yol yik Sidón, tzach kan ta' junok tiempo'al. Toxo ix wal t'a jun ix ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum to ha ix ol ak'an ha wa'el, xchi t'a winh.

Ix el winhaj Elías chi', ix b'atkan winh t'a Sarepta chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a sti' chonhab', ix yilanb'at jun ix ix winh, chamnakxo yetb'eyum ix, wan smolan chab' te' b'olob' ix. Ix yawtankot ix winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Mamax el t'a ha k'o'ol, b'at ik' junok waso ha' wuk'ej, xchi winh.
Wanxo sb'at ix yik'kot ha', ix awajxi winh t'a ix: --Tzin tewipax t'ayach to tzik'kot jab'ok pan hin wa'a, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi ix: --Wal t'a yichanh Jehová ha Diosal swala', malaj jab'ok ixim pan b'ob'il wu'uj, haxonhej wal jun b'ech jab' warina ya'ab'ilkan wu'uj t'a yol jun xalu yet' jab' waceite ay t'a yol yet'tal. Anhej ol hin k'ochxok yet' chab' hin b'olob' tik, ol hin wach' b'o'an jab' warina chi' hin wa yet' tzun wune' tik, ol lajwok chi', ol ko tanhwan cham ko b'a yuj wejel, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix icha tik: --Manh hach xiwok. Ixik, b'at b'o ixim icha ix aj halan chi', palta to tza b'ab'laj b'o'ej junok wik t'a jab' harina chi', tzik'ankot t'ayin, slajwi chi' ol ha b'o'an ik ol ha wa yet' winh unin chi'.

Yujto toxo ix yal Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik to manh ol lajwok jab' harina ayem t'a yol ha xalu chi' yet' jab' aceite ayem t'a yol yet'tal chi', masanto yik ol yak'anxikot nhab' Jehová, xchi winh t'a ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at ix sb'o icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Jantaknhej tiempo ix yak' jun wejel chi', ix wa winh yet' ix yet' pax heb' ayek' yet' ix t'a spat chi'.
Maj lajwi'el-laj jab' yarina ix chi' yet' jab' yaceite chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Elías chi' yuj Jehová.
Ix ek' jun pekti', ix ilya'an jun yune' ix chi'. Te ow ix aj jun syahelal chi', ix chami.
Ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Hach schekab' Dios, ¿tas halan ik t'ayin? ¿Tom yuj snachajkot hin mul yet' scham tzun wune' tik, yuj chi' hach jawi? xchi ix.
--Ik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Elías chi' t'a ix. Ix scha'anek' winh unin chi' winh t'a ix, ix yik'ank'e winh t'a yol scuarto, ix yak'anek' jichan winh t'a sat sch'at.
Wal chi' ix yalan winh t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin Jehová hin Diosal, ¿tas yuj tzak'kot kusk'olal t'a yib'anh ix ix tz'ak'an hin posado tik, tza cha'an cham winh yune' ix tik? xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', oxel ix b'at lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix yalan winh t'a Jehová: Mamin Jehová hin Diosal, tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak'xi sk'inal winh unin tik, xchi winh.
Ix yab'an Jehová tas ix yal winh chi', ix jax sk'o'ol winh unin chi'.
Elanhchamel ix yik'emta winh unin chi' winh b'aj aykan ix snun chi', ix yak'anxi winh t'a ix, ix yalan winh: --Ilnab'i, toxo ix jax sk'o'ol winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik swak'och t'a hin k'o'ol to yel schekab' hach ton Jehová Dios, ha tas schek ala', tz'elnhejk'ochi, xchi ix.
Ix ek'b'at oxe' ab'il, ix lolonxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: B'at ch'ox ha b'a t'a winhaj Acab yujto ol wak'xib'at k 'inal nhab', xchi t'a winh.
Ix b'at winh sch'ox sb'a t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Ha t'a Samaria te ow yak'an wejel.

Ha winhaj Acab chi' ix awtan winhaj Abdías, winh ayoch yilumalok spalacio winh. Ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Konh, b'at ko say kila', tope ay b'aj ay ha ha' t'a yol ko makb'en tik, b'aj sko say jab'ok yanh nok' ko chej, yik manh ol cham nok' yuj wejel, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix spoj sb'a heb' winh, ch'okch'ok b'aj ix b'atkan junjun heb' winh. Ha winhaj Abdías chi', aynhej xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Ha t'a yalanhtaxo, ayik ix schekan ix Jezabel yetb'eyum winhaj Acab chi' to smiljicham heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ha winhaj Abdías chi' ix k'ub'anel 100 heb' winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Chab' makan ix aj heb' winh yuj winh, 50 tak ix aj heb' winh. Ix b'at winh sk'ub'ejel heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'e'en nhak'e'en, haxo winh sb'at ak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas syuk'ej heb' winh t'a jun pekti' chi'.

Ayik wan yek' winhaj Abdías sayoj yanh chej chi', ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' winhaj Elías chi'. Ayik ix yilanoch winhaj Elías chi' winh, ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin, ¿tok ha hach tik Elías hach? xchi winh.
--I' ha hin toni. Ixik al t'a winhaj Acab to ayinek' t'a tik, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Abdías chi': --¿Tas hin mul yuj chi' tzin ak'och t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Acab yik tzin smilancham winh?

T'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal swal t'ayach to malaj junok nación b'aj maj hach sayji'ek' yuj winh rey chi'. Ayik ix yalan heb' winh rey chi' to malaj hach ayach ek' t'a yol smakb'en heb' winh, ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' to syak' sti' heb' winh tato yel malaj hach ayach ek' ta'.
Haxo tikne'ik tzalan t'ayin to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayach ek' t'a tik.

Axom ol ajok, anhej yik tzin el t'a ha tz'ey tik, haxo Yespíritu Dios ol hach ik'anb'atok. Ma chekel b'ajtom ol hach k'ochok, haxo yik ol hin k'och wal t'a winhaj Acab chi', ol kot winh hach saya'. Tato manhxo hach ayok ek' t'a tik, axom hin smilancham winh chi' hu'uj. Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, yiktax kelem hinto aynhej hin xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.

¿Tom manta mach tz'alan t'ayach tas ix aj hin kolan heb' winh schekab' Jehová t'a ix Jezabel ayik wan smiljicham heb' winh yuj ix? Ix hin k'ub'ejel 100 heb' winh t'a yol chab' k'e'en nhak'e'en, 50 tak ix wutej hin k'ub'anel heb' winh, ix wak'an tas swa heb' winh yet' tas ix yuk'ej heb' winh.
Haxo tikne'ik tzalani to sb'at wal t'a winh rey chi' to ayachek' t'a tik, axom hin smilancham winh chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': --Wal t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swal t'ayach, jun swak' serwil to ha t'a jun k'u tik yowalil tzin lolon yet' winhaj Acab chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Abdías chi' yal t'a winhaj rey Acab chi'. Haxo yik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Acab chi', ix kot winh scha winhaj Elías chi'.
Haxo yik ix ilchaj winhaj Elías chi' yuj winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tom ha hach wan ixtan chonhab' Israel tik? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: Manhok hin laj wan wixtan jun chonhab' tik, palta ha hach yet' masanil heb' ha k'ab' ok, yujto ix heyaktejkan scheknab'il Jehová. Haxo t'a komon Dios Baal tzex och ejmelal.

Ha tikne'ik, chekb'at yik'umal heb' ketisraelal yet' 450 heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' pax 400 heb' winh schekab' ix Dios Asera, haton heb' winh tz'ak'ji wa yuj ix Jezabel. Ol hin chalaj hin b'a yet' heb' winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Yuj chi' ix schekan winhaj Acab chi' molb'aj masanil heb' winh schekab' komon Dios Baal t'a yol smakb'en Israel t'a jolom witz Carmelo.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a skal heb' anima chi' smasanil, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --¿B'ak'inh wal ol heyaktejkan somsoman he pensar? Tato ha Jehová to yel Dios toni, anhejokab' t'ay tzex och ejmelal. Tato ha Baal chi' Dios pax jun, anhejokab' t'ay tzeyak'em he b'a, xchi winh. Haxo heb' anima chi' maj tak'woklaj heb'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ha hinxonhej pitzan hin, haxo pax heb' winh yik Baal, ay 450 heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ik'ekkot chawanhok nok' mam wakax, sik'lan heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' junok nok' yiko', skotak xikanb'at nok' heb' winh, syak'ank'e nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, palta max yak'ochlaj sk'ak'al te' k'atzitz chi' heb' winh. Ha hinxo ol hin b'opax junxo nok' chi', ol wak'anpaxk'e nok' t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz, hanheja' malaj sk'ak'al ol wak'ochi.

Slajwi chi', ol awaj heb' winh t'a sdiosal chi', hanheja' hin pax tik ol hin awaj t'a Jehová hin Diosal. Ha junok Dios ol ak'ankot k'ak' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi', haton jun chi' Dios t'a yel, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Te wach' ton ix aj ha na'an chi', xchi heb' anima chi' smasanil.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' winh schekab' Baal chi' icha tik: --Sik'ekel junok nok' mam wakax tik tze b'o'an nok', ha hex ol he b'ab'laj b'o'ej heyik chi' yujto tzijtum hex, palta manh heyak'ochlaj sk'ak'al. Slajwi chi' tzex awaj t'a he diosal chi', xchi winh.

Ix smilancham nok' yik heb' winh chi', ix sb'o'an nok' heb' winh. Ix syamanoch heb' winh yawaj t'a sdiosal chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, hanheja' yawaj heb' winh masanto ix och chimk'uhalil, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Tak'wanh t'ayonh Baal, xchi heb' winh. Sk'e chennaj heb' winh, tz'ek' oyoyok heb' winh t'a spatik altar b'aj ayk'e silab' ix sb'o chi', malaj mach stak'wi t'a heb' winh.

Haxo yik ix och chimk'uhalil, ix syamanoch winhaj Elías chi' sb'uchwaj t'a heb' winh: --Más cha'anh tzex awaji, yujto Dios jun, tekan ay tas wan sk'ulani, mato ayb'at chuljel, ma ay b'aj ayb'at schek sb'a, mato jun, waynak, pitzekel swayanh, xchi winh.
Ix ochxi ijan heb' winh yawaj cha'anh, ix laj spolan sb'a heb' winh t'a k'e'en kuchilub' yet' t'a k'e'en kotak lanza, ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb' winh, chik'takxonhej ix aj heb' winh.

Ix ek' chimk'uhalil, hanheja' yel yaw heb' winh, sk'e chennaj heb' winh masanto ayik wan sk'och yora'il tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová t'a yemk'uhalil. Palta malaj mach ix ab'an tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb' anima chi': --Kotanhek t'a hin tz'ey tik, xchi winh. Ix snitzanb'at sb'a masanil heb' anima chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix syamanoch winh sb'o'anxik'e jun altar yik Jehová jub'ileli.
Ix yik'ankot lajchawe' k'e'en k'e'en winh, yujto icha chi' sb'isul heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jacob, haton winh yalnak Jehová t'ay to Israel sb'i'ejkani.
Ix sb'o'an jun altar chi' winh t'a Jehová t'a k'e'en k'e'en chi', ix sjoyan jun sanja winh t'a spatiktak jun altar chi', chanhe' am galón ha' tz'em t'a yo'ol.
Ix sb'o'ank'e te' k'atzitz winh t'a yib'anh altar chi', ix skotak xikanb'at nok' wakax chi' winh, ix yak'ank'e nok' winh t'a yib'anh te' k'atzitz chi'.

Ix yalan winh: --B'ut'ek chanhe'ok ch'ub' t'a ha ha', tze tob'anb'at ha' t'a yib'anh nok' silab' chi' yet' t'a yib'anh te' sk'atzitzal chi', xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' to syik'kot ha' heb' t'a scha'elal. Ix yik'anxikot ha' heb'. Ix yalanxi winh to syik'xikot ha' heb' t'a yoxelal, ix sb'o'an heb' icha tas ix yal winh chi'.
Ix el yok ha' t'a spatiktak altar chi', masanto ix b'ut'jikan jun sanja chi'.

Ayik ix k'och yora'il ichataxon yik tz'ak'ji silab' t'a yemk'uhalil, ix snitzanoch sb'a winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey altar chi', ix yalan winh: Mamin Jehová sDiosal hach winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ha tikne'ik ojtakajokab'eli to ha hach ton ko Diosal hach ha honh israel honh tik, ha hinxo tik to ha chekab' hin, ha hach ix ha chek hin k'ulej juntzanh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin, yik wach' ol yojtakejel juntzanh anima tik to ha hachnhej ton Dios hach, tzik'anxi meltzaj spensar heb' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix kot kopnaj k'ak' t'a satcha'anh yuj Jehová, ix tz'ab'at nok' silab' chi' yet' te' k'atzitz chi' yet' k'e'en k'e'en yet' lum pokok, ix tupb'atpax ha ha' t'a yol sanja chi'.
Ayik ix yilan heb' anima tas ix uji chi', ix sjulanek' telnaj sb'a heb' t'a sat lu'um, ix laj awaj cha'anh heb': Anhej Jehová yel Dios toni, xchixonhej heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a heb': --Yamec heb' winh schekab' Baal tik. Malajokab' junok heb' winh tz'eli, xchi winh. Ix yamji heb' winh yuj heb' anima chi', ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cisón. Hata' ix miljicham heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Acab icha tik: --Ixik, b'at wa'anh, tzuk'an ha', yujto wan sk'anh sjawi jun niwan yaxnhab' swab'i, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Acab chi', ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Haxo winhaj Elías chi', ix k'ex winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo chi', ix em kuman winh ta' lesal, ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a skal sjolom spenek.

Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: --K'e'anh t'a jolom witz chi', tzach b'at k'elan t'a yib'anh ha' mar, xchi winh. Ix k'ek'och winh schekab' winh chi', ix yilanb'at winh t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh: --Malaj jab'ok tas ix wila', xchi winh. Ukel ix chekjib'at winh yil yuj winhaj Elías chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi xit'ek' winh t'a yukelal chi', ix yalan winh: --Ay wal tzin jab' asun t'a yib'anh ha' mar chi', smuslaj yuj junok ko k'ab', xchi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Elías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ixik al t'a winhaj Acab to syak' lista nok' schej winh stok'an carruaje yik spax winh, tato ma'ay, majxo ta yal sk'och winh t'a spat yuj nhab', xchi winh.
Ix k'e winhaj Acab chi' t'a yol scarruaje yik sb'at t'a Jezreel. Wanto wal sb'at winh ix k'ik'b'i'el satcha'anh yuj asun, ix kot ik' te ow, ix kot jun niwan yaxnhab'.

Haxo Jehová ix och yet' winhaj Elías chi', elanhchamel ix stok'cha'anh sjukan pichul winh, ix sch'apank'e winh t'a stzek'ul snanhal, ix b'at lemnaj winh. B'ab'el sb'at winh yuj winhaj Acab chi' masanto ix k'och winh t'a Jezreel.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a ix Jezabel tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Elías yet' tas ix yutej winh smilancham heb' winh schekab' Baal.

Yuj chi', ix schekanb'at jun schekab' ix t'a winhaj Elías chi', ix yalanb'at ix icha tik: A'okab' heb' Dios tz'ak'ankot yahelal t'a wib'anh tato manto hach cham wu'uj yab' icha tik k'ik'an, icha ix utej ha milancham heb' winh schekab' hin diosal chi', xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Elías to ay smay jun chi', ix b'at winh elelal. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a Beerseba t'a yol yik Judá, hata' ix yaktejkan jun winh schekab' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a tzinan lu'um. Jun k'uhal ix b'ey winh. Ix k'unb'i winh, ix em k'ojan winh t'a yich jun te' mes. Hata' ix snib'ej cham sb'a winh. Ix yalan winh: k'okb'ilxo tik Mamin. Ik'el hin k 'inal, manh ek'b'aloklaj welk'och t'a heb' hin mam wicham, xchi winh.
Ix ek' jichan winh t'a yich jun te te' chi', ix wayb'at winh. Haxo yik waynak winh chi', ix k'och jun ángel t'a winh, ix tenji winh yuj, ix yalani: K'e'anh wa'an, wa'anh, xchi t'a winh.
Haxo ix yilan winh t'a sjolomtak, ayek' jun ixim pan k'anb'inak t'a te' tzak'ak' yet' jun xalu ha ha'. Ix k'e k'ojan winh, ix wa winh, ix yuk'an ha' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ek'xi jichan winh swayi.
Ix k'ochxi jun ángel chi' t'a winh, ix tenjixi winh yuj, ix yalani: K'e'anh wa'an, wa'anh, yujto te najatto skan b'aj ol hach k'ochok, xchi t'a winh.
Ix k'e wa'an winh, ix wa winh, ix te och yip winh yuj tas ix swa chi'. 40 k'u yet' 40 ak'wal ix b'ey winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a lum witz Horeb b'aj sch'oxnak sb'a Jehová t'a heb' israel.
Ayik ix k'och winh ta', ix way winh t'a yol jun k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a jun ak'wal chi'. Ix lolon Jehová t'a winh, ix yalan icha tik: Elías, ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh t'ay icha tik: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas tzach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal. Yujto ix spatikejel ha trato heb', ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' ha chekab' heb'. Ha hinxonhej ix hin kolchajkaneli, palta wan hin sayji'ek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh: Elanh t'a chi' tzach och linhan t'a wichanh t'a jolom witz tik, yujto ol hin ek' ta', xchi t'a winh. Ix yak'ankot jun niwan ik' Jehová chi', ix laj pojb'at k'e'en tenam yuj, palta manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun ik' chi'. Ixlajwi yek' jun ik' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun kixkab'. Palta hanheja' manh ayokochlaj t'a skal jun kixkab' chi'.

Ixlajwi yek' jun kixkab' chi', ix yak'anpaxkot jun k'ak', hanheja' malaj Jehová chi' ayoch t'a skal jun k'ak' chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yek'b'at jun k'ak' chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel winhaj Elías chi', te k'ununi ix aj yalani.

Ayik ix yab'an winh chi', ix smusan sat winh yet' jun spichul jukan, ix elta winh, ix aj linhan winh t'a sti' k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' winh, ix yalani: Elías ¿tas tza k'ulej t'a tik? xchi.

Ix tak'wi winh: Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ix te kot wowal yuj tas ix hach utaj yuj heb' wetisraelal, yujto ix spatikejel ha trato heb'. Ix sjuanem altar heb', ix xikancham heb' ha chekab' heb'. Ha hinxonhej ix hin kolchajkaneli, palta wan hin sayji'ek' yuj heb' yik tzin smilancham heb', xchi winh.

Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ixik, meltzajanh t'a b'e b'aj hach koti, slajwi chi' tzach b'at t'a tzinan lum yik Damasco. Ayik ol hach k'och ta', tza sik'kanel winhaj Hazael yik ol och winh reyal t'a Siria.

Haxo winhaj Jehú yinhtilal winhaj Nimsi tza sik'paxkaneli yik ol och winh sreyalok Israel. Haxo winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat aj Abel-mehola, tza sik'kanel winh yik ol och winh hin chekab'ok ha k'exulok.

Ha tas ol ujok, ha mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael, haxo winhaj Jehú ol milanchamok. Haxo mach ol kolchajkanel t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jehú chi', haxo pax winhaj Eliseo ol milanchamok.
Palta ayto uke' mil heb' israel chi' sik'b'ilkanel wu'uj, maj ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, maj stz'ub'pax eltalaj heb', xchi Jehová chi'.

Ix meltzaj winhaj Elías chi' t'a jun lugar chi', ix ja winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Wan st'okwi lum winh yet' lajchawe' mojanh nok' mam wakax. Ha winh et'jinak nok' tzak'anto sb'ati. Ix k'och winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winh, ix yak'anb'at jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' t'a yib'anh winh.

T'a jun rato chi' ix yaktankan nok' wakax winhaj Eliseo chi', ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --Cha hin b'ati, b'at walkan kilkob'a t'a hin mam hin nun, tzin tz'ub'ankanelta sti' heb' yik tzin pukankan hin b'a yet' heb'. Slajwi chi', tzin och tzak'an hu'uj, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Syal ha b'ati, manh wanok hach wak'an pural, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi', ix smilan chawanh nok' wakax chi' winh. Haxo yet' te' yugo ayoch t'a nok' ix sb'ol schib'ejal nok' winh, ix yak'an wa heb' anima smunlaj yet' winh chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix och tzak'an winh yuj winhaj Elías chi'.

Ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix smolb'ej masanil heb' soldado winh. Ay pax 32 heb' winh rey junnhej ix yutej sb'a yet' winh yet' pax schej heb' winh yet' scarruaje heb' winh yik owal. Ix jawi heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Samaria, ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a spatik jun chonhab' chi'.
Ix yak'ankot schekab' heb' winh t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha winhaj Ben-adad ix honh chekankot ul kala':
Wik yaj masanil ha b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum te wach' yet' heb' uninal te wach', xchikot winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh icha tik: Mamin rey, ujokab' icha ix al chi'. Ha hin tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ayin ikokab'i, xchib'at winh.

Ix jaxpax heb' chekab' chi' t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalanxi heb' icha tik: Icha tik ix yutej winhaj Ben-adad yalanxikoti: Toxo ix walb'at t'ayach to wik yaj masanil ha b'eyumal, heb' ix etb'eyum yet' pax heb' uninal.

Hanhejtona' yab' icha tik k'ik'an, swak'anb'at heb' yajalil heb' hin soldado yik sb'at yilan heb' masanil tas ay t'a yol ha palacio yet' yoltak spat heb' winh ayoch yajalil het'ok. Masanil tas ol snib'ej heb', ol yik'kot heb', xchi winh, xchi heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yawtankot masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb': --¿Tas tz'aj he na'an ha hex tik? Ha winhaj Ben-adad chi' wannhej sayan winh tas ol yutej honh yixtani, wach'chom ha hin tik toxo ix wal t'a winh to syal wak'an hin b'eyumal, heb' ix wetb'eyum yet' heb' wuninal t'a winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan heb' ichamtak winak chi' yet' masanil heb' chonhab': --Mamin rey, manh ha cha ab' tas syalkot winh chi' t'ayach, xchi heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi' t'a heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi': --Alek t'a winh rey wajal chi', ol hin k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix yal winh t'a sb'ab'elal, palta haxo tas syalkot winh t'ayin tikne'ik, manhxo ol hin k'anab'ajejlaj, xchib'at winh. Icha chi' ix aj yalanxik'och heb' schekab' winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Ix schekanxikot heb' schekab' winh chi' jun'elxo t'a winhaj rey Acab chi', ix yalankot winh: A'okab' juntzanh Dios tz'ak'anoch hin yahelal tato max hin satel Samaria chi' t'a jun'elnhej. Manh ol yab'laj sk'alemal yik syik'ankot jun jopok yik junjun heb' hin soldado, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxib'at winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: Manh smojok syik'cha'anh sb'a junok mach to wanto sb'at t'a owal, icha junok mach to wanxo sjaxi, xchib'at winh.

Wan yuk'an anh winhaj Ben-adad chi' yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayek' yet' winh t'a scampamento ayik ix yab'an winh tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado to syak' lista sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal yet' jun chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a heb'.

Yakb'an chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Scham wal ilan jantak heb' ajk'o'ol chi', palta ol wak'och heb' t'a yol ha k'ab' t'a jun k'u tik, yik wach' ol ojtakejeli to ha hinton Jehová Dios hin, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi', ¿mach yuj ol ak'jokoch heb' t'a yol hin k'ab' chi'? xchi winh. --Ha Jehová ix halani to ha yuj heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yoltak ha makb'en tik, ha yuj heb' winh ol ak' ganar, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. --¿Palta mach ol b'ab'laj yamanoch owal chi'? xchi winhaj Acab chi'. --Ha extoni, xchi winh chekab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej 232 heb' winh kelemtak chi' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix smolb'anpax heb' soldado winh ayek' ta', uke' mil heb' t'a smasanil.

Chimk'uhalil wal ix el heb', b'ab'el sb'at heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj heb', haxo winhaj Ben-adad yet' 32 heb' winh rey ajun yet'ok, hanheja' yuk'an anh heb' winh t'a yol scampamento. Ayik ix alji t'a winh yuj heb' soldado ayel yila' to ay juntzanh winak ix el t'a yol chonhab' Samaria,
ix yalan winh icha tik: Wach'chom t'a junk'olal ix elul heb', ma owal jun, yamek heb', pitzan heb' tzeyik'ankot heb' t'ayin t'a tik, xchi winh.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak skolwaj t'a heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yik Israel chi', b'ab'el heb' winh, tzak'anoch masanil heb' soldado yuj heb' winh.

Junjun heb' ix milancham junjun heb' sirio ajk'o'ol chi'. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' sirio chi' elelal, haxo heb' israel ix b'at t'a spatik heb'. Haxo winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'e winh t'a yib'anh schej yet' juntzanhxo heb' soldado, ix b'atkan heb' elelal.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' sirio chi' yuj heb' israel chi', ix yik'ankan nok' chej heb' yet' carruaje yik owal. Te niwan heb' sirio chi' ix chami.

Ixlajwi chi' ix jax winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik scham wal ha na'ani tas tzutej ak'anoch stz'akub' heb' winh ha soldado tik, yujto ha t'a junxo ab'il yab' icha tik, sjax heb' sirio tik yak' owal et' jun'elxo, xchi winh.

Hanheja' ix yalanpax heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado sirio chi' t'a winh sreyal chi' icha tik: --Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' israel chi', sdiosal jolomtak witz. Yuj chi', ix honh yak' ganar heb'. Palta tato ha t'a panhkiltak skak' owal yet' heb', skak' ganar heb'.
Mamin rey, ha tas tza k'ulej tikne'ik to maxtzak ak'och heb' winh rey tik yajalilok heb' soldado, say sk'exul heb' winh.

Tzak'anpaxoch heb' soldado icha sb'isul heb' ix ak'ji ganar chi', lajan tz'aj sb'isul heb' yet' nok' chej yet' pax carruaje. Slajwi chi' tzonh b'at kak' owal yet' heb' israel t'a lum panhkiltak chi', ol kilan b'i'an tato manh ol kak' ganar heb', xchi heb'. Ix scha'an yab' winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal heb' chi'.
Ayik ix ek' jun ab'il chi', ix yak'an lista heb' soldado winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix jawi heb' t'a chonhab' Afec yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel chi'.

Hanhejtona' ix yak'anpax lista sb'a heb' winh soldado israel chi', ix ak'ji syamk'ab' heb' yik sb'at heb' yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Ix b'at heb' israel chi', ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi'. Lajan wal yilji heb' icha chab'ok makte'al nok' chiwa, haxo pax heb' soldado yik heb' sirio chi' jun, majnakel sat lum ak'lik chi' yuj heb'.

Ha wal ta' ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Yujto ha heb' sirio tik ix halani to ha hin tik sDiosal hin lum jolomtak witz, manh hin sDiosalok lum panhkiltak, yuj chi' ha tikne'ik ol wak'och juntzanh tzijtumal anima tik t'a yol ha k'ab', icha wal chi' ol aj ojtakaneli to ha hin ton Jehová Dios hin, xchi Jehová, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Uke' k'uhal tonhej ix ajek' heb' soldado sirio t'a yichanh heb' soldado israel chi', ix lajwi chi' ix syamanoch heb' yak'an owal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' 100 mil soldado yik heb' sirio chi' sb'ey t'a yok ix cham yuj heb' israel chi'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' soldado chi', ix b'at heb' elelal t'a chonhab' Afec. Haxo smuro'al jun chonhab' chi' ix kot lanhnaj t'a yib'anh heb', 27 mil heb' soldado ix el chi' ix chami. Ix pax lemnaj winhaj Ben-adad chi', ix k'och winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', tzuli tz'ek' winh sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a yoltak pat.

Yuj chi' haxo heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh ix halan t'ay icha tik: --Ix kab'i to ha heb' winh sreyal Israel ay yok'elk'olal heb' winh, yuj chi' komonok scha ha k'o'ol skak'och pichul ya swa'i, skak'anoch lasu t'a ko jaj. Slajwi chi' b'at ko ch'oxan ko b'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', talaj tz'ok' sk'o'ol winh t'ayonh, manh ol honh smilchamlaj winh, xchi heb' t'a winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i, ix yak'anoch lasu heb' t'a sjaj, ix b'at heb' sch'ox sb'a t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan heb': --Mamin rey, ha winh ha chekab' aj Ben-adad, tzonh schekkot winh kal t'ayach, komonok tz'ok' ha k'o'ol max ha milchamlaj winh, xchi heb'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Tom pitzanto winh jun? Ha t'a hin sat, icha wuk'tak yaj winh, xchi winh.

Te wach' ix yal winh rey chi' ix yab' heb', yuj chi' ix yal heb' icha tik: --Mamin rey, ha winh uk'tak aj Ben-adad chi' pitzanto winh, xchi heb'. --B'at ik'ekkot winh an, xchi winhaj Acab chi' t'a heb'. Yuj chi' ix jawi winhaj Ben-adad chi' t'a yichanh winh, ix yak'ank'e winh winh t'a yol scarruaje.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Ben-adad chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ha juntzanh chonhab' yik'nak ek' winh hin mam t'a winh ha mam, swak'xikan t'ayach. Syal sb'at heb' ha chonhwajum t'a Damasco icha sk'ulejnak heb' schonhwajum winh hin mam chi' t'a Samaria, xchi winh. --Tato icha chi', ol hach wak'el t'a libre, xchi winhaj Acab chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'an jun strato heb' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix pax winhaj Ben-adad chi'.

Palta ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh schekab' Jehová, ha Jehová ix halan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a jun winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ak' hin echnaj hin k'ana', xchi winh. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh yetb'eyum winh chi'.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Yujto maj ha k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, yuj chi' ayik ol hach el t'a hin tz'ey tik, ay jun nok' choj ol hach milanchamok, xchi winh. Ayik ix el winh chi' t'a stz'ey winh schekab' Dios chi', haxo t'a yol b'e ix elta jun nok' choj t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj nok'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schalan sb'a winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' junxo winh winak, ix yalanxi winh t'a winh icha tik: Ak' hin echnajok, xchi winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix mak'an winh schekab' Dios chi', ix lajwi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh schekab' Dios chi' smaklej winh rey t'a yol b'e. Ix sk'exanel sb'a winh, ix smusan sat winh t'a jun k'apak.

Ayik wan yek'b'at winh rey chi' ta', te cha'anh ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi': --Mamin rey, ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, ix hin b'at t'a owal. Ha t'a skal heb' soldado ix elta jun winh soldado ix yik'ankot jun winh ajk'o'ol winh t'ayin. Ix yalan winh t'ayin to tzin tanhwej jun winh chi'. Ix cham wal yalan winh tato swaktejel winh ajk'o'ol chi', ha hinxo tzin cham sk'exulok winh, mato yowalil swak' oxe'ok arroba k'e'en plata.

Palta mamin rey, ha hin tik yakb'an ay jab'ok tas wan hin k'ulani, ix el lemnaj winh ajk'o'ol chi' t'ayin, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix tak'wi winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi': --Munil ha hach ix alk'eta ha mul yet' tas ol elul t'a ib'anh yuj, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anel smusil sat winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix yilan winh rey chi' to ha jun winh chi' ha junok heb' winh schekab' Dios.

Ix yalan winh schekab' Dios chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Ha hach tik ix aktejb'at jun winh winak ix wala' to yowalil schami, yuj chi' ha hach ol hach cham sk'exulok winh, haxo ha chonhab' ol satel sk'exulok yik winh, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'atkan winhaj Acab chi' t'a Samaria, ix chab'axk'e sk'o'ol winh. Wan schichon sk'o'ol winh ix ochkan winh t'a yol spalacio.

Ayik ix lajwi yek'kan juntzanh chi', ha winhaj Acab rey t'a Samaria, ix snib'ej winh sman jab' slu'um jun winh aj Jezreel skuch Nabot. Ha jab' slu'um winh chi' awab'il te' uwa t'a sat, ha t'a stz'ey spalacio winh rey chi' ay. Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Ak' jab' ha lum chi' t'ayin, yik hata' swawej jab'ok witaj, yujto t'a stz'ey hin palacio ay. Haxo junokxo lum te wach' swak' sk'exulok, mato tzin tup t'ayach icha stojol, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj, yujto max yal-laj sk'o'ol Dios to tzin chonhel hin makb'en ak'b'ilkan yuj hin mam wicham, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Acab chi' t'a spalacio. Ix te och pitz'an t'a sk'o'ol winh, ix somchajcha'anh winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Nabot chi'. Yuj chi' ayik ix k'och winh t'a spalacio chi', ix ek' jichan winh, ix meltzajkanoch k'elan winh t'a yich sch'at, majxo scha walaj sb'a winh.
Ix k'och ix Jezabel, ix yetb'eyum winh t'a stz'ey, ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas yuj schichon ha k'o'ol, max yal ha k'o'ol tzach wa'i? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Yujto ix hin lolon yet' winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel yuj jab' slu'um winh b'aj ay te' uwa, ix hin k'an hin man t'a winh, mato swak' junokxo lum sk'exulok, palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix yak' lum t'ayin, yuj chi' schichon hin k'o'ol, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj stak ha k'o'ol yuj jun chi'? ¿Tom manh sreyalok Israel aj jun? Manh ak' pensar yuj jun chi'. K'e'anh wa'an, wa'anh. Ha hin ol wik'ek' jun lum chi', ol wak'an lum t'ayach, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'an jun ch'anh carta ix t'a sb'i winhaj Acab chi', haxo sello winh ix yak'och ix t'a ch'anh. Ix yak'anb'at ch'anh ix t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj kajan winhaj Nabot chi'.
Ix yalan ix t'a ch'anh carta chi' icha tik: Tze molb'ej heb' anima yik tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tzeyak'em k'ojan winhaj Nabot t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' t'a junok lugar niwan yelk'ochi.

Tze sayan chawanhok winak chuk spensar stek'b'ej sb'a yalan t'a spatik winh icha tik: Ha hach tik, ix hach b'uchwaj t'a Dios yet' t'a winh rey, xchiokab' heb' t'a winh. Slajwi chi' tzeyik'anel winh t'a sti'el chonhab', haxo ta' tze julk'enejcham winh, xchib'at ix.
Haxo heb' ichamtak winak chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal ix aj yalanb'at ix Jezabel chi' t'a ch'anh scarta chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot heb' t'a ix Jezabel chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel chi', ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Acab chi': --Ha tikne'ik b'at makkan ikok lum slu'um winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, haton lum maj yal sk'o'ol winh ix schonh t'ayach, yujto toxo ix cham winh, xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi', ix b'at sb'o'anoch sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe:
--Ixik b'at il winhaj Acab sreyal Samaria. Ha t'a Jezreel ayek' winh tikne'ik t'a lum slu'um winhaj Nabot, haton lum ix yik'ek' winh t'a winh.

Tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Yujto ix ha milcham winhaj Nabot, ix ik'anek' lum slu'um winh tik, yuj chi' ha b'aj ix lek'jik'e schik'il winh yuj nok' tz'i', hanheja' pax ta' ol lek'jokk'e ha chik'il ha hach tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Hach ajk'o'ol, ix hin ilchaj hu'uj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Hach ilchaj toni, yujto ix ha tek'b'ej ha b'a ha k'ulan tas te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ol wik'kot kusk'olal t'a ib'anh, ol satel masanil heb' winak t'a inhtilal yet' heb' winak niwak yelk'och t'a skal chonhab' Israel, ma heb' chekab' yaji.

Icha wal wutejnak hin satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej hin satanel heb' inhtilal, yujto ix ha tzuntzejkot yowal hin k'o'ol yuj tas ix ha k'ulej, ix ha kuchb'anb'at heb' etisraelal t'a chukal, xchi Jehová.
Haxo pax yuj ix Jezabel, ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at schib'ejal ix t'a Jezreel tik.

Ha heb' inhtilal ol cham heb' t'a yol chonhab', ha nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at sniwanil heb'. Haxo heb' ol cham t'a spatikel chonhab' chi', ha nok' ostok ol chi'anb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
(Wal yel malaj junokxo rey ix yutej sb'a icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix kuchb'aj winh yuj ix Jezabel ix yetb'eyum, yik stek'b'an sb'a winh sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te yajb'entak ix yutej sb'a winh ayik ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Lajan wal ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a heb' amorreo, haton heb' yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel.)

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab tas ix yal winhaj Elías chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch pichul winh te ya swa'i. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix way winh yet' spichul ya swa chi'. Te kusnak winh tz'ek' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:

¿Tzam ila' tas syutej winhaj Acab chi' yik'anem sb'a t'ayin? Yuj chi' manh ol wak'b'at jun yahelal chi' t'a yib'anh winh. Hato yik ayoch junok yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok, hato ta' ol wak'b'ati, xchi t'a winh.
Oxe' ab'il malaj jab'ok owal t'a skal chonhab' Israel yet' heb' sirio.
Haxo ix el yoxil ab'il chi', ix k'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá lolonel yet' winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a masanil heb' ayoch yopisio yet'ok: --Ha hex tik heyojtak sik'lab'il to ha chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, kiktaxon yaji. ¿Tas yuj max kik'ek' t'a winh sreyal Siria chi'? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mamax yal ha k'o'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha hin tik ol hin b'at het'ok yet' masanil heb' hin soldado yet' jantak nok' hin chej yik owal.
Palta ayik manto och owal chi', ol ko k'anb'ej t'a Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yawtankot 400 heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios winhaj Acab chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tzam yal ko yamanoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh icha tik: --Ak'ek owal chi'. Ha Dios Kajal ol ak'anoch t'a yol he k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Josafat chi': --¿Mama wal junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik b'aj sko k'anb'ej? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh: --Ayto wal junxo winh syal slolon yet' Jehová, haton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta malaj hin gana swil winh, yujto malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al icha chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yawtan jun winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --Ixik t'a elanhchamel, b'at ik'kot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj rey Acab yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá chi', ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, ix em k'ojan heb' winh t'a juntzanh xila yik heb' winh rey t'a jun tek'lab' trigo t'a sti'el spuerta'il chonhab' Samaria. Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', ix stz'ak yal heb' winh tas ol aj yak'an ganar heb' winh rey chi'.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ix sb'o juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en winh, icha sch'a'ak nok' wakax ix aji, ix yalan winh: Icha wal tik ix aj yalan Jehová: Ha juntzanh yechel ch'a'ak wakax tik, ha sch'oxanel ipalil b'aj ol ak' owal yet' masanil heb' sirio masanto ol satel heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi', lajannhej syutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ixik, ak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot yujto ha Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Haxo winh schekab' winh rey ix b'at yik'kot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios wan yalani to wach' ol elk'och winh rey, yuj chi' alpax icha tz'aj yalan heb' winh chi' ha hach tik, xchi winh t'a winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --T'a yichanh Jehová swal t'ayach to ha tas ol yal Jehová t'ayin, ha ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix jawi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Ha tikne'ik hach Micaías, ¿tom smoj sko yamoch owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi': --Ixik, ol ak' ganar jun owal chi', yujto ha Jehová ol ak'anoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal winh icha chi'.
Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Tzijtum elxo swal t'ayach to ha tas yel, ha chi' tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wila', masanil heb' soldado ketisraelal sakleminak sb'atkan heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel malaj stanhwumal. Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Ha juntzanh heb' soldado tik, malaj yilumal heb', meltzajokab' junjun heb' t'a spat t'a junk'olal, xchi, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ina ton swal t'ayach to ha jun winh tik malaj jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'a wib'anh, anhej chukal syal winh, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal slolonel Jehová. Ix wila' to k'ojanem Jehová t'a yol sdespacho, haxo heb' yángel t'a satcha'anh oyanoch heb' t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: ¿Mach wal junok hex b'at he montejb'at winhaj Acab yik sb'at winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik hata' schamkan winh? xchi. Ch'okch'ok ix yutej heb' ángel chi' yalan t'ay.
Haxo ix aji, ay jun espíritu ix k'och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol b'at hin montejb'at winh, xchi. Ix yalan Jehová t'ay: ¿Tas ol utej b'at ha montanb'at winh jun? xchi.

Ix yalan jun espíritu chi' icha tik: Ol hin b'at wek sna' juntzanh heb' winh schekab' winhaj Acab chi' yik anhej esal lolonel ol yal heb' winh, xchi. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ixik ol yal uj icha tzal chi', xchi.

Yuj chi', ha tikne'ik ha Jehová ix ak'anoch jun espíritu t'a heb' winh ha chekab' tik yik anhej esal lolonel syal heb' winh t'ayach. Ha Jehová ix halani to icha chi' tz'aj ha chami, xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

T'a wal jun rato chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Micaías chi', ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Olxo ab'i ayik ol hach ek' ha k'ub'ejel ha b'a t'a yoltak pat, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey Acab chi': --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón sgobernadoral chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.

Tzeyalan t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha winh rey ix halani to tz'och jun winh tik t'a preso. Jab'nhej swa'el winh tzeyak'a', jab'nhej pax ha' tzeyak' yuk'ej winh, masanto tzin meltzaj t'a junk'olal, xchi winh rey chi', xe chi t'a heb' winh.

Ix yalan jay b'elanh lolonel tik winhaj Micaías chi': Tato tzach meltzaj t'a junk'olal, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' anima chi': --Hex wetchonhab', scham wal he na'an jun ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Acab sreyal Israel chi' yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá. Ix k'och heb' winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab t'a winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha hin tik, ol hin k'exel hin pichul yik ol wak' owal chi', ha hachxo tik, ayokab'nhej och ha pichul yik reyal tik, xchi winh t'a winh. Ix sk'exanel spichul winh chi', ix och winh t'a skal owal chi'.
Haxo pax winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' 32 yajalil soldado yik carruaje: Manh heyak' owal yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej yet' winh sreyal Israel tzeyak' owal chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix iljib'at winhaj Josafat yuj heb' yajalil soldado chi', ha sna'an heb' to ha winh sreyal Israel, ix yoyan sb'a heb' t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' ix el yaw winh.
Ix yab'an heb' soldado chi' to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix yaktej heb' spechan winh.

Palta ay jun soldado sirio ix komon julanb'at sjul-lab' t'a skal heb' soldado wan yak'an owal chi'. k'okb'il wal ha winhaj rey Acab chi' ix yamchaji. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a cha makan k'e'en pichul ayoch yuj winh, hata' ix och jun jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh yamjinak sch'anhal nok' chej tok'jinak carruaje b'aj ayk'e winh chi': --Ik' meltzaj nok' chej tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix hin aj hin lajwi, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun k'u chi' te niwan jun owal ix yak' chi'. Ixto syamk'e linhan winhaj Acab chi' heb' t'a yol carruaje yik tzato wal yak' yip heb' yak'an owal yet' heb' aj Siria chi', ix k'e wal sib'an schik'il winh t'a yol carruaje chi', haxo yik ix em k'u ix cham winh.
Haxo yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i, ix och jun aw t'a skal masanil heb' soldado, ix yalani: Paxanhek t'a he chonhab', ma t'a he lu'um junjun hex, xchi.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Acab chi', ix ik'jikot sniwanil winh t'a Samaria. Ha t'a Samaria chi' ix mukji winh.

Ix b'ikji'el scarruaje winh chi' t'a jun tanque b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi', b'aj sb'ikel sb'a heb' ix aj mul ix. Hata' ix lek'ji schik'il winhaj Acab chi' yuj nok' tz'i'. Icha wal chi' ix aj yelk'och tas ix yal Jehová.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acab chi' yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh yet' pax yab'ixal spalacio winh ayoch marfil yelwanub'ok yet' niwak chonhab' ix laj sb'o winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Ocozías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik chanhexo ab'il yoch winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa reyal t'a Judá.
Ayxo 35 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Anhej to maj scheklaj winh ik'jokel masanil yet'tal b'aj tz'och ejmelal b'aj syak' silab' heb' anima yet' b'aj snhus incienso heb' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.
Ix och winh t'a junk'olal yet' winh sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winh yet' sb'inajnakil winh yet' b'ajtak ix yak' ganar owal winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Masanil juntzanh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, ix laj spechel heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en, haton juntzanh heb' winh ixto kan t'a stiempo'al winhaj Asa smam winh.
(Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', malaj rey ayoch t'a Edom, anhej jun winh yajal ak'b'iloch yuj winhaj Josafat.)

Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix yak' b'ojok juntzanh te' barco winh icha te' yik heb' aj Tarsis, yik sb'at te' yik' k'e'en oro t'a Ofir, palta maj yal-laj sb'at te', yujto ix pojkanb'at te' t'a Ezión-geber.
Ha winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab, ix snib'ej winh ix b'at heb' smunlajwum t'a te' barco yet' heb' yik winhaj Josafat chi', palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winhaj Josafat chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel t'a chonhab' Samaria. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh.

Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha sb'eyb'al smam snun winh ix sb'eyb'alej yet' pax sb'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.
Ix och winhaj Ocozías chi' ejmelal t'a komon Dios Baal, icha sk'ulejnak winh smam winh. Icha chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová sDiosal Israel winh t'a yib'anh.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj rey Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a chonhab' Moab t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.

Ay jun k'u ix kot sutnaj winhaj Ocozías yuninal winhaj Acab chi' t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat t'a Samaria. Te niwan ix aj winh slajwi, yuj chi' ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winh yik b'at sk'anb'ej yab' heb' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal heb' aj Ecrón, tato olto b'oxok winh.

Palta ha jun yángel Jehová ix halan t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe icha tik: Ixik, b'at cha heb' schekab' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Samaria, tzalan t'a heb' icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a ko chonhab' ha honh israel honh tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón sb'at he k'anb'ej heyab'i? xa chi t'a heb'.

Tzalanpaxi to ha hin Jehová hin swal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, palta ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi'. Ix b'at winhaj Elías chi', ix sk'anab'ajan winh icha tas ix alji chi' t'ay.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' schekab' winh rey chi', ix k'ochxi heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Tas yuj ix hex meltzaj t'a elanhchamel? xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix tak'wi heb': --Mamin rey, ay jun winh winak ix ko cha t'a yol b'e. Ha winh ix halan t'ayonh icha tik: Meltzajanhek t'a winh ix hex chekankot chi', tzeyalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tom malaj Dios t'a Israel tik, yuj chi' hato t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón tza chekb'at ab'chajok? Yuj wal jun tas ix ha na' tik, manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xe chi, xchi jun winh chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a heb' icha tik: --¿Chajtil yilji jun winh ix halan chi' t'ayex? xchi winh.

--Mamin rey, ha jun winh chi' ayoch jun pichul ay xi'il yuj winh, aypaxoch jun tzek'ul tz'u'um t'a snanhal winh, xchi heb' t'a winh. --Ha jun winh chi', haton winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanb'at jun winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50 heb' winh soldado yik b'at ik'jokkot winhaj Elías chi'. Haxo yik ix k'och heb' t'a winh, k'ojanem winh t'a jun tzalan. Ix yalan winh capitán chi' t'a winh: --Hach schekab' Dios, ha winh rey ix alankoti to tzach emta, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Tato schekab' hin Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh ha soldado chi', xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak', ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado, ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Elías chi': --Hach schekab' Dios, emanhkot t'a elanhchamel yal winh rey, xchi winh capitán chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Tato schekab' hin Dios, kotokab' k'ak' t'a satcha'anh tzach tz'ab'at yet' 50 heb' winh ha soldado chi', xchi winh. T'a wal jun rato chi' ix emta k'ak' t'a satcha'anh, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi' ix schekanxib'at junxo winh capitán winh rey chi' yet' 50-xo heb' winh soldado t'a yoxelal. Palta ha jun winh capitán chi', ix k'ek'och winh b'aj ayek' winhaj Elías chi', ix em kuman winh t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ak' wal niwank'olal t'a wib'anh yet' 50 heb' winh soldado ha chekab' tik.

Yujto ha juntzanh heb' winh capitán yet' soldado, heb' winh ix b'ab'laj ja t'ayach, ix tz'ab'at heb' winh yuj k'ak' ix kot t'a satcha'anh. Ha hin tik tzin tewi t'ayach to tzonh ak' niwank'olal yik max honh chami, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ixik yet' winh, manh hach xiwok, xchi t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix emta winhaj Elías chi', ix b'at winh yet' winh capitán chi', ix b'at winh yil winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winh icha tik t'a winh rey chi': --Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Yujto ix ha chekb'at heb' ha chekab' t'a Baal-zebub sdiosal Ecrón, yik b'at ha k'anb'ej ha b'a, ichato malaj Dios t'a Israel tik b'aj syal tza k'anb'ej ab'i, yuj chi' manhxo ol hach k'e wa'an, palta to ol hach chamxonhej, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.

Icha chi' ix aji, ix cham winh rey chi', icha tas ix schek Jehová yal winhaj Elías chi'. Yujto malaj junok yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi', yuj chi' ha jun winh yuk'tak winh skuchan Joram, ha winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok, haton yik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch junxo winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Ocozías yet' juntzanhxo tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik toxo wal sk'och sk'uhal yik'jib'at winhaj Elías yuj Jehová t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik', ix el winh yet' winhaj Eliseo t'a Gilgal.

Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Betel, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol hin b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh schawanhil t'a Betel chi'.

Ix elta heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Betel chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to ha tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh ha k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh t'a winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a Jericó, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol hin b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atxi heb' winh schawanhil t'a Jericó chi'.

Ix eltapax heb' winh schekab' Dios ayek' ta' scha heb' winh, ix yalan heb' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --¿Ojtak hama to ha tikne'ik ol ik'jokel winh ha k'ayb'umal tik t'ayach yuj Jehová? xchi heb' winh. --Wojtakxo, tz'inek xe chi, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winhaj Elías chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Kananh t'a tik, yujto tzin schekb'at Jehová t'a ha' Jordán, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to ol hin b'atnhej het'ok, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atnhej heb' winh schawanhil.
Najat ix b'at tzak'an 50 heb' winh schekab' Dios yuj heb' winh, najatto ix kan heb' winh t'a yichanhkot heb' winh chawanh chi' t'a sti' ha' Jordán.
Ixlajwi chi' ix spakan jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi', ix spajanem winh t'a sat ha' Jordán chi'. Ix spojan sb'a ha', takinh ix aj b'aj ix ek' heb' winh t'a yol ha' chi'.

Ayik toxo ix k'axpaj ek' heb' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Elías t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Al t'ayin tas tza nib'ej swak' t'ayach yakb'an manto hin ik'jokel t'a ha tz'ey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Tzin k'an t'ayach to cha makan tz'aj ak'ankan opisio chi' t'ayin, ichato ha b'ab'el unin tzin ajkan ha k'exulok, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Elías chi': Te ajaltak jun tza k'an tik t'ayin. Tato ol il tas ol aj wik'ji'el t'a ha tz'ey, ol ak'jok t'ayach. Tato manh ol il jun, manh ol ak'joklaj t'ayach, xchi winh.

Yakb'an wan sb'ey heb' winh, wan slolon heb' winh. Elanhchamel ix cheklajk'e jun carruaje k'ak' yilji, tok'b'il yuj nok' chej k'ak' yiljipaxi. Ha' ix ik'anel winhaj Elías chi' t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix ik'jib'at winh t'a satcha'anh t'a skal jun chakxuxum ik'.

Ayik ix yilan jun chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: Ay mamin, lajan hach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel honh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh. Manhxa b'aj ix yil winhaj Elías winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix snhik'chitanb'at jun spichul winhaj Eliseo ayoch yuj yik sch'oxanel skusk'olal winh.
Elanhchamel ix b'at winh sik'k'e jun sjukan pichul winhaj Elías ix kan lanhnaj chi'. Ix meltzajkan winh t'a ha' Jordán chi', ix och linhan winh t'a sti' ha'.

Ix spajanem sjukan pichul winhaj Elías chi' winh t'a sat ha ha' chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿B'ajtil ayek' Jehová sDiosal winhaj Elías? xchi winh. Ixnhej em k'apak chi' t'a sat ha', ix spojan sb'a ha'. Icha chi' ix aj yek'xita winh t'a yol ha'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Jericó, haton heb' winh najat linhjab'kan yila', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha yopisio winhaj Elías ix ochkan t'a winhaj Eliseo tik, xchi heb' winh. Ix kot heb' scha winh, ix em nhojnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Mamin, iltonab'i, ay 50 heb' winh winak t'a ko kal tik te tek'an. Tato syal ha k'o'ol sb'at heb' winh say winh ha k'ayb'umal chi', talaj ay b'aj ix aktajkan winh yuj Yespíritu Jehová t'a jolomtak witz, ma t'a yoltak ch'olan, xchi heb' winh t'a winh. Palta ix yalan winh: --Ma'ay, malaj mach sb'ati, xchi winh.
Ix ochnhej ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ixikek an, xchi winh. Ix b'at heb' winh 50 chi' say t'a oxe' k'uhal. Malaj mach ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh t'a Jericó b'aj aykan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tom maj wal t'ayex jun to max hex b'atlaj? xchi winh.

Ix yalan heb' anima kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Mamin, ilnab' wal yilji jun lugar tik, te wach', palta malaj tas tz'el t'a sat lu'um yujto manh wach'ok ha ha' ay t'a lu'um, xchi heb'.
--Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot atz'am atz'am t'a yol junok uk'ab' ak'to, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun uk'ab' atz'am chi' heb' t'a winh,

ix b'at sekanem winh t'a yol sjaj ha ha' chi'. Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Icha tik yalan Jehová: Ha hin ix hin b'o jun ha ha' tik. Manhxa b'ak'inh ay mach ol cham yuj ha', manhxa pax b'ak'inh malaj tas ol yak' t'a sat lu'um yuj ha', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'okan ha', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh t'a Betel. Ayik wan sk'e winh t'a sb'e'al chi', ay jun nhilanh heb' winh kelemtak ay t'a jun chonhab' chi' ix elta t'a yol sb'e winh, ix och ijan heb' winh sb'ajan winh, ix yalan heb' winh: K'e'anh hach t'en jolom. K'e'anh hach t'en jolom, xchi heb' winh.

Ix meltzajb'at k'elan winh t'a heb' winh, ix katab'aj heb' winh yuj winh t'a sb'i Jehová. Elanhchamel ix elta chawanh nok' oso t'a kaltak te', ix kotak nhik'chitajb'at 42 heb' winh kelemtak chi' yuj nok'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a jolom witz Carmelo, ix meltzajxi winh t'a Samaria.
Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josafat reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 12 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'och wal ijan chukal ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh yik smam snun. Yujto ix sju'el jun k'e'en k'e'en winh yik Baal sb'onakkan winh smam winh chi'.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ix sb'eyb'alejnhej schukal b'eyb'al winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat winh, haton winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' israel t'a chukal.

Ha winhaj Mesa sreyal Moab, molum kalnel winh yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en chi'. Yuj chi' ha nok' syak' winh yik stupan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', 100 mil nok' yunetak kalnel yet' pax 100 mil nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' slana'il syak' winh.
Palta ayik ix cham winhaj Acab, ix yik'anel sb'a winh sreyal Moab chi' t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Israel.
Yuj chi', ix el winhaj Joram t'a Samaria, ix smolb'an masanil heb' soldado yik Israel winh.

Elanhchamel ix yalb'at winh t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá: Ha winh sreyal Moab toxo ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh hin mandar, ¿tzam yal ha k'o'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal yet' winh? xchib'at winh. Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Judá chi' icha tik: Ol hin b'at het'ok yet' heb' hin soldado yet' nok' hin chej.
Anhej b'i'an, ¿tas b'e'al b'aj ol honh b'atok? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Joram chi' ix yalan winh: Ha t'a sb'e'al takinh lu'um t'a yol yik Edom, hata' ol honh b'atok, xchi winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winh sreyal Israel yet' winh sreyal Judá yet' pax winh sreyal Edom yet' heb' soldado. Uke' k'uhal ix b'ey heb' yujto ix ek' yoymitej lum takinh lum chi' heb', yuj chi' ix lajwi'el ha' ya'al heb' soldado syuk'ej yet' pax yik masanil snok' heb' yet'nak.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, ichato honh smolb'ej Jehová ha honh oxwanh rey honh tik yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' aj Moab tik, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová ayek' t'a tik yik wach' sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová ku'uj? xchi winh. Ay jun winh yajal soldado yaj t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix tak'wi icha tik: --Ha t'a tik ayek' winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat. Haton winh schekab'kan winhaj Elías, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh chi' yel schekab' Jehová yaj winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'at oxwanh heb' winh rey chi' lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Palta ix yalan winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --¿Tas walan wik t'ayach? Ixik, b'at k'anb'ej ha b'a t'a heb' winh schekab' sdiosalkan heb' ha mam ha nun, xchi winh. Palta ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi': --Ma'ay, yujto honh ik'jikot yuj Jehová ha honh oxwanh rey honh tik, yik tzonh yak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' moabita, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --T'a wal yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil swala', haton jun swak' serwil, k'inalok malaj yelk'och winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá tik t'a yol hin sat, manh jab'ok tzin cha wab' tas tzala', max hin ochpax k'elan jab'ok t'ayach.

Ik'ekkot junok mach syal schalan te' arpa t'a wichanh tik, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot jun winh syal schalan te' arpa chi' heb' winh. Ayik wan schalan te' arpa chi' winh, ix jawi yipalil Jehová t'a winhaj Eliseo chi',
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: B'o'ek tzijtumok sanja t'a jun ch'olan tik.
Wach'chom malaj ik', ma nhab' ol heyil sjawi, palta ha jun ch'olan tik ol b'ut'jok yuj ha ha', yuj chi' he masanil ol heyuk' ha', ol yuk'an ha' nok' he wakax yet' pax nok' he chej, xchi Jehová.
Chekelnhej wal yaj jun tik t'a yichanh tas ol sk'ulej Jehová, ol yak'och heb' moabita chi' t'a yol he k'ab'.

Yuj chi' ol he ju'em lanhnaj schonhab' heb' wach' yajoch smuro'al yet' juntzanh niwak chonhab' wach' yilji. Ol he ch'akanem masanil yawb'en te' heb', ol laj he mukankan sjaj ha' yuk'lab' ha' heb', ol he b'ut'ankan sat slu'um heb' yet' k'e'en k'e'en b'aj smunlaji, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Haxo ix aji, ha t'a junxo k'inhib'alil, icha yora'il tz'ak'ji silab' t'a Jehová, ha t'a yol yik Edom, ix kot ha ha', ix b'ut'ji'el sat lum lum chi' yuj ha'.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' moabita to wan sk'och heb' winh rey yak' owal yet' heb', ix smolb'an masanil heb' winh kelemtak heb' yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, heb' winh syal yoch t'a owal, ix och heb' winh smak t'a sat smojon snación chi'.
Ayik ix k'e wan heb' moabita chi' t'a k'inhib'alil, ix yilan heb' toxonhej skopopi yilji yib'anh ha ha' chi' yuj yok k'u, ichato chik'xonhej yilji ha'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ha jun chi' chik'. Tope ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' winh soldado ix smil-lajcham sb'a. Ha tikne'ik koyek sb'at kik'ankan masanil tastak yet'nak heb' ix kani, xchi heb'.

Palta haxo ix jawi heb' moabita t'a scampamento heb' israel, ix elta heb' israel chi' yak' owal yet' heb', ix ak'ji ganar heb' moabita chi' yuj heb'. Yuj chi' ix el heb' elelal, palta ix och heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb', ix miljicham heb' yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix sjuanem lanhnaj schonhab' heb' moabita chi' heb', ix sb'ut'an lum lum heb' t'a k'e'en k'e'en, haton lum te yax sat yik munlajel. Ix smukan sjajtak ha ha' heb', ix sch'akanel masanil te' awb'en te' heb' te wach'. Haxonhej chonhab' Quir-hareset ixto kani, palta haxo heb' sjulwaj yet' ch'anh mejme'ech, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ayik ix yilan winh sreyal Moab to wan yak'ji ganar winh t'a owal chi', ix yik'ankot 700 heb' soldado winh, heb' te jelan yak'an owal yet' k'e'en espada. Ix yekanoch sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' soldado yik sk'och heb' b'aj ayek' winh sreyal Edom chi', yik smilancham winh heb' yalani, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'ankot jun sb'ab'el yuninal winh sreyal Moab chi', haton jun t'inhan yochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix snhusantz'a winh silab'il t'a sdiosal t'a yib'anh smuro'al schonhab' chi'. Te chuk ix aj sna'an heb' winh israel chi' yuj jun chi', yuj chi' ix yik'k'e wa'an scampamento heb' winh, ix pax heb' winh t'a schonhab'.

Ay jun ix ix yetb'eyumkan junok heb' winh schekab' Dios, ix b'at ix yal sb'a t'a winhaj Eliseo icha tik: --Ha winh wetb'eyum chamnakxo winh, ojtak to te ay xiwk'olal winh t'a Jehová. Haxo tikne'ik ay jun winh ak'annak k'e'en tumin smajnej winh wetb'eyum chi', ix jawi winh t'ayin, snib'ej winh syik'b'at chawanh heb' wune' tik schekab'ok yuj k'e'en tumin chi', xchi ix.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tas tza nib'ej tzin b'o t'ayach? Al t'ayin tastak ay t'ayach, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, malaj wal jab'ok tas ay t'ayin, anhej wal jab' yune' xalu aceite ayek' t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ix yalan winh t'a ix: --Ixik, tza k'anan ha majnej jantak xalu t'a heb' ay t'a ha lak'anil, jantaknhej malaj yo'ol tz'ilchaj hu'uj.

Elanhchamel tzach och t'a yol ha pat yet' heb' winh une' chi'. Tza makan ha pat chi', tzak'an b'ut'jok masanil juntzanh yet'tal chi' t'a aceite chi'. Ch'ok b'aj tzak'kanem juntzanh sb'ut'jikan chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon ix yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at smakanoch sb'a ix yet' heb' winh yune' chi' t'a yol spat, ix syamanoch heb' sb'ut'an juntzanh xalu ix smajnej chi' t'a aceite chi'.

Ayik toxo ix b'ut'ji masanil xalu chi', ix yalan ix t'a junok heb' winh yune' chi' icha tik: --Ik'kot junokxo xalu, xchi ix. Ix yalan jun winh yune' ix chi': --Manhxalaj tas, xchi winh. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi' ix wanaj aceite chi' yeli.

Ix lajwinhej chi', ix b'at ix yal t'a winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix yalan winh icha tik t'a ix: --Ha tikne'ik ixik ha chonh aceite chi', slajwi chi' tza tupan ha b'ok chi', haxo jantak stojol chi' skani, tza k'an k'e'en yet' heb' winh une' chi', xchi winh t'a ix.

Ay jun k'u ix ek' winhaj Eliseo t'a chonhab' Sunem. Hata' ay jun ix ix te b'eyum. Ix och te'an ix t'a winh to tz'ek' winh wa'el t'a spat ix. Yuj chi' ayik tz'ek' winh juntak el t'a jun chonhab' chi', tz'ek'nhej winh wa'el t'a spat ix chi'.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, snachajel wu'uj to ha jun winh tz'ek'nhej honh yil t'a juntak el, wal yel schekab' Dios yaj winh.

Yuj chi', wach' sko b'o junok cuarto t'a yib'anh ko pat tik, skak'anoch junok ch'at t'a yo'ol, junok mexa, junok xila yet' junok candil, yik wach' ayik sjawi winh honh yila', hata' skan winh, xchi ix.
Ix ek'xi winhaj Eliseo chi' ta' yet' winh schekab' skuchan Giezi, ix k'e heb' winh t'a yol jun cuarto chi', hata' ix waykan heb' winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi' icha tik: --Awtej ix aj Sunem chi', xchi winh. Ix yawtan ix winh, ix jawi ix t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' chi':

--k'anb'ej t'a ix tas snib'ej sk'o'ol ix, yujto te wach' syutej sk'o'ol ix t'ayonh. Tato syal sk'o'ol ix syal tzonh lolon yet' winh rey yuj ix, ma yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, xchi winh. Ix yalan ix: --Ma'ay, wach' waj t'a yol hin chonhab' tik, xchi ix t'a winh chekab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix pax ix.
--¿Tas wach' sko k'ulej t'a ix syal chi'? xchi winh t'a winh schekab' chi'. --Max nachajel wu'uj, anhej, malaj yune' ix, haxo winh yetb'eyum ix icham winakxo winh, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.
--Awtejxikot ix, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix awtajxikot ix, ix jawi tek'tek' ix t'a spuerta'il jun cuarto chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a ix: --Yab' wal icha tik junab', chelb'ilxo k'e junok une' hu'uj, xchi winh t'a ix. Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Ma'ay mamin, hach schekab' Dios, manh hach b'uchwaj t'ayin, xchi ix.
Palta ix skuchanoch jun yune' ix, haxo t'a junxo ab'il, ix alji jun yune' ix chi', icha wal ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Ix k'ib' jun unin chi', ay jun k'u ix b'at yil winh smam b'aj ayb'at yil heb' sjochum trigo.

Ix yalan jun unin chi' t'a winh smam chi' icha tik: --Ay, te ya hin jolom. Te ya hin jolom, xchi. Ix yalan winh mamab'il chi' t'a junok heb' winh schekab': --Ik'b'at winh unin tik t'a ix snun, xchi winh.
Ix ik'jib'at winh unin chi' t'a ix snun yuj winh chekab' chi', ix schelank'e ix t'a sat xub', haxo ix och chimk'uhalil ix chami.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yak'ankanek' telan ix t'a sat sch'at winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi', ix smakankan jun cuarto chi' ix.
Elanhchamel ix yawtej winh yetb'eyum ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh: --Chekb'at junok heb' winh ko chekab' yet' junok nok' b'uru wet'ok, sb'at wilan winh schekab' Dios, naktik hin jaxi, xchi ix.
--¿Tas yuj b'at il winh tikne'ik? Manh stiempo'alok yalji k'e'en uj, manh sk'uhalok pax ik'oj ip, xchi winh yetb'eyum ix chi'. --Manh ak' pensar, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix to tz'ak'ji'och stz'u'um nok' b'uru chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh schekab' chi': --Konh an, yelk'olal ha pechan nok', manh ha cha och wa'an nok' t'a yol b'e masanto ha hin ol wal t'ayach, xchi ix t'a winh.

Icha chi' ix aj sb'at ix masanto ix k'och ix t'a lum witz Carmelo b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios chi'. Najatto wan skot ix ix yilanb'at winh, ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Giezi icha tik: --Ilnab'i, ha ix aj Sunem sjawi chi'.
Ixik b'at cha ix, tza k'anb'an t'a ix tato wach' sk'o'ol ix yet' winh yetb'eyum yet' winh nene' unin, xchi winh. Ix b'at winh scha ix. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a ix, ix yalan ix to wach' sk'o'ol heb'.

Palta elanhchamel ix k'och ix b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo t'a lum witz Carmelo chi', ix och lak'naj ix t'a yok winh, haxo winhaj Giezi chi' ix ketzanel ix yalani. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Aktejel ix, yujto te kusnak spixan ix swila', manta tas syal Jehová t'ayin tas yuj ix kot ix, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalan ix icha tik: --Mamin, ¿tokwal ha hin ix hin k'an t'ayach to tz'alji junok wune'? ¿Tom maj wal t'ayach tas yuj tonhej tzach b'uchwaj t'ayin? xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a winh schekab' chi': --Ak' lista ha b'a, ik'b'at te' hin k'okoch tik het'ok, tzach b'at t'a elanhchamel. Tato ay mach tza cha'a, manh hach lolon yet'ok. Tato ay heb' tz'awajkot t'ayach, manh hach tak'wok t'a heb'. Ayik tzach k'och chi' tzak'em te' hin k'okoch tik t'a sat winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalan ix snun winh unin chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh Jehová to max hin b'at t'a tik tato max hach b'at wet'ok, xchi ix.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yet' ix. Haxo pax winhaj Giezi chi', toxo ix b'ab'lajb'at winh, toxo ix yak'em te' k'okoch chi' winh t'a sat winh unin chi', palta maj jaxlaj sk'o'ol winh. Yuj chi' ix kot winh scha winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Max jalaj sk'o'ol winh unin chi', xchi winh.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Eliseo t'a yol cuarto chi', telanek' winh unin chi' t'a sat sch'at winh, chamnakxo.
Yuj chi' ix och winh t'a yol jun cuarto chi' sch'okoj yet' winh unin chi', ix smakan winh, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e winh t'a sat ch'at chi', ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix em tenan sat winh t'a sat winh unin chi', ix yak'anoch sti' winh t'a sti' yet' sk'ab' winh t'a sk'ab'. Ix k'e lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi'. Ix k'ixnajxi sniwanil winh unin chi'.

Ix el winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi', ix ek' b'esesok winh t'a yol pat chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'ex lachan winh t'a yib'anh winh unin chi' icha t'a sb'ab'elal. Haxo ix aj jun, ukel ix at'iswi winh unin chi', ichato chi' ix elta k'elan winh.

Ix yawtan winhaj Giezi winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Awtejkot ix sunamita chi', xchi winh. Ix b'at winh yawtejkot ix. Haxo ix k'och ix t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi' jun, ix yalan winh: --Ina winh une' tik, xchi winh.
Ix snitzanoch sb'a ix, ix em kuman ix t'a yichanh winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix schelank'e winh yune' ix chi', ix elta ix t'a yol scuarto winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Gilgal ayik te ayem jun niwan wejel t'a yol yik Israel. Ha jun'el molanoch heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a stz'ey winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh schekab' icha tik: Ak'k'e junok niwan chen t'a yib'anh k'ak', tza b'o'an swa'el heb' winh schekab' Dios tik, xchi winh.

Ay jun winh t'a skal heb' winh chekab' chi' ix b'at sayoj itaj. Ix ilchaj jun anh itaj icha anh kaltakte'al k'um ay sat yuj winh. Ix smolankot sat chi' winh t'a yol jun spichul jukan. Haxo yik ix jax winh, ix slesanem winh t'a yol jun niwan chen chi', palta manh yojtakok winh tas.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an winh t'a heb' winh schekab' Dios chi'. Haxo ix syamanoch heb' winh swa'i, ix el yaw heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh: --Mamin schekab' Dios, ha jun wan ko chi'an tik ayb'at veneno t'a skal, xchi heb' winh. Yuj chi' majxo schilaj heb' winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ik'ekkot jab'ok ixim harina t'ayin, xchi winh. Ix yak'anem ixim winh t'a yol chen chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha tikne'ik ak' wa heb' anima tik, xchi winh. Haxo ix schi'an heb', manhxalaj tas ix ik'an heb'.

Haxo t'a jun'el ix k'och jun winh winak aj Baal-salisa, yet'nak 20 ixim pan cebada winh b'ob'il t'a ixim b'ab'el sat cebada chi', ix yak'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', yet'nakpax ixim jolom trigo winh yaxto. Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh schekab': --Ak' ixim pan chi' swa heb' anima tik, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh schekab' winh chi': --¿Tokwal ol yal wak'an jab' tik t'a 100 anima tik? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ak' wa heb' anima tik, yujto toxo ix yal Jehová to ol wa heb', aytopax ol kanok, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an wa heb' anima chi' winh chekab' chi'. Ayto ix kani, icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Ay jun winh winak skuch Naamán, yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Siria. Te xajan winh yuj winh rey chi', te niwan pax yelk'och winh, yujto ha Jehová ix ak'anoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Te jelan winh t'a owal, palta ayoch jun yab'il lepra t'a winh.
Ay jun'el, ay juntzanh heb' soldado aj Siria ix b'at elk'al t'a yol yik Israel. Ix yelk'ejb'at jun ix kob'es unin heb'. Ix och ix schekab'ok ix yetb'eyum winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix yalan ix kob'es unin chi' t'a ix b'aj ayoch chekab'ok chi': --Komonok sb'at winh hin patrón tik t'a jun winh schekab' Dios ay t'a Samaria, talaj sb'oxi winh yuj jun yab'il tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yal t'a winh sreyal Siria tas ix yal ix kob'es chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh: --Wach' tzach b'ati, swak'b'at junok carta t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj sb'at winhaj Naamán chi', ix yik'anb'at nanhal swajxakil quintal k'e'en plata winh yet' nanhal schab'il quintal k'e'en oro yet' lajunh moj pichul.

Ix yik'anb'at jun carta chi' winh t'a winh sreyal Israel chi', syalan winh sreyal Siria chi' t'a jun carta chi' icha tik: Ayik ol ha cha'an hin carta tik, ol ojtakejeli to ha hin tzin chekb'at winh sat yajal heb' hin soldado skuchan Naamán tik t'ayach, tzanhtej winh t'a jun lepra ayoch t'ay, xchi winh t'a scarta chi'.

Ayik ix lajwi yilan jun carta chi' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxaneli to tz'och winh t'a ilk'olal, ix yalan winh: --Tokwal Dios hin, ¿tom ha hin syal wak'an schamel anima, ma swak'anpax sk'inal heb', yuj chi' schekjikot jun winh winak tik t'ayin yik swik'el jun lepra tik t'a winh? Syalelk'ochi to ay tas sna' winh rey chi' t'a hin patik, xchi winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios to ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul winh rey chi', ix yalanb'at winh: --¿Tas yuj ix ha nhik'chitejb'at ha pichul? Chekkot jun winh chi' t'ayin, ol yilan winh to ay schekab' Dios t'a ko chonhab' Israel tik, xchib'at winh.
Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi' yet' scarruaje yet' schej yet' heb' ajun yet'ok, ix k'och linhan heb' t'a sti' spat winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix schekanb'at winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: Ixik, b'at b'ikel ukelok ha b'a t'a ha' Jordán, icha chi' ol aj yel yab'il lepra chi' t'a ha niwanil chi', xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Naamán chi', ix b'at winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha wal hin na'ani to ol elta winh hin scha'a, ol k'e wal linhan winh slesalwi t'a Jehová sDiosal t'a wichanh, ol yak'anek' sk'ab' winh b'aj ayoch lepra chi' t'ayin, tz'elkan yab'il walani.

¿Tok ek'b'al swach'il junok ha' ay t'a Israel tik t'a yichanh ha' Abana yet' ha' Farfar ay t'a Damasco? ¿Tom max yal b'at hin b'ikanel hin b'a t'a yol ha' chi', tzin b'oxi? xchi winh. Te aykot yowal winh, ix meltzaj winh.

Palta haxo heb' schekab' winh ajun yet'ok, ix yal heb' t'a winh icha tik: --Mamin, k'inalok ay junok tas ajaltak ix yal winh schekab' Dios t'ayach, ¿tom max ha k'anab'ajej? Okxo jun, anhej ix yal winh to tza b'ikel ha b'a tzach b'oxikani, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ichato chi' ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi', ukel ix em winh t'a yol ha' Jordán chi', icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios. Ix b'oxikan sniwanil winh chi', icha sniwanil junok unin, te wach' ix ajkani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' ajun yet' chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winh, ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ix nachajel wu'uj to malaj junokxo Dios t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, palta anhej wal he Diosal ha hex israel hex tik. Yuj chi', elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol ha cha'an hin silab' swak' tik t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Swak' hin ti' t'a Jehová, haton ayin schekab', max hin chalaj tas tzak' chi', xchi winh. Wach'chom ix ochnhej te'an winhaj Naamán chi' t'a winh, palta maj schalaj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Naamán chi' icha tik: --Tato icha chi' jun, elok wal t'a ha k'o'ol ha cha'an wik'b'at chab'ok chejal lum lum yik Israel tik, yujto ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, manhxa junokxo Dios b'aj ol wak' hin silab', palta to anhej t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Anhej wal jun tzin k'an t'a Jehová to tzin yak' niwank'olal, yujto ayik ol b'at winh hin reyal yak'em sb'a t'a stemplo sdiosal skuch Rimón, ol och ketzketz winh t'a hin k'ab', hanhejtona' ol hin em kuman yet' winh t'a templo chi', yak'okab' niwank'olal Jehová t'a hin patik yuj jun chi', xchi winhaj Naamán chi'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh ak' pensar, ixik, xchi winh. Ix b'at winhaj Naamán chi'. Palta kenanto sb'at winh,

ix sna'an winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi': ¿Tas yuj tonhej ix schab'at winhaj Naamán aj Siria winh wajalil tik, malaj jab'ok tas ix yak'kan winh? Swak' hin ti' t'a Jehová to b'at hin tzak'wej winh, yalnhej tas ol wik'ek' t'a winh, xchi winh.

Ix b'at lemnaj winhaj Giezi chi'. Haxo ix yilankot winhaj Naamán to wan skot winh t'a spatik, ix emta winh t'a yol scarruaje, ix kot winh scha winh, ix sk'anb'an winh: --¿Mantok ay tas ix uji? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Giezi chi' icha tik: Ma'ay, malaj tasi, palta ha winh wajalil ix hin chekankot wal t'ayach to hato wal sk'och chawanh heb' kelemtak schekab' Dios spetoj t'a tzalkixtak yik Efraín. Yuj chi' sk'an winh t'ayach to tzak' oxe'ok arroba k'e'en plata yet' cha mojanhok k'apak pichul yuj heb' winh, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Naamán chi': --Komonok tz'el t'a ha k'o'ol tza cha wal wake'ok arroba k'e'en plata tik, xchi winh. Yakb'an wan yalan winh chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajem k'e'en yet' cha moj k'apak pichul chi' t'a yol chab' koxtal, ix yak'ankot chawanh schekab' winh yet' winhaj Giezi chi'.

Ayik ix k'och heb' t'a tzalan b'aj ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yik'an ek' winhaj Giezi tastak yet'nak heb' schekab' winhaj Naamán chi', ix sk'ub'ankanel winh t'a yol spat, ix schekan meltzaj heb' winh.
Elanhchamel ix jawi winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Giezi, ¿b'ajtil ix hach xit'ek'i? xchi winh. --Malaj b'aj ix hin xit'ek' mamin, xchi winhaj Giezi chi'.

Palta ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ayik ix emta jun winh winak t'a yol scarruaje ix kot winh ul hach scha'a, ¿tokwal maj yil hin pixan jun chi' tza na'a? Ha tikne'ik, manh smojok ko cha'an tumin yet' pichul. Manh smojok pax ko manan te' awb'en te', icha te' olivo yet' te' uwa, nok' kalnel, ma nok' wakax, ma heb' winh chekab' yet' heb' ix chekab'.

Yuj jun tas ix ha k'ulej tik, ha tikne'ik, ha slepra winhaj Naamán chi' ol ochkan t'ayach yet' t'a heb' inhtilal t'a jun'elnhej, xchi winh. Haxo yik ix spukan sb'a winhaj Giezi yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ayxo lepra t'a winh, sakxonhej yilji sniwanil winh icha k'e'en che'ew.
Ay jun'el ix yal heb' winh schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Eliseo: --Ina wal jun lugar b'aj ayonh ek' et' tik, te lot'an.
Yuj chi' tzok wal el t'a ha k'o'ol tzonh ha chab'at t'a sti' ha' Jordán, sb'at ko ch'ak junjunok ko te', sko b'o'ank'e junok pat b'aj tzonh aji, xchi heb' winh. --Ixikek, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
--Tzok yal ha k'o'ol tzach b'at ket'ok, xchi jun winh t'a winh. --Hinye, ol hin b'atok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yet' heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán ch'akoj te' chi'.

Ayik wan sch'akan te' heb' winh, ay jun winh ix elta surnaj k'e'en sch'akab', ix b'atkan k'e'en t'a yol ha ha' chi', ix el yaw winh: --Hach hin k'ayb'umal. Ha jun k'e'en ch'akab' tik hierro k'e'en, hin majanpax k'e'en, xchi winh.

--¿B'ajtil ix b'at k'e'en? xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix sch'oxan winh b'aj ix b'at k'e'en chi'. Ix xikanelta jun te te' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yak'anem te' winh t'a yol ha', ix k'e'ul b'akhnaj k'e'en ch'akab' chi' t'a sat ha'.
--Ik'k'eta k'e'en, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anem sk'ab' winh, ix yik'ank'eta k'e'en winh.
Ha winh sreyal Siria ayoch owal yuj winh t'a Israel, ix slajti'an sb'a winh yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado smasanil b'ajtil sb'ok'e scampamento heb' winh.
Ix yalanb'at winhaj Eliseo t'a winh sreyal Israel b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh aj Siria chi' yik wach' syak' lista sb'a winh b'ajtak ayek' heb' winh chi'.
Ix schekanpaxb'at yilumal winh sreyal Israel t'a juntzanh lugar b'aj syal winh schekab' Dios chi', yik syil heb' winh tas yaji, yuj chi' tzijtum el ix skol sb'a heb' winh.

Ha winh sreyal Siria chi', ix te somchaj spensar winh, yuj chi' ix yawtej heb' winh yajalil soldado winh, ix yalan winh: --Alek t'ayin mach junok t'a ko kal tik ayoch yet' winh sreyal Israel chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh yajal soldado icha tik: --Malaj mach mamin, palta ha winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios ayek' t'a Israel chi', ha winh tz'alan t'a winh rey masanil tas tzala', wach'chom t'a elk'altak tzala', xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Siria chi': --Ixikek, b'at ilek b'ajtil ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi', ol wak'anb'at jaywanhok hin soldado yik b'at tzek'jikot winh, xchi winh. Haxo ix aj yalji t'a winh rey chi' to ha t'a Dotán ayek' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'anb'at jun nhilanh heb' winh soldado winh yet' heb' winh ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' carruaje yik owal. T'ak'walil ix k'och heb' winh t'a Dotán chi', ix yoyan sb'a heb' winh t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi'.

Ayik ix sakb'i, ix k'e wa'an winh schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ayik ix elta winh, ix yilan winh to manhxo jantakok soldado oyanek' t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi', ay nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal. Yuj chi' ix b'at winh yal t'a winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ay mamin, ¿tas wal ol ko k'ulej? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Manh hach xiwok, yujto ek'alto sb'isul heb' ayek' ket'ok t'a yichanh heb' winh chi', xchi winh.

Ix och ijan winhaj Eliseo chi' slesalwi t'a Jehová icha tik: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza jak sat winh hin chekab' tik, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat winh chekab' chi' yuj Jehová, ix yilan winh to ha t'a sattak witz yet' t'a jolomtak witz, toxonhej oyankot soldado t'a yib'anh chej yet' t'a yoltak carruaje nab'a k'ak', oyanoch t'a spatik yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ayik wan sjawi heb' winh sirio chi' yak' owal, ix sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a Jehová: Mamin tzin k'an t'ayach to tza mak sat heb' winh tik, xchi winh. Haxo Jehová ix makan sat heb' winh soldado ajk'o'ol chi', icha ix aj sk'anan winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Eliseo chi' yal t'a heb' winh: --Manhoklaj jun b'e yet' jun chonhab' tik tze saya'. Ochanhek tzak'an wu'uj, ol hex wik'b'at b'aj ayek' jun winh tze say chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix yik'anb'at heb' winh winh t'a Samaria.
