Ayik toxo ix och heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, jak sat heb' winh yik syal yilan heb' winh, xchi winh. Ix jakji sat heb' winh chi'. Ix yilan heb' winh to ha t'a yol chonhab' Samaria ayek' heb' winh.
Ayik ix yilan heb' winh chi' winh sreyal Israel, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. --Mamin, ¿tzam yal hin milancham heb' winh tik? xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ma'ay, manh ha milchamlaj heb' winh. K'inalok ay heb' syamchaj hu'uj t'a owal, ¿tom tza milcham heb'? Ak' wa heb' winh, tzak'an yuk' ha' heb' winh, tzak'an meltzaj heb' winh t'a winh yajalil, xchi winh.

Ix b'o jun niwan wa'el, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh sreyal Israel to spax heb' winh, ix meltzaj heb' winh b'aj ayek' winh yajalil chi'. Atax ta' ix yaktej heb' winh soldado sirio yochta yik syixtan chonhab' Israel yet' yochta heb' elk'al.
Ixlajwi yek' jun pekti', ha winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ix molb'ej masanil heb' winh soldado winh, ix b'at yoyank'e Samaria heb' winh yik syak'an owal yet'ok.

Yuj chi' ix em jun niwan wejel t'a Samaria chi'. Ix te k'e stojol masanil tastak, yujto te wach' yajoch hoyan heb' winh aj Siria chi' t'a spatik chonhab' chi'. Ha junok sjolom nok' b'uru, 80 ciclo plata stojol, haxo junok waso stza' nok' paramuch, oye' ciclo plata stojol.
Ay jun k'u wan sb'eyek' winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' chi', ix awajb'at jun ix ix t'a winh: --Mamin rey, kolin, xchi ix.
Ix tak'wi winh rey chi': --Tato max hach kolji yuj Jehová, ¿tom ha hinto wal tik ol hach hin kolo'? ¿Tom ol yal wak'an ixim ha trigo yet' ha wino?
¿Tas tzach ik'ani? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi ix: --Ha jun ix ix tik, ix yal ix t'ayin: Ak' jun une' tik ko chi tikne'ik, haxo k'ik'an sko chi'an jun wik tik, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ko tz'anh wune' chi', ko chi'ani. Haxo t'a junxo k'u chi', walan t'a ix to syak' yune' ix chi' ko chi'a, palta toxo ix sk'ub'ejel ix, xchi ix t'a winh rey chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an winh rey tas ix yal jun ix chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh yuj sch'oxanel skusk'olal. Yakb'an wan yek' winh t'a yib'anh muro chi', ix yilan heb' anima ayek' t'a slak'anil chi' to ayoch pichul ya swa yuj winh t'a yol spichul.
Ix yalan winh rey chi': Kotokab'kan yowal sk'o'ol Dios t'a wib'anh tato max wik'el sjolom winhaj Eliseo yuninal winhaj Safat t'a jun k'u tik, xchi winh.

Ix schekanb'at jun winh winak winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Eliseo chi'. k'ojanem winh t'a yol spat yet' heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab'. Ayik manto k'ochlaj jun winh schekab' winh rey chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ichamtak winak chi': --Ilek tonab'i, ix schekkot jun winh schekab' jun winh milum anima chi' yik tzul yik'el hin jolom winh. Palta maklejek heyab' tas ol wala': Ayik ol jawok winh chi', ol he makel te' puerta tik, wach' tzeyutej he makan te', tzak'an sjawi winh rey t'a spatik winh, xchi winh.

Wanto wal slolon winh ix jawi winh schekab' winh rey chi', ajun pax winh rey chi', ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ha jun yahelal tik, ha Jehová ix ak'ankoti. ¿Tasto wal sko te tanhwej tikne'ik yik tzonh skolani? xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' icha tik: --Ab'ek wal tas syal Jehová: Ha k'ik'an yab' icha tik, ha t'a spuerta'il Samaria tik, ha junok almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'e'en, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi jun winh stanhwan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Wach'chom sjakwi swentena'il satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol ha walaj ixim, xchi winh.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ay chanhwanh heb' winh ayoch lepra t'ay, ayel heb' winh t'a sti'el chonhab' chi', ix yal-lan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --¿Tas wal sko k'ulej t'a tik? Tonhej k'ojan honh em ko tanhwan cham ko b'a.

Tato tzonh och t'a yol chonhab' tik, yowalil tzonh cham yuj wejel. Tato tzonh kan k'ojan t'a tik, yowalil ol honh champaxok. Ha tikne'ik koyek t'a scampamento heb' sirio, talaj tzonh yak' niwank'olal heb', max honh smil-laj heb'. Tato ma'ay jun, toxonton yik chamel kaji, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik numnonxo sk'ik'b'i, ix b'at heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix k'och heb' winh, ix yilan heb' winh manhxa junok mach ayek'i.

Yujto ha Jehová ix ak'an yab' heb' soldado sirio sk'anh yek' carruaje yet' nok' chej yet' pax jun niwan nhilanh soldado. Ha yalan heb' sirio chi' to ha winh sreyal heb' israel ix tupan heb' winh sreyal hitita yet' winh sreyal Egipto yik syak'an owal yet' heb' yalani.
Yuj chi' ayik wan sk'ik'b'i ix b'at heb' elelal, ix yaktankan scampamento heb' yet' smantiado yet' nok' chej yet' scarruaje heb'. Anhej heb' ix skol sb'a.

Ayik ix k'och heb' winh ayoch lepra chi' t'ay t'a stitak campamento chi', ix och heb' winh t'a yol junok mantiado, ix wa heb' winh, ix yuk'an ha' heb' winh. Ix yik'anelta k'e'en oro heb' winh, k'e'en plata yet' pichul, ix b'at heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh, ix ochxi heb' winh t'a yol junxo mantiado, ix yik'anelta heb' winh tastak ay t'a yo'ol, ix b'atxi heb' winh sk'ub'ejeli.

Ix laj yalan heb' winh t'ay junjun: --Manh wach'ok jun wan ko k'ulan tik. Ha tikne'ik smoj wal kik'anb'at ab'ix, palta ichnhejta' kajek'i. Tato sko tanhwej, hato k'ik'an b'at kala', ay ta tas skot t'a kib'anh. Wach' to b'at kalek t'a winh rey, xchi heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' winh, ix yawtan heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Ix honh xit'ek' t'a scampamento heb' sirio, manhxa junok mach ayek'i, manhxa junok mach skab' sloloni, haxonhej nok' chej yet' nok' b'uru etzjab'kani. Haxo smantiado heb', icha ix aj sb'o'ankan heb', icha chi' yajkani.
Ix b'at heb' winh stanhwumal sti' chonhab' chi' yawtej heb' winh stanhwan spalacio winh rey.

Ix alji yab' winh rey chi', yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winh t'ak'walil chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a opisio yet'ok: --Ol wal t'ayex tas snib'ej heb' sirio chi' tzonh yutej, yujto yojtak heb' to wan ko cham yuj wejel, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan scampamento heb' chi', ix sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' t'a kaltak te', yuj chi' tato tzonh el t'a spatikel chonhab' tik, ol honh syam heb' t'a pitzanil, haxo yochkankot heb' t'a yol chonhab' tik, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan junok heb' winh schekab' winh icha tik: --B'atokab' jaywanhok winak yila' yet' owanhok nok' chej ayto ek' tik, ol kilani tas ix uji chi'. Tato scham heb', mato ma'ay, lajannhej, yujto ay smay b'aj sb'at heb' chi', ay pax smay t'a tik, xchi winh chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at chab' carruaje heb' yet' nok' chej, ix chekjib'at heb' yuj winh rey chi', yik b'at yil heb' b'ajtil ix b'at heb' sirio chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: B'at ilek tas wal yaji, xchi winh.

Ix b'at tzak'an heb' t'a yoklem heb' sirio chi', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a ha' Jordán. Ix yilan heb' to aykan spichul heb' t'a yoltak b'e yet' syamk'ab' heb' ayik wan yel heb' skol sb'a yalani. Elanhchamel ix meltzaj heb' chekab' chi', ix ul yalan heb' t'a winh rey chi' tas ix yil heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix elta masanil heb' anima t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yik'anelta masanil tastak ay t'a yol scampamento heb' sirio chi' heb', ix yik'ankot heb'. Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan Jehová, ha jun almul ixim harina, jun ciclo plata stojol ixim. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo plata chi'.

Ix yalan winh rey t'a winh stanhwumal to skan winh stanhwej spuerta'il chonhab' chi', palta ix b'at heb' anima t'a yib'anh winh, ix telwikan winh t'a skal yok heb', ix cham winh, icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios t'a winh ayik ix xit'ek' winh rey lolonel yet' winhaj Eliseo chi'.

Ix elk'och icha ix aj yalan winhaj Eliseo chi' to ha t'a spuerta'il chonhab' Samaria yab' icha tik k'ik'an, schonhchaj ixim harina, ha jun almul ixim, jun ciclo plata stojol. Chab' almul pax ixim cebada t'a jun ciclo k'e'en, xchi winh.

Haxo jun winh stanhwumal winh rey chi', ix tak'wi winh t'a winh schekab' Dios chi': Wach'chom sjakwi swentena'il satcha'anh yuj Jehová, palta max ujilaj icha tzal chi', xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo: Olto il wal jun chi', palta manhxo ol ha walaj ixim, xchi winh.
Ichaton chi' ix aji, yujto ha heb' anima ix tek'ancham winh t'a spuerta'il chonhab' chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo t'a ix aj Sunem, haton ix pitzwinakxi yune' yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: Ixik, b'at kajnajan t'a junokxo nación yet' heb' kajan t'a ha pat, yujto ix yal Jehová to ol yak'kot junok niwan wejel t'a ko nación tik, uke' ab'il ol yak'a', xchi winh t'a ix.
Yuj chi' ix sk'anab'ajej ix sb'ati, icha ix aj yalan winh chi'. Ix b'atkan ix t'a yol smakb'en heb' filisteo. Uke' ab'il ix kan kajan ix ta'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix paxta ix t'a smakb'en heb' filisteo chi'. Ix b'at ix t'a yichanh winh sreyal Israel yik sk'ananxi spat ix yet' slu'um.
Wan slolon winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Giezi schekab' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: Al wab' masanil tastak satub'tak ix sk'ulej winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh.

Ha wal yik wan yalan winhaj Giezi chi' yab'ixal tas ix aj yak'anxi pitzwok jun yune' jun ix ix chi' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix jawi ix yal yuj slu'um yet' spat. Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Giezi chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Mamin rey, haton wal jun ix ix tik swala', haton jun yune' ix tik pitzwinakxi yuj winhaj Eliseo chi', xchi winh t'a winh rey chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a ix, ix yalan jun ab'ix chi' ix t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan junok heb' schekab' winh rey chi' yik b'at ak'jixi smakb'en ix ix chi' yet' masanil sat awb'en ix el t'a lu'um yiktax ix el ix t'a yol nación chi' masanto ix meltzajxi ix.
Ay jun'el ix b'at winhaj Eliseo t'a Damasco. Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te pena'ay winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria. Ix alchaj t'a winh to ix k'och winh schekab' Jehová ta'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Hazael schekab' icha tik: --Ik'b'at junok silab' tzach b'at il winh schekab' Jehová chi'. Tza k'anan t'a winh to sk'anb'ej winh t'a Jehová chi' wu'uj, tato olto hin b'oxok yuj jun yahelal tik, xchi winh.

Ix b'at winhaj Hazael chi' yil winhaj Eliseo chi'. Ix yik'anb'at silab' winh, haton tas te wach' tz'el t'a Damasco chi', 40 nok' camello kuchjinak silab' chi'. Ayik ix k'och winh t'a yichanh winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh ha chekab' aj Ben-adad sreyal Siria, ha winh tzin chekankoti yik tzul hin k'anb'an t'ayach, tom olto b'oxok sk'o'ol winh yuj jun yahelal ayoch t'ay, mato manhxo, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ixik, tzalan t'a winh to ol b'oxok sk'o'ol winh yuj jun yahelal chi', palta ix yal Jehová to ol chamxonhej winh, xchi winh.
Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ix te och k'elan winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a sat winhaj Hazael chi', masanto ix k'ixwi winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix ok'k'e winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj Hazael chi' t'a winh: --Mamin ¿tas yuj tzach ok'i? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi': --Wojtak wal to ol ak' wal chukal t'a heb' wetisraelal, ol ak'och sk'ak'al scuartel heb', ol ha milancham heb' kelemtak t'a owal. Ol ha milancham heb' kotak unin, ol ha tekanelta yol sk'o'ol heb' ix yab'ix, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Hazael t'a winh icha tik: --Ha hin tik te malaj jab'ok welk'ochi, lajan hin icha junok nok' tz'i'. ¿Tas wal ol aj hin k'ulan tas icha chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh: --Toxo ix yal Jehová t'ayin to ha hach ol hach ochkan sreyalok Siria tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix spukan sb'a winhaj Hazael chi' yet' winhaj Eliseo chi', ix meltzaj winh t'a winh yajalil chi'. Ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Hazael chi' icha tik: --Ix yal winh t'ayin tob' ol hach b'oxok yuj jun ha yahelal tik, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix sch'ayan jun k'apak k'apak pim winhaj Hazael chi', ix b'at yak'anb'at k'apak winh t'a sat winh rey chi', ix tup yik winh. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Hazael chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik oyexo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Josafat yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal chi'. Wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Palta ha' sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh, yujto ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Acab chi' winh yetb'eyumok. Yuj chi', te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol Jehová ix satel Judá, yujto yak'nakkan sti' t'a winhaj rey David schekab' to ol ochnhejkan yinhtilal winh reyal.
Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix yak'an reyal winh, ix yik'el sb'a heb' aj Edom t'a yalanh smandar chonhab' Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' t'a yol yiko'.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' masanil scarruaje yak' owal yet' heb' aj Edom chi' t'a Zair, palta ha heb' aj Edom chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik winh yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a scarruaje winh yik owal. Haxo t'ak'walil ix k'e wan winh, ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' edomita chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skolanel sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb', ha heb' soldado winh chi', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.
Atax ta' ix yikej sb'a heb' aj Edom chi'. Hanheja' pax t'a jun pekti' chi' ix yik'el sb'a chonhab' Libna t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joram chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joram chi', ix mukji sniwanil winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haton t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Ocozías winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik slajchawil ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ocozías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', jun ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Atalía sb'i ix snun winh, yixchikin ix winhaj Omri sreyal Israel.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', ha sb'eyb'al winhaj Acab ix sb'eyb'alej winh, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto smam icham winhaj Acab chi' winh.

Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', junnhej ix yutej spensar winh yet' winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad yet' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, palta ix lajwi winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb' sirio chi'.
Yuj chi' ix k'ochkan winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix echnaj yuj heb' sirio chi'. Ix k'och winhaj Ocozías chi' yil winh yujto ya yaj winh.

Ha winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios, ix yawtej jun winh yetchekab'wumal winh kelemto, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ak' lista ha b'a, tzach b'at t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Ik'b'at jun yet'tal aceite tik tzach b'ati.

Ayik tzach k'och ta', tza sayanek' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi. Tzach och b'aj ayek' winh chi', tzik'anelta winh t'a skal heb' winh ayek' yet' winh ta', tzik'anb'at winh t'a junokxo cuarto.

Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot aceite chi', tza tob'ank'e t'a sjolom winh, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha hin tzach hin sik'kaneli yik ol hach och reyal t'a Israel, xchi, xa chi. Slajwi chi' tza jakan puerta, tzach el lemnajok, manh hach och wa'an, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh kelem schekab' Dios t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh ta', molanek' masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Hach hin capitán, ay wal jab' tas ol wal t'ayach, xchi winh. --¿Mach junok honh b'aj tzal chi'? xchi winhaj Jehú. --Hach hin capitán, ha hach ton tzach wala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e juknaj winhaj Jehú chi', ix och winh t'a yol pat. Ix yak'ank'e aceite winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ha hin tzach hin sik'kaneli, yik ol hach och reyal t'a hin chonhab' Israel.

Ha hach ol ha satel masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, winh ayach t'a yalanh smandar. Icha chi' ol aj hin pakan schamel heb' winh hin chekab' yet' heb' winh tz'alanel hin lolonel, yujto elnak schik'il heb' winh yuj ix Jezabel.

Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi', yowalil ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' winak, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, ol satel heb' t'a chonhab' Israel. Manhxa junok yinhtilal winh chi' olto kanok.
Icha wutejnak yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, icha wutejnakpax yik winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Haxo pax ix Jezabel jun, ha nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at sniwanil ix t'a yol yik Jezreel, manhxalaj mach ol mukan ix, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan masanil juntzanh tik winh schekab' Dios chi', ix sjakan spuerta'il jun pat chi' winh, ix b'at winh elelal.

Ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Jehú chi' b'aj molanek' heb' winh yetyajalil chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi, wach' hama? ¿Tas yuj ix ul hach yil jun winh kistal chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ha hex tik heyojtakxo winh, heyojtak tas syaltaxon heb' winh schekab' Dios chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

--Ma'ay, manh kojtakoklaj, al t'ayonh tas ix ul yal winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha hin tzach hin sik'kanel sreyalok Israel tikne'ik, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junjun heb' winh ix yik'el sjukan pichul, ix slich'anem heb' winh t'a yalanh yok winhaj Jehú b'aj b'akhkiltak sk'e'i. Ix laj spu'an sch'a'ak heb' winh, te cha'anh ix yal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Jehú, reyxo winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, te chuk tas sna'a winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Joram. Ha winhaj Joram chi', aynhejoch winh yet' heb' yetisraelal skolanelta chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria.

Palta ayxo jaye' k'u sk'och winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix lajwi yuj heb' sirio chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hazael chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: Tato t'a wal yel he gana tzin och he reyalok, malaj junok mach tz'el t'a yol chonhab' tik yik wach' malaj mach sb'at halan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh aj Jezreel, xchi winh.
Ix k'e winh t'a yol scarruaje yik owal, ix b'at winh t'a Jezreel b'aj wan yanhtan sb'a winhaj Joram chi'. Aypaxek' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá ta', yujto ayk'och winh yil winhaj Joram chi'.

Ayik ix yilanb'at winh ayk'e t'a cha'anh stanhwej chonhab' Jezreel chi' to wan sjawi winhaj Jehú yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado, ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay juntzanh heb' soldado wan sjawi, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Joram chi' icha tik: --B'atokab' junok winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej, yik b'at yil winh mach jun sjawi chi', sk'anb'anpax t'ay, tom t'a ak'ank'olal sjawi, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at jun winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej chi' yik b'at yil winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankot hin k'anb'ej t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha hach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wu'uj, xchi winh. Haxo ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Ha winh chekab' chi', ix k'och winh b'aj wan sjawi heb' chi', palta malaj winh smeltzaji, xchi winh.

Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix chekjib'at junxo winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej yuj winh rey chi'. Ix k'och winh soldado chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankoti yik tzul hin k'anb'an t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha hach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wu'uj, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Hanheja' junxo winh chi' ix k'och winh t'a heb', palta malaj winh smeltzaji. Ha mach sja t'a yol carruaje chi', ichato ha winhaj Jehú yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, yujto te lokotak skot winh, ichataxon smodo, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Joram chi': --Ak'ekoch nok' chej t'a hin carruaje yik owal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'ochaj scarruaje winhaj Joram sreyal Israel chi' yet' pax yik winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá. Ix b'at heb' winh junjun t'a yol scarruaje chi'. Ix b'at scha'an winhaj Jehú chi' heb' winh. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a lum slu'um winhaj Nabot t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joram chi' to ha winhaj Jehú sk'ochi, ix yalan winh: --Hach Jehú, ¿tom t'a ak'ank'olal tzach jawi? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Tom ijan ak'ank'olal tzin jawi yakb'an ha ix ha nun ix Jezabel, hanheja' yak'anem sb'a ix t'a juntzanh sdiosal yet' t'a yajb'a'alil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joram chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ixto awajkan winh t'a winhaj Ocozías chi': --Ocozías, chamel jun tik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ha winhaj Jehú chi' yet' wal yip winh ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' t'a winhaj Joram chi', awal t'a snanhal yich spatik winh ix ochi, ix k'axpaj t'a spixan winh. Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a yol scarruaje chi', ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winhaj Bidcar, winh skolwaj yet'ok: --Ik'elta winh t'a yol scarruaje chi', tza yumankanb'at winh t'a yol smakb'enkan winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, yujto tzato hin nakoti to ha hach jun wet'nak hach ayik tzak'an honh och t'a spatik scarruaje winhaj Acab smam jun winh tik, ayik yalannakkan jun lolonel tik Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Acab chi' icha tik:

Ha ewi wil schamel winhaj Nabot yet' heb' yuninal. Hanheja' icha wal chi' ol aj wak'an spak t'ayach t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' ik'elta sniwanil winh chi', tza julankanb'at t'a lum slu'umkan winhaj Nabot chi', yujto icha chi' ajnak yalan Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá tas ix uji chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a sb'e'al Bet-hagán, palta ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a spatik winh, ix yalan winh: --Milekpaxcham jun winh tik, xchi winh. Ix yamchaj winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj heb' t'a switzal Gur t'a slak'anil Ibleam. Hata' ix lajwi winh t'a yol scarruaje chi' yuj heb', palta ixto yal yel winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Meguido. Hata' ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh yuj heb' winh schekab' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol jun carruaje. Ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', ix scha'el yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá ayik yuxluchilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Jezreel. Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel tas ix uji chi', ix yak'an uk' stitak sat ix, ix sjixb'an sjolom ix, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a jun wentena.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Jehú t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Wach'am ha k'o'ol? Lajan hach yet' winhaj Zimri, ix ha milcham winh ajalil, xchi ix.
Ix k'e k'elan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a jun wentena chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mach ayoch wet'ok? xchi winh. Ay chawanh oxwanh heb' winh munlajwum t'a yol spat ix, ix elta t'anhan heb' winh yila'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ekek emta jun ix ix chi' t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix yekankot sutnaj ix heb' winh, ix laj och tzipnaj schik'il ix t'a sattak yich pat chi' yet' t'a nok' chej, haxo nok' chej chi' ix ek' t'a yib'anh sniwanil ix chi' yet' scarruaje.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' wa'el. Ayik ix lajwi swa winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ilek tas tzeyutej jun ix ix te chuk chi', yujnhej to yisil ix winh rey, yuj chi' mukchajokab' ix, xchi winh.
Ayik ix b'at heb' winh smuk sniwanil ix yalani, ix yilan heb' winh to haxonhej sb'akil sjolom ix, yok ix yet' sk'ab' ix ayek'i.

Haxo ix paxta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jehú tas yaji, ix yalan winh: --Icha tik ix aj yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, winh schekab' to ha nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at sniwanil ix Jezabel t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ha sniwanil ix chi', stza' nok' nok' ol ajkanb'atok, yuj chi' yalxonhej b'aj ol kan t'a sattak lum lum t'a yol yik Jezreel, malaj mach ol alanok: Ina b'aj mukan ix Jezabel tik, manh xchiok heb', xchi Jehová, xchikan winhaj Elías chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria, ay 70 heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Yuj chi' ix stz'ib'ejb'at jun carta winhaj Jehú t'a heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' t'a heb' winh yilumal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a scarta chi' icha tik:
Ha b'aj ayex chi', hata' ayek' heb' yinhtilal winh he reyal, nok' chej, carruaje yik owal, jun chonhab' te wach' yaji yet' jantak syamk'ab' winh yik owal. Yuj chi' ayik ol k'och jun carta tik t'ayex,
tze sik'el junok yinhtilal winh heyajalil chi' te wach', smoj wal yoch he reyalok sk'exulok winh smam chi', tzeyak'an owal yuj yopisio winh heyajalil chi', xchib'at winh t'a heb' winh.

Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' heb', ix te xiwk'e heb', ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ina tax maj tzak'wan stek'b'an sb'a chawanh heb' winh rey t'a yichanh winh, okonhxo ¿tom ha honh to tik ol yal ko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh winh? xchi heb'.

Haxo winh tz'ilan spalacio winh rey chi' yet' winh sgobernadoral chonhab' chi', masanil heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' yet' pax heb' ix ilan k'ib' heb' yuninal winhaj Acab chi', ix yalb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú chi': Ha honh tik ayonh ek' t'a yol ha k'ab'. Masanil tas ol ala' ol ko k'anab'ajej, manh ol kak'ochlaj junokxo ko reyal. Ujokab' icha tas wach' tz'aj ha na'ani, xchib'at heb'.

Ix stz'ib'anxib'at junxo carta winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: Tato tze nib'ej tzex och wet'ok, ol he k'anab'ajan tas swala', ha k'ik'an tzeyik'kot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh heyajalil chi', tzex jawi t'ayin t'a Jezreel tik, xchib'at winh t'a heb'. Ha heb' 70 yinhtilalkan winh rey chi', junnhej yaj heb' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix ilan k'ib' heb' t'a Samaria chi'.

Ayik ix scha'an jun carta chi' heb', ix syaman heb' 70 yinhtilal winh rey chi' heb', ix xikji'el sjolom heb' yuj heb'. Ix yak'anem sjolom heb' chi' heb' t'a yol juntzanh mo'och, ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winhaj Jehú t'a Jezreel chi'.

Ix jawi jun winh chekab' t'a winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Toxo ix ik'chajkot sjolom heb' yinhtilal winh rey, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Chab' juyanh tzeyutejkan t'a sti' chonhab' tik. Hata' skani masanto k'ik'an, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi', ix och linhan winh t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' anima: --Ha hex tik, malaj he mul. Ha hin ix hin milcham winh ko reyal yuj wik'anel winh t'a yopisio, palta ¿mach ix milancham masanil juntzanh heb' tik?

Ha tikne'ik scham wal heyojtakaneli to ha masanil tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a yib'anh heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, malaj junok manh ol elk'ochok. Wan yelk'och masanil tas scheknak Jehová yalkanel winhaj Elías schekab', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', ix smilcham juntzanh sk'ab' yok winhaj Acab chi' winh t'a Jezreel, haton heb' niwak winak yaji yet' heb' yamigo winhaj Acab chi' yet' heb' yak'nakoch winh sacerdote'al. Manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria. Ayik wan sb'at winh chi' t'a yol b'e, ix k'och winh t'a jun b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel.

Hata' ix schalaj sb'a winh yet' juntzanh heb' sk'ab' yok winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá, ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb': --¿Mach hex ha hex tik? xchi winh t'a heb'. Ix tak'wi heb' t'a winh: --Ha honh tik ayto ku'uj ko b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, honh jawi kak' stzatzil sk'o'ol heb' winh yuninal winh rey yet' heb' yune' ix reina Jezabel, xchi heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: --Yamec heb', xchi winh. Haxo heb' ajun yet' winh chi' ix yaman heb', ix smilancham heb' winh t'a sti' jun ha' uk'b'il ha' skuch Bet-equed b'aj tz'ajtaxon heb' tanhwum kalnel chi'. 42 heb' t'a smasanil, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.

Ayik ix helxi winhaj Jehú chi' ta', ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winhaj Jonadab yuninal winhaj Recab. Ix yak'an stzatzil sk'o'ol winh winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mek'an hach am wet'ok, icha hin tik wach' hin na'an t'a ha patik? xchi winh. --I', wach' toni, xchi winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh. --Tato icha chi' an, ak'kot ha k'ab' t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh. Ix yak'anb'at sk'ab' winhaj Jonadab chi' t'a winh, ix yik'ank'e winh winh t'a yol scarruaje chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Konh wet'ok, ol hin ch'ox ila' tas ol wutej yik tzin k'anab'ajej tas ix yal Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Jonadab chi' winh t'a yol scarruaje chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Samaria, ix smilancham masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab winh ta', haton heb' pitzanto ix kani. Yuj chi' pilan ix satel heb' smasanil yuj winh, icha ajnak yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil chonhab' winhaj Jehú chi', ix yalan winh: --Ha winhaj Acab, kennhej ochnak winh ejmelal t'a Baal, ha hinxo pax tik, ek'b'alto ol hin och ejmelal t'a Baal chi'.

Yuj chi' awtejek masanil heb' winh schekab' Baal yet' mach tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'ay yet' masanil heb' sacerdote yaj t'ay. Manhxa junok mach max jawi, yujto ol hin b'o jun niwan silab' yuj wik'ancha'anh Baal chi'. Ha mach max jawi, yowalil tz'och chamel t'a yib'anh, xchi winh. Palta tonhej ix yal jun chi' winh, masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ol satel winh.
Yuj chi' ix schek winh alchajeli to ol och k'inh yik tz'ik'jicha'anh Baal chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'anb'at schekab' winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en Israel to yowalil sk'och masanil heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal t'a stemplo. Yuj chi' manhxa junok mach maj k'ochok. Ha templo yik Baal chi', te b'ut'an ix aji.
Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' molum pichul to tz'ik'ji'elta spichul heb' tz'ochtaxon ejmelal t'a Baal, ix sk'anab'ajej heb' yik'anelta.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och winh yet' winhaj Jonadab t'a yol templo chi', ix yalan winh t'a heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi': --Scham heyilani to malajokab' heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová ayek' t'a he kal tik, anhejokab' mach tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal ayek'i, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ayik toxo ix och heb' tz'och ejmelal t'a Baal chi' t'a yol stemplo chi', ix yak'an silab' heb' snhusji yet' juntzanhxo silab'. Yakb'an wan yak'an silab' heb' chi', ayxo och hoyan 80 heb' soldado yuj winhaj Jehú t'a spatik templo chi', ix yalkan winh t'a heb' to malaj junok mach scha'el heb': --Tato ay junok mach scha'anel junok heb' ayoch ejmelal chi', haxo scham sk'exulok, xchi winh.

Ayik ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' soldado yet' t'a heb' capitán: --Ochanhek, milekcham heb'. Manhxa junok mach tze cha'eli, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix och heb' soldado winh chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' anima chi' heb' t'a k'e'en espada. Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anelta heb' chamnak chi' heb' t'a spatikel templo chi'. Ix och heb' t'a yet'tal Baal t'a yol templo chi'.
Masanil juntzanh yechel ix yik'elta heb', ix snhusantz'a heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel Baal chi' heb'. Ix sjuanem lanhnaj templo chi' heb' smasanil, yikxo b'aj schulaj anima ix ajnhejkani.
Icha chi' ix aj satanel ejmelal winhaj Jehú t'a Baal t'a kal chonhab' Israel.

Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winhaj Jehú chi', palta maj yik'el-laj sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Maj satel-laj juntzanh yechel wakax winh, haton juntzanh nab'a oro aykan t'a Dan yet' t'a Betel.

Ix yalan Jehová t'a winh: Yujto tojol tas ix ha k'ulej t'a wichanh, ix ha k'anab'ajej ha satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi' icha wal ix aj walani, ha heb' inhtilal, ol ochnhej heb' reyal masanto t'a schanhil makan, xchi t'a winh.

Wach'chom icha chi', palta maj yak'waloch winh t'a sk'o'ol sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal Israel, yujto maj yik'el sb'a winh t'a chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix och ijan Jehová yik'anek' lum slu'um heb' israel. Ha winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ix ik'anek' lum t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton lum yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, lum yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' lum yik nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ix kotnhej t'a chonhab' Aroer t'a sti' ha' Arnón tz'ek' t'a Galaad masanto t'a Basán.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jehú yet' tas ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Ha winhaj Jehú chi', 28 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a heb' yetisraelal t'a Samaria. Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria chi', haxo jun winh yuninal winh skuchan Joacaz ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winh yune' ix, haton winhaj rey Ocozías, ix schekan ix satji'el masanil heb' yinhtilal winh rey chi'.

Haxo ix Josaba, yisilkan winhaj rey Joram, schab'il yanab' winhaj rey Ocozías chi', ha' ix ix ik'ankanel winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a skal heb' yuninal winh wan smiljicham chi'. Icha chi' ix aj sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at sk'ub'ejel winh ix yet' jun ix tz'ilan k'ib' winh t'a jun cuarto b'aj ay juntzanh ch'at sik'an, yuj chi' maj miljokcham winhaj Joás chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'ub'chajel winh yet' ix tz'ilank'ib' chi' t'a stemplo Jehová, wake' ab'il ix kan winh ta', yakb'an ayoch ix Atalía yajalil t'a Judá chi'.

Haxo t'a yukil ab'il, ha winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada yetb'eyum ix Josaba chi', ix schek winh awtaj heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo yet' heb' stanhwan spalacio winh rey. Ha winh ix ak'anoch heb' t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Hata' ix schek winh yak' sti' heb' yik tz'och heb' yet' winh t'a tas nab'il yuj. Ixlajwi chi' ix ch'oxji'och winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías chi' t'a heb'.
Elanhchamel ix yal winh t'a heb': Haton tik ol he k'ulok: Ay hex mach hex ol hex ochkan he tanhwej spalacio winh rey t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip,
ayex pax mach hex ol he tanhwej spuerta'il yik Shur, hanhejtona' ayex mach hex ol he tanhwej spuerta'il spat heb' stanhwan winh rey. Icha chi' ol aj he kannhej he tanhwej yik malaj mach sk'och ta'.
Ha hexxo tzex elkan t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip chi' jun, cha makan tzeyutej he b'a he tanhwan stemplo Jehová t'a stz'eytak winh rey.

Tzex och hoyan t'a spatiktak b'aj ay winh chi', junjun heb' yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal. Yalnhej mach tz'och t'a he kal b'aj tzolan hex och chi', tojolnhej schami. Yalnhej b'ajtil sb'at winh rey chi', tzex b'at yet' winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej heb' capitán chi' tastak ix yal winhaj Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' ix yak'och soldado heb', heb' tz'och stanhwej t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, ix k'och heb' t'a yichanh winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an k'e'en lanza winh yet' k'e'en smaklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' capitán chi', haton k'e'en aykan yuj winhaj rey David t'a yol stemplo Jehová chi'.
Ix och hoyan heb' soldado chi' stanhwan t'a yamak'il templo yet' t'a spatiktak altar yet' t'a spatik yichanh winh rey chi'. Junjun heb', yet'nak syamk'ab' heb' yik owal.

Ix yik'anelta winh yuninal winh rey chi' winhaj Joiada chi', ix yak'ank'e corona winh t'a sjolom winh, ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios winh t'a winh. Ix stob'ank'e aceite winh t'a sjolom winh unin chi', ix yalan winh to reyxo winh. Ixlajwi chi', masanil heb' ix stz'it sk'ab', ix syamanoch heb' yawaji: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko reyal, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía yel yaw heb' winh soldado yet' heb' anima chi' yek'i, ix jawi ix t'a stemplo Jehová b'aj ayek' heb' anima smasanil.

Haxo ix yilan ix ayek' winh rey chi', linhanoch winh t'a stz'ey jun oy t'a amak' chi', ichataxon sb'eyb'al heb'. Ha t'a stz'eytak winh rey chi' ayek' heb' yajal yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch sonal heb' sb'itani. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb', spu'an sch'a'ak heb'. Yuj chi' ix snhik'chitejb'at spichul ix, ix el yaw ix: --Pechum hex el yajal ha hex tik. Pechum hex el yajal, xchi ix.

Ix yalan winhaj sacerdote Joiada t'a heb' yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ik'ekel ix ha hex tzolan hex ek' chi'. Ha mach tz'och tzak'an yuj ix miljokab'chamok, xchi winh. Yujto toxo ix yal winh sacerdote chi' to max yal-laj smiljicham ix t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix ik'ji'elta ix t'a skal heb' chi', ix ik'chajb'at ix b'aj tz'ochk'och sb'e heb' ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej sk'och t'a spalacio winh rey. Hata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' to sb'okan junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová. Ix yalanpax winh to ayokab' junok strato winh rey yet' heb' chonhab' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smak'anem lanhnaj stemplo Baal heb', ix smak'anpoj juntzanh altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel. Ix mak'jipaxcham winhaj Matán, sacerdote yaj t'a Baal chi' t'a yichanh juntzanh altar chi'. Ix yak'anoch stanhwumal stemplo Jehová winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ix elta heb' yajalil soldado, heb' quereteo, haton heb' stanhwan winh rey chi' yet' masanil anima. Yaman ix aj yel heb' yet' winh rey t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová, masanto ix k'och heb' t'a palacio. Ha t'a spuerta'il b'aj ayek' heb' stanhwan palacio chi' ix k'och heb', ix em k'ojan winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a yol sk'ojnub' heb' rey.
Masanil heb' anima, ix tzalajk'e heb', yujto ha ix Atalía toxo ix miljicham ix t'a sti' palacio chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan jun chonhab' chi' t'a junk'olal.
Uke' ab'il sk'inal winhaj rey Joás chi' ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá.
Ayik ukexo ab'il yoch winhaj Jehú reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Joás chi' reyal t'a Judá. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ix k'ayb'aj winh yuj winhaj sacerdote Joiada.
Palta ha b'aj syak'em sb'a anima t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ixto yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan incienso heb' ta'.

Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj rey Joás chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote: --Molek k'e'en tumin yet' k'e'en ofrenda tz'ik'jikot t'a stemplo Jehová, k'e'en yowalil syak' junjun anima yet' jantak k'e'en ofrenda tonhej tz'el t'a sk'o'ol heb' yak'ani. Junjun hex ol heyak' k'e'en tumin ol he cha chi' yuj sb'oji templo, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Palta ayik ix el 23 ab'il yoch winh reyal chi', manta jab'ok stemplo Jehová chi' sb'o heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj Joiada yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote yuj winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh: --¿Tas yuj manta jab'ok templo tik tze b'o'o? Ha tikne'ik t'a kichanhb'at tik, manhxo'ok hex laj ol he cha k'e'en tumin t'a heb' anima tik. Ha jantak k'e'en tumin ol ak'jok, yowalil skan k'e'en yik sb'oji templo chi', xchi winh.
Ix scha sk'o'ol heb' winh sacerdote chi' to manhxo'oklaj heb' winh scha'an k'e'en tumin chi', manhxa paxlaj yalan yik heb' winh sb'o'an stemplo Jehová chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'kot jun kaxa winhaj Joiada chi', ix yolan smakul te' winh, ix yak'ankan te' winh t'a slak'anil altar t'a stojolal swach' mach tz'och t'a yol templo chi'. Haton ta' syak'em k'e'en tumin heb' winh sacerdote stanhwan sti' templo scha t'a heb' anima sk'och t'a templo chi'.

Ayik syilan heb' winh to niwanxo k'e'en tumin chi' ay t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sk'och jun winh stz'ib'um winh rey yet' winh sat sacerdote chi', sb'isan k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh. Slajwi chi' syak'anem k'e'en heb' winh t'a yol juntzanh mukuk.

Ayik slajwi sb'isan k'e'en chi' heb' winh, syak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilumalok munlajel tas tz'aj sb'oxi templo chi', yik stupchaj heb' winh snhikan te te', heb' winh tz'ilan sb'o munlajel chi',

heb' winh albañil yet' heb' winh b'o'um k'e'en. Ix manchaj pax te te' yet' k'e'en k'e'en mak'b'ilpojok yik tz'och t'a munlajel chi'. Sk'anchajpax k'e'en tumin chi' t'a juntzanhxo tas smanchaj yuj munlajel chi'.

Ha k'e'en tumin syik'b'at heb' t'a templo chi', max k'anchajlaj k'e'en yik sb'ochaj juntzanh waso, pultu, k'e'en ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil, k'e'en niwak uk'ab' yet' trompeta yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro yet' plata.
Palta ha masanil k'e'en tumin chi', ha t'a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh yilan munlajel yik sb'oji stemplo Jehová chi', ha t'a heb' winh tz'ak'ji k'e'en.
Maj ch'olb'itaj smunlajel heb' winh scha'an k'e'en tumin chi', yik slaj stupan heb' winh munlajwum heb' winh, yujto te tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'o'ani.
Haxo pax k'e'en tumin tz'ak'ji yuj spakok mul yet' silab' tz'ak'chaj yuj stupchaj mul, max ak'jilaj k'e'en t'a templo chi', yujto yik heb' winh sacerdote yaj k'e'en.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria, ix jawi winh yak' owal t'a chonhab' Gat, ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh, ix lajwi chi' ix kot winh t'a sb'e'al Jerusalén yak' owal.

Ha winhaj Joás sreyal Judá, ix smolb'ej jantak tas yak'nak heb' smam yicham winh t'a stemplo Jehová, haton winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram yet' winhaj Ocozías. Ix smolb'anpax juntzanh tas yak'nak winh t'a templo chi' yet' masanil k'e'en oro ayxo ek' ta' yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalacio winh. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winhaj Hazael chi', yuj chi' majxo yak'laj owal chi' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás yet' masanil tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winhaj Joás chi', ix smol halan heb' winh t'a spatik winh. Ix smilancham winh heb' winh t'a jun pat b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan t'a ti' b'e tz'emta t'a Sila.

Ha heb' winh ix milancham winh chi', haton winhaj Josacar yuninal winhaj Simat yet' winhaj Jozabad yuninal winhaj Somer. Ayik ix cham winh chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David. Haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amasías ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 23 ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Ocozías reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Joacaz yuninal winhaj Jehú yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 17 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj wal chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a heb' israel chi', niwan tiempo ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria yet' pax t'a yol sk'ab' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Ben-adad.
Yuj chi' ix lesalwi winhaj Joacaz chi' t'a Jehová, ix ab'chaj slesal winh chi', yujto ix yil Jehová tas wal tz'utaj heb' israel yuj winh sreyal Siria chi',
yuj chi' ix ak'ji jun mach skolwaj t'a heb' yuj Jehová chi'. Icha chi' ix aj yel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sirio chi', ix kanxi heb' t'a junk'olal, ichataxon yajek' heb' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Palta maj yaktejkanlaj heb' sb'eyb'alan juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam winh kuchb'annak heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Ix k'enhejcha'anh heb' yet' jun chukal chi', hanheja' ayek' jun yechel Asera t'a Samaria chi'.

Ha heb' soldado winhaj Joacaz chi', kenxonhej sb'isul heb', yujto ha winh sreyal Siria ix satanel heb'. 50-xonhej heb' sk'e t'a yib'anh chej, lajunhe' carruaje yik owal yet' 10 mil soldado sb'ey t'a yok ayek'i.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Joacaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a Samaria. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Joás winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 37 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix scha'el yich winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.

Ayik manto cham winhaj Joás sreyal Israel chi', ix xit'ek' winh yil winhaj Eliseo ayik te pena'ay winhaj Eliseo chi' yuj jun yab'il ix ik'an schami. Yuj chi' ix ok'k'e winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh, ix och lak'naj winh t'a winh, ix yalan winh rey chi': --Ay mamin, lajan hach icha nok' chej yet' carruaje yik owal t'ayonh israel honh tik, yujto tzach kolwajnhej t'ayonh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ik'kot junok ha jul-lab' yet' jaye'ok sjul-lab'il, xchi winh. Ix yik'ankot winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Jak wentena t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Ix sjakan winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': B'o'och ha jul-lab' chi' yik ol hach julwajok, xchi winh. Yakb'an yamb'il te' yuj winh rey chi', ix yak'anoch sk'ab' winhaj Eliseo t'a yib'anh sk'ab' winh rey chi'. --Julwajanh an, xchi winh. Ix julwajb'at winh rey chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha ha jul-lab' tik sch'oxanel skolwal Jehová t'a schonhab' to ol ak' ganar heb' sirio t'a Afec, ol ha satanel heb' smasanil, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Eliseo chi' t'a winh rey chi': --Yam juntzanh ha jul-lab', xchi winh. Ayik ix syaman sjul-lab' winh chi', ix yalan winhaj Eliseo chi': --Ha tikne'ik, tekub'tanhejem t'a sat lu'um, xchi winh. Yuj chi' oxel ix stekem winh rey chi', ix och wa'an winh.

Ix kot yowal winhaj Eliseo chi', ix yalan winh: --Oktom ix ha tekem o'el wakelok, tato icha chi', icham chi' ol aj ha satanel heb' sirio chi' smasanil. Okxo jun, oxelnhej ol ak' ganar heb', xchi winh.
Ix cham winhaj Eliseo chi', ix mukchaj winh. Junjun ab'il tzulnhejek' heb' moabita elk'al t'a yol smakb'en heb' israel.

Ha jun'el, ix b'at juntzanh heb' israel smuk jun chamnak. Ayik wan sk'och heb' b'aj ol smuk chi', ix yilan heb' sjawi heb' elk'um chi', toxonhej ix syumkanoch jun chamnak chi' heb' b'aj mukan winhaj Eliseo chi', ix b'at heb' elelal. Ayik ix och tennaj jun chamnak chi' t'a sb'akil winhaj Eliseo chi', ix pitzwixi, ix k'ex linhan.
Ix te ixtaj wal heb' israel yuj winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria ayik pitzanto winhaj rey Joacaz.

Palta ix yak' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a heb', ix ok' sk'o'ol t'a heb' yujnhej strato yet' winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob. Yuj chi' maj schalaj satji'el heb', maj yik'el-laj heb' t'a yichanh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria chi', haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Ben-adad ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Yuj chi', ha winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz ix ik'anxikanek' juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winhaj Hazael t'a winhaj rey Joacaz ayik ix yak'an owal heb'. Oxel ix ak'ji ganar winhaj Ben-adad yuj winhaj Joás chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh skolanxikan juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ayik schab'ilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Amasías chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Joadán sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, palta maj k'ochlaj icha sk'ulejnak winhaj David, haton smam yicham winh. Ha sb'eyb'al winhaj Joás winh smam winh ix sb'eyb'alej.
Ha juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima ta', ix snhusanpax incienso heb'.
Ayik ix yik'an wal yip yopisio winhaj Amasías chi', ix smilcham heb' winh ay yopisio winh, haton heb' winh miljinak cham winh smam winh.

Palta maj smilchamlaj heb' yuninal heb' winh ix cham chi' winh, yujto tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a ley Moisés, b'aj syalkan Jehová icha tik: Ha heb' mamab'il, max yal-laj scham heb' yuj smul yuninal, hanhejtona' heb' uninab'il, max yalpax scham heb' yuj smul smam, palta junjun mach scham yuj smul, xchi Jehová.
Ix smilpaxcham 10 mil heb' edomita winhaj Amasías t'a owal t'a lum Spanhanil Atz'am Atz'am. Ix yak'pax ganar chonhab' Sela winh, ix yak'ankan skuch winh Jocteel, haton chi' ix sb'i'ejkani.
Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' schekab' winh t'a winhaj Joás sreyal Israel, yuninal winhaj Joacaz yixchikin winhaj Jehú. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Kotanh, kak' owal, xchib'at winh.

Palta ix yak'anb'at spak winhaj Joás chi' icha tik: Ay jun te' sak k'i'ix, ix yalb'at te' t'a te' k'ute' ay t'a Líbano: Ak' ix isil yetb'eyumok winh wunin, xchi te'. Palta haxo nok' chi'um nok' ix ek' ta', ix stek'anem lat'an te' sak k'i'ix chi' nok'.

Yel ix ak' ganar heb' edomita chi', yuj chi' tzik'walcha'anh ha b'a tikne'ik. Wach' toni, ik'cha'anh ha b'a t'a ha pat. Tato tza nib'ej ak' owal wet'ok, ha jun chi' tonhej ol kot t'a ib'anh yuj yet' t'a yib'anh Judá, xchib'at winh.
Palta maj schalaj yab' juntzanh chi' winhaj Amasías chi'. Yuj chi' ix kot winhaj Joás chi' yak' owal yet' winh, ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a Bet-semes t'a yol yik Judá.
Ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Judá chi' yuj heb' soldado yik Israel, toxonhej ix el lemnaj heb', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ix yamchaj winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá chi' yuj winhaj Joás chi' t'a Bet-semes chi', ix ik'jik'e winh t'a Jerusalén yuj winh. Ix sjuanem 180 metro smuro'al chonhab' chi' heb' soldado, ix b'at t'a puerta yik heb' aj Efraín masanto t'a spuerta'il schikin.

Ix yik'anpax masanil k'e'en oro winhaj Joás chi', k'e'en plata yet' pax masanil tastak ay t'a stemplo Jehová yet' masanil tas ay t'a spalacio winhaj rey Amasías chi'. Ay pax juntzanh anima ix yik'b'at winh t'a Samaria yik tz'ak'ji pural winhaj Amasías chi' yoch junk'olal yet' winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' tas ix aj yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Joás chi', ix mukji winh t'a Samaria b'aj mukan juntzanhxo heb' winh sreyal Israel. Haxo winhaj Jeroboam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás sreyal Judá chi', 15 ab'ilto ix kan winh ayik ix cham winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amasías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.

Ay juntzanh heb' winh ay t'a Jerusalén ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Amasías chi', yuj chi' ix b'at winh elelal t'a Laquis. Palta ix ochnhej heb' winh t'a spatik winh, yuj chi' hata' ix cham winh yuj heb' winh.
Ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a yib'anh chej, ix mukji winh t'a Jerusalén b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj David.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá ix ak'anoch winhaj Azarías reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. 16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'.
Ayik ayxo och winh reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi', ix yik'anxi'ek' chonhab' Elat winh, ix sb'o'anxik'e winh.
Ayik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás yak'an reyal t'a Israel, 41 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Palta te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha winhaj Jeroboam chi' ix ik'anxi'ek' b'aj tz'ek'taxon smojonal smakb'en Israel, sb'atnhej b'aj tz'ochk'och b'e t'a Hamat masanto t'a ha' mar yik Arabá, icha aj yalannakkan Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a winhaj Jonás schekab', haton winh yuninal winhaj Amitai aj Gat-hefer.
Yujto ix yil Jehová to te ya tz'ek' heb' israel smasanil, malaj wal junok mach skolwaj yet' heb'.
Yuj chi' ha winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Joás ix yak'lab'ej Jehová skolan heb', yujto malaj t'a spensar Jehová satanel schonhab' t'a jun'elnhej.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jeroboam chi', tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak owal ix yak' winh ayik ix yik'anxi'ek' juntzanh chonhab' winh t'a Judá, haton Damasco yet' Hamat, masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jeroboam chi', ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' winh sreyal Israel, haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 27 ab'il yoch winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, hata' ix scha'el yich winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Amasías yak'an reyal t'a Judá.
16 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Azarías chi' wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.
Palta ha juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima, ix snhusanpax incienso heb' ta'.

Ix yak'och jun yab'il skuch lepra Jehová t'a winh rey chi' masanto ix cham winh. Yuj chi', majxo ajlaj winh rey chi' t'a spalacio, ch'ok patil b'aj ix ajek' winh. Haxo winhaj Jotam, winh yuninal winh, ha' winh ix och yilumalok spalacio winh chi', ix yak'anpax yajalil winh t'a Judá chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Azarías yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a schonhab'kan winhaj rey David t'a slak'anil b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham, haxo winhaj Jotam winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 38 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Jeroboam reyal t'a Israel, wake' ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Haxo winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Jabes ix och ajk'olal t'a winh, ix b'at juknaj winh t'a winhaj Zacarías chi', ix smilancham winh winh t'a yichanh heb' chonhab'. Haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Zacarías chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj Jehú, ayik yalannak to ha heb' yinhtilal winh, ol ochnhej heb' reyal t'a Israel masanto t'a schanhil makan yinhtilal chi'.
Ha winhaj Salum chi', ix scha'el yich winh yak'an reyal ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, palta junnhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Haxo winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi ix kot yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Tirsa, ix yak'an owal heb' winh t'a chonhab' Tifsa. Ix smilancham masanil heb' anima heb' winh ta' yet' masanil anima ay t'a yol smakb'en Tifsa chi'. Ix tekji'elta yol sk'o'ol heb' ix yab'ix yuj heb' winh. Masanil tas ay ta', ix yik'b'at heb' winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' winh yujto maj chaji'och heb' winh yuj heb' aj chonhab' chi' t'a yol schonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och winhaj Manahem chi' t'a Samaria yak' owal yet' winhaj Salum chi'. Ayik ix lajwi smilancham winhaj Salum chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Salum chi' yet' tas ix aj yoch winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Zacarías, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Manahem yuninal winhaj Gadi yak'an reyal t'a Israel. 10 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.

Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, yujto ha chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annak b'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha t'a stiempo'al ayoch winhaj Manahem reyal chi',
ix jawi winhaj Pul sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a Israel chi'. Yuj chi' 750 quintal k'e'en plata ix yak' winh t'a winhaj Pul chi' yik tz'och winh yet' winh yik wach' skannhej winh t'a yopisio.

Ix yak'och 50 siclo k'e'en plata winhaj Manahem chi' t'a yib'anh junjun heb' b'eyum t'a yol smakb'en Israel chi', yik syal stupan k'e'en tumin syak' winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smeltzaj winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a schonhab', majxo ochlaj wa'an winh t'a yol yik Israel chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manahem yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ixlajwi chi' ix cham winh, haxo winhaj Pekaía winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 50 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Pekaía yuninal winhaj Manahem reyal t'a Israel. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Palta ha winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yajal heb' winh soldado winhaj Pekaía chi', ix och winh ajk'olal t'a winhaj Pekaía chi', ix yak'anoch sb'a 50 heb' winak aj Galaad yet' winh. Ix miljicham winhaj Pekaía chi' yuj heb' winh t'a scuartel t'a yol spalacio t'a Samaria yet' winhaj Argob yet' winhaj Arie. Haxo winhaj Peka chi' ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Pekaía chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik 52 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel. 20 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha juntzanh chukal sk'ulejnak winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ha t'a stiempo'al ayoch winhaj Peka reyal t'a Israel chi', hata' ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, ix ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' tik yuj winh: Haton Ijón, Abel-bet-maaca, Janoa, Cedes, Hazor, Galaad, Galilea yet' masanil yol yik Neftalí. Masanil heb' kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' icha preso t'a Asiria chi'.

Ayik 20 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá, ha winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och ajk'olal t'a winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías chi', ix smilancham winhaj Peka chi' winh, haxo winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Peka yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Ayik schab'il ab'il yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix och winhaj Jotam yuninal winhaj Azarías reyal t'a Judá.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj Azarías smam winh.
Ix sb'o'okh spuerta'il stemplo Jehová winh t'a yib'anh, palta ha juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, maj yik'el-laj winh, ix yak'nhej silab' heb' anima yet' snhusan incienso heb' ta'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Jotam yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi' ix och ijan Jehová yak'ankot winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías yak' owal yet' Judá chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Jotam chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David, winh smam yicham winh. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 17 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías reyal t'a Israel, ix scha'anel yich winhaj Acaz yuninal winhaj Jotam yak'an reyal t'a Judá.

Ayxo 20 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal chi'. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sb'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Anhej sb'eyb'al juntzanh heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix snhustz'a yuninal winh silab'il. Lajan wal ix sk'ulej winh icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación ik'b'ilel yuj Jehová ayik yochnak heb' israel t'a lu'um tik.
Hanhejtona' ix yak' silab' winh, ix snhusanpax incienso winh t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal t'a jolomtak witz yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winhaj Rezín sreyal Siria yet' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel, ix k'och heb' winh t'a Jerusalén yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winhaj rey Acaz chi'. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', palta maj yak'laj ganar heb' winh.

Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winh sreyal Edom ix ak'an ganar chonhab' Elat, ix ochkan yikok Edom chi'. Ha heb' aj Judá kajan ta', ix pechji'el heb' yuj winh, haxo heb' aj Edom chi' ix kannhej kajan ta'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at jaywanh heb' schekab' winhaj Acaz t'a winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria, yik sb'at alchaj t'a winh icha tik: Swak'och hin b'a t'a yol ha k'ab'. Yuj chi' kotanh yuj tzul hin ha kolan t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria yet' winh sreyal Israel, yujto wan yak'an owal heb' winh wet'ok, xchi b'at winh.
Yuj chi', ha winhaj Acaz chi', ix yik'elta k'e'en plata winh yet' k'e'en oro t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'e'en ay t'a spalacio winh, ix si'anb'at k'e'en winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix sk'anab'ajej winh sreyal Asiria chi' tas ix yal winhaj Acaz chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh yet' heb' soldado yak' owal t'a Damasco. Ix yak'an ganar jun chonhab' chi' winh. Ha heb' kajan ta', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh t'a Quir. Ix smilanpaxcham winhaj Rezín chi' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco scha winhaj Tiglat-pileser chi'. Hata' ix yil jun altar winh, ix stz'ib'anb'at yechel jun altar chi' winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Urías t'a Jerusalén.
Icha chi' ix aj sb'o'ank'e jun altar winhaj sacerdote Urías chi', lajan ix aj icha yechel ix yak'kot winhaj rey Acaz t'a Damasco chi'. Wach'xo yaji ayik ix jax winhaj Acaz chi' t'a Jerusalén.
Ayik ix jax winh t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yilan jun altar chi' winh, ix snitzanoch sb'a winh t'a stz'ey yik snhusantz'a silab' winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'an nok' silab' winh stz'a smasanil yet' ofrenda yet' tas swaji. Ix sekanpaxem wino winh t'a yib'anh altar chi' t'a ofrenda'il. Ix stzikanpaxoch schik'il nok' silab' yik junk'olal winh t'a spatiktak altar chi'.
Haxo pax altar bronce ay t'a yichanh stemplo Jehová, ix yik'el winh t'a skal jun ak' altar chi' yet' stemplo Jehová chi', ix yak'an kan winh t'a stojolal snorte'al jun ak' altar chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh t'a winhaj sacerdote Urías chi' icha tik: Ha tikne'ik ha masanil nok' silab' tz'ak'ji t'a k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil yet' ofrenda t'a tas swaji yet' wino, anhej t'a yib'anh jun ak' altar tik tz'ak'ji. Hanheja' juntzanhxo silab' syak' heb' chonhab' yet' wik ha hin tik, ha t'a yib'anh jun altar chi' stz'a'i. Stzikchajpaxoch schik'il nok' silab' chi' t'a spatiktak. Palta haxo jun altar bronce chi', wik tz'ajkani yik hata' tzin k'anb'ej hin b'a t'a Jehová.
Ix sk'anab'ajej winhaj Urías chi' icha wal ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix schekan winh rey chi' ik'chajel yol sat smarco'al juntzanh carreta nab'a bronce t'a templo. Ix ik'chajpaxel palangana ayem t'a yib'anh. Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en yechel mam wakax nab'a bronce ayoch t'a yalanh jun niwan pila, haxo t'a yib'anh k'e'en k'e'en t'a sat lu'um ix yak'kanem winh.

Yik wach' skan winh t'a sat winh sreyal Asiria chi', yuj chi' ix yik'el jun yet'tal b'aj skan heb' rey t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip winh t'a stemplo Jehová yet' spuerta'il ay t'a spatikeli, haton b'aj tz'och winh rey t'a templo chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Acaz yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab'kan winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 12 ab'il yoch winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela ix och reyal t'a Israel, b'alunhe' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Samaria.
Chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, wach'chom maj k'och ijan icha schukal juntzanh heb' winh rey ek'nak t'a Israel chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ha winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria, ix yak' owal winh yet' winhaj Oseas chi'. Ix kan winhaj Oseas chi' t'a yalanh smandar winh, ix yak'an k'e'en tumin winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a junjun ab'il.

Palta ix yaktej winhaj Oseas chi' yak'an k'e'en tumin chi', ix schekanb'at schekab' winh t'a winhaj So sreyal Egipto yik skolwaj winh yet' winh yik tz'el winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' ha winhaj rey Salmanasar ix yaman winhaj Oseas chi', ix yak'anoch winh winh t'a preso.
Ix lajwinhej chi', ix syamanoch winh yik'anek' masanil smakb'en Israel chi'. Oxe' ab'il ix yoymitej chonhab' Samaria winh.

Haxo ix aji, ha t'a sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas chi' reyal, ix ak'ji ganar Samaria yuj winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria chi'. Yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at masanil heb' israel t'a preso. Haxo t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' yik heb' medo, ix ak'jib'at heb' yuj winh.

Icha chi' ix aj skot jun chi' t'a yib'anh heb' israel chi', yujto ix och wal smul heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal. Ha Jehová chi' ik'jinakelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Ochnak heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
sb'eyb'alannak sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación heb', haton juntzanh yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh heb' yet' juntzanh b'eyb'al b'aj ix kuchb'aj heb' yuj juntzanh heb' winh sreyal.

Elk'altak ix sk'ulej juntzanh tas manh wach'ok heb' t'a yichanh Jehová sDiosal, ix sb'o'ank'e juntzanh lugar cha'anh heb' t'a junjun niwak chonhab' yet' t'a junjun cuartel, yik b'aj tz'och heb' ejmelal.

Ix sb'o'anpaxk'e k'e'en k'e'en heb' yik syal sb'a heb' t'ay, ix sb'o'anpax te te' heb' yik yechel jun sdiosal heb' skuch Asera. Ha t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a yich te te' k'ayum xi'il sb'o juntzanh chi' heb'.
Hata' ix snhus incienso heb' icha wal sb'eyb'al juntzanh nación yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh heb'. Ix stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová chi' heb'.
Ix och heb' ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, haton wal juntzanh yalnak Jehová to ay yowalil yoch heb' ejmelal t'ay.

Ix schek Jehová yal heb' schekab' t'a Israel yet' t'a Judá: Na'ek he b'a t'a masanil he chuk b'eyb'al, k'anab'ajejek masanil cheknab'il, kachnab'il yet' masanil k'ayb'ub'al wak'nak t'a heb' he mam heyicham. Hanheja' heb' hin chekab' wan yalan heb' t'ayex, xchi Jehová, xchi heb'.
Palta manh wal jab'ok ix scha heb' yab'i, te pit ix yutej spensar heb' icha yutejnak sb'a heb' smam yicham heb', yujto maj yak'och Jehová sDiosal heb' t'a sk'o'ol.

Ix spatikejel ley heb' yet' trato sb'onak Jehová yet' heb' smam yicham heb' chi'. Ix spatikejpaxel cheknab'il ix alchaj t'a heb'. Ix ochpax tzak'an heb' yuj juntzanh Dios malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi. Ha yuj juntzanh chi' manhxa jab'ok yelk'och heb', haxonhej schuk b'eyb'al juntzanhxo nación ix sb'eyb'alej heb', juntzanh to ay yowalil yuj Jehová sb'eyb'alaji.

Ix yaktankan masanil scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb', ix sb'o'an chab' yechel wakax heb' sdiosalok. Ay pax jun te' yechel ix Asera b'aj ix och heb' ejmelal. Ix ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'anal yet' t'a Baal.

Ix snhusantz'a yal yuninal heb' silab'il t'a komon Dios, ix sk'anb'an sb'a heb' t'a heb' na'umel lolonel yet' t'a heb' aj chum. Ix ste k'ulejnhej chukal heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Icha wal chi' ix aj stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová heb'.
Yuj chi' ix te kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a Israel, ix yik'anel heb' t'a yichanh. Haxonhej heb' yinhtilal Judá ix kan yuj.
Maj sk'anab'ajej pax scheknab'il Jehová sDiosal heb' aj Judá chi'. Palta ix sb'eyb'alej heb' icha wal tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb' israel chi'.

Yuj chi', masanil heb' yinhtilal Israel ix patikanel Jehová, ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il yik tz'ixtaj heb' yuj heb', masanto ix yal yel heb' t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ayik ix ik'ji'el lajunhe' inhtilal heb' israel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yinhtilal winhaj David, haxo winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat ix yak'och heb' sreyalok. Haton winh ix kuchb'anel heb' t'a spatik Jehová, te niwan chukal ix sk'ulej heb' yuj winh.
Icha wal chi' ix te aj yoch smul heb', ix sk'ulejnhej heb' icha chukal ix sk'ulej winhaj Jeroboam chi'.
Yuj chi', ix yik'el heb' israel chi' Jehová t'a yichanh, icha ix aj yalankan heb' schekab'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' preso t'a Asiria, ix kannhej heb' ta'.

Ha winh sreyal Asiria chi' ix ik'ankot heb' anima ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Babilonia, Cuta, Ava, Hamat yet' Sefarvaim. Haton heb' chi' ix kajnaj yuj winh t'a yol yik Samaria sk'exulok heb' israel. Icha chi' ix ajek' kajan juntzanh anima chi' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Samaria chi'.
Ha juntzanh anima ix jawi kajan chi', max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, yuj chi' ix yak'kot nok' choj Jehová t'a skal heb', ix miljicham jaywanh heb' yuj nok'.

Ix alchaj t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Ha heb' anima ix ak'b'at t'a Samaria yik b'at kajnaj heb' ta', manh yojtakok heb' yoch ejmelal t'a sDiosal jun lugar chi', yuj chi' ha jun Dios chi' schekankot nok' choj t'a heb', smiljicham heb' yuj nok', xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji meltzaj junok heb' winh sacerdote ik'b'ilb'at t'a preso chi' yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi', yik wach' tz'aj winh ta', yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj winh t'a tas snib'ej sDiosal jun chonhab' chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot junok heb' winh sacerdote aj Samaria ik'b'ilb'at chi'. Haxo t'a Betel ix aj winh, ix sk'ayb'an heb' anima chi' winh t'a tas tz'aj yoch heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová.
Palta junjun chonhab'il heb' ix sb'o sdiosal t'a junjun chonhab' b'aj kajan. Ix sb'o'anxik'e lugar heb' cha'anh b'aj b'ob'iltaxon yuj heb' aj Samaria chi'.
Ha heb' aj Babilonia, ix sb'o yechel Sucot-benot heb'. Haxo heb' aj Cuta, ix sb'o yechel Nergal heb'. Haxo heb' aj Hamat, ix sb'o yechel Asima heb'.

Haxo heb' aj Ava, ix sb'o yechel Nibhaz heb' yet' yechel Tartac. Haxo pax heb' aj Sefarvaim, ix snhustz'a yalyuninal heb' silab'il t'a yechel Adramelec yet' t'a Anamelec, haton juntzanh chi' sdiosal heb'.
Skomon ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Syak'anpaxoch heb' yetchonhab' heb' sacerdote'al yik tz'och ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh.
Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, palta hanheja' yoch heb' ejmelal t'a skomon Dios, icha sb'eyb'al heb' anima b'aj kotnak heb'.

Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' icha sb'eyb'altaxon t'a peka'. Max ochlaj heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, max sk'anab'ajej cheknab'il heb' yet' k'ayb'ub'al ix yak' Jehová to yowalil sk'anab'ajej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, haton winh ix ak'ji skuch Israel.
Ayik ix sb'o'an strato Jehová yet' heb' israel, ix yalani: Manh hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios, manh heyak' serwil, manh heyak' he silab' t'ay.
Palta anhej t'ayin tzex och ejmelal, yujto Ha hin ix hex wik'elta t'a Egipto yet' hin poder, yuj chi' anhej wal t'ayin yowalil tzex och ejmelal, anhej t'ayin tzeyak'pax he silab'.
Hanhejtona' tze k'anab'ajej masanil hin k'ayb'ub'al, hin cheknab'il yet' kachnab'il tz'ib'yajkani. Manh hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha hin trato tzin b'o tik heyet'ok, manh heyak'b'at satk'olal. Manh hex och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios,
palta anhej t'ayin Jehová he Diosal hin tik tzex och ejmelal. Tato icha chi' tze k'ulej, ol hex hin kolel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' heyajk'o'ol, xchi Jehová.

Palta ha juntzanh anima chi', maj schalaj yab' heb'. Ix sb'eyb'alejnhej heb' ichataxon sb'eyb'al. Wach'chom tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová yalani, tz'ochpax heb' ejmelal t'a sdiosal. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb', ix sb'eyb'alejnhej sb'eyb'al heb' smam yicham heb'.
Ayik yoxilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a israel, ix och winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Acaz reyal t'a Judá.
25 ab'il sk'inal winh, 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abi sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Ezequías chi', te wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.

Maj scha'ochlaj heb' anima winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh. Ix schekan winh mak'jokpoj juntzanh k'e'en k'e'en chajul yaj t'a heb'. Ix ch'akchajel juntzanh te te' yechel Asera. Ix mak'jipoj jun k'e'en yechel chan bronce b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés, yujto snhus incienso heb' israel chi' t'ay, Nehustán ix sb'i'ejkan k'e'en yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', ha Jehová sDiosal Israel ix yak'och winh yipok sk'o'ol. Ha t'a skal masanil heb' winh sreyal Judá, heb' ek'nakxo yet' heb' tzak'anto ochnak yuj winhaj Ezequías chi', malaj junok lajan spensar yet' winh.
Te k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová. Malaj jun'elok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'ay. Masanil scheknab'il Jehová yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés, ix sk'anab'ajej winh.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej ix aj yelk'ochi, yujto aynhejoch Jehová yet' winh. Ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a yalanh smandar winh sreyal Asiria, majxo yak'laj k'e'en tumin winh t'a winh.
Ix yak' ganar heb' filisteo winh, heb' ay t'a juntzanh cuartel yet' heb' ay t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' ayoch smuro'al, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Gaza yet' b'aj sk'och smakb'en Gaza chi'.

Ayik schanhil ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Ela reyal t'a Israel, ix yoymitan chonhab' Samaria winhaj Salmanasar sreyal Asiria yet' heb' soldado.
Ayik ix lajwi yoxil ab'il yoymitan heb', ix yak'an ganar Samaria chi' heb'. Ix uji jun chi' ayik wakexo ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías chi' reyal, b'alunhexo pax ab'il yoch winhaj Oseas reyal t'a Israel.
Ix yik'b'at heb' israel winhaj Salmanasar chi' t'a Asiria. Ha t'a chonhab' Halah t'a yol yik Habor t'a sti' ha' Gozán yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik heb' medo ix aj heb' yuj winh.
Icha chi' ix uji yujto manh k'anab'ajumok ix yutej sb'a heb' israel t'a Jehová sDiosal, ix spitej sb'a heb' t'a strato, maj schalaj yab' heb' tas alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová.

Ayik 14 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal t'a Judá, ix och winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria yak' owal t'a masanil chonhab' ay smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá chi', ix laj ak'ji ganar juntzanh chonhab' chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' ix yak'b'at jun hu'um winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh sreyal Asiria t'a Laquis, ix yalanb'at winh icha tik: Ix och hin mul t'ayach, ik'el ha soldado ayoch t'a sat ko lugar tik, ol wak' k'e'en tumin ayoch t'a wib'anh hu'uj, xchib'at winh. Yuj chi', 225 quintal k'e'en plata yet' 23 quintal k'e'en oro ix yak'och winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a yib'anh winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi'.
Masanil k'e'en plata ayek' t'a yol stemplo Jehová ix yak'b'at winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' jantakxo sb'eyumal winh ay t'a yol spalacio.

Ix yik'anpaxel k'e'en oro winh, haton k'e'en ayoch t'a templo chi', k'e'en ayoch t'a spuerta'il yet' t'a smarco'al, haton k'e'en yak'nakoch winh t'a spuerta'il templo chi'. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yak'b'at winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankot oxwanh heb' winh sat yaj t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix el heb' t'a Laquis, ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén. Ix sb'o'an scampamento heb' b'aj tz'emul yoktak jun stanqueal ha ha' ay t'a yib'anh, t'a yol b'e sb'at b'aj sjuk'wi heb' jalum k'apak.

Elanhchamel ix awtaj winhaj rey Ezequías yuj heb' winh. Yuj chi' ha heb' winh oxwanh tik ix schekb'at winh rey chi', yik sb'at lolon heb' winh yet' heb': Haton winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Hilcías, winh stanhwumal spalacio winh rey chi', winhaj Sebna tz'ib'um ab'ix yet' winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Asaf, stz'ib'um winh rey chi'.
Ix yalan jun winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria chi' t'a heb' winh: --Alek t'a winhaj Ezequías tas syal winh sreyal Asiria, winh niwan yelk'och t'a sat lu'um tik: ¿Tas ayoch yipok ha k'o'ol?
¿Tom tza na' to yujnhej sjelanil ha pensar syal ak'an ganar heb' hin soldado jelan t'a owal? ¿Tas ayoch yipok ha k'o'ol yuj chi' tzach och ajk'olal t'ayin?

Ix wila' to ha Egipto tzak'och yipok ha k'o'ol. Wach' toni, yujto ha Egipto chi' lajan wal icha junok te' aj pojeltakxo. Ayik sko k'okochan te', tz'ek' paknaj te', haxo sjayil snhi' te' sb'at t'a ko k'ab'. Icha chi' yaj winh sreyal Egipto t'a mach tz'ak'anoch winh yipok sk'o'ol.

Hach Ezequías, tekan tzal icha tik: Ha honh tik ha Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. Palta ina toxo ix ha chek satji'el juntzanh altar b'aj cha'anh, b'aj tz'och heb' anima ejmelal t'a jun he Diosal chi'. Ix halani to junxonhej altar b'aj tz'och heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén ejmelal.

Ha tikne'ik b'o junok ha trato yet' winh wajalil, haton winh sreyal Asiria. Syal winh t'ayach icha tik: Ol wak' chab'ok mil nok' chej t'ayach, tato tz'ilchaj heb' soldado sk'e t'a yib'anh nok' hu'uj. ¿Tom ol yal hu'uj?
Tato icha chi', ¿tom ol tzak'wan heyak'an owal yet' jun nhilanh heb' ko soldado aj Asiria wanto sk'ayi, wach'chom tze komon ak'ejoch heb' aj Egipto yet' scarruaje yipok he k'o'ol?
Hanhejtona', ¿tom tza na' to tzonh komon jawi ko satel jun chonhab' tik tato manhok Jehová ayoch ket'ok? Haton wal ix honh chekankot ul hex ko sateli.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Eliaquim, winhaj Sebna yet' winhaj Joa t'a jun winh yajal soldado chi': --Tzonh tewi t'ayach to ha t'a arameo tzal t'ayonh, yujto skab' arameo chi'. Palta manh hach lolon t'a hebreo chi', yujto syab' masanil anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab', xchi heb' winh.

Ix tak'wi winh yajal heb' soldado chi': --Manhoknhej t'ayex yet' t'a winh he reyal b'aj ix hin chekjikot yuj winh hin reyal yik tzul walan juntzanh lolonel tik. Palta haton wal t'a masanil heb' anima ayk'e t'a yib'anh muro chi' b'aj swala', yujto ol yab' sya'il heb' heyet'ok, ol he lo he tza', ol heyuk'an he chul tato tz'och owal.
Yuj chi' ix k'e wa'an winh yajalil heb' soldado chi', te cha'anh ix yal winh t'a hebreo: --Ab'ek wal tas syal winh rey te niwan yelk'ochi, haton winh sreyal Asiria:
Manh heyak' he b'a yixtej winhaj Ezequías chi'. ¿Tokwal ol yal hex skolanel winh t'a yol hin k'ab'?

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi' snib'ej winh to ha Jehová tzeyak'och yipok he k'o'ol. Syalan winh icha tik: Wal yel ol honh skol Jehová ko Diosal. Manh ol ak'jokoch ko chonhab' tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi' yuj, xchi winh.

Palta manh he cha heyab' tas syal winh chi', xchi winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Yujto ha winh rey chi' tzul chekan wal t'ayex tato tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' winh t'a ak'ank'olal, ol he lo sat heyawb'en te', icha te' uwa yet' te' higo. Ol heyuk'anpax ha ha' joyb'il heyu'uj.

Ol lajwok chi', ol hex yik'anb'at winh t'a jun lum lum lajan icha heyik tik, b'aj ay te' uwa yet' ixim trigo. Ol he b'o he pan yet' he wino. Ay pax aceite yet' te' olivo yet' nok' yalchab'. Wach' ol aj yek' heyu'uj, manh ol hex chamlaj yuj wejel. Palta manh heyak'och t'a he k'o'ol tas syal winhaj Ezequías chi', yujto tonhej tzex yixtej winh syalan winh: Ha Jehová ol honh kolanok, xchi winh.
Ha juntzanhxo nación maj koljilaj heb' yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
¿B'aj ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Amat yet' chonhab' Arfad? ¿B'ajtil ix k'och sdiosal chonhab' Sefarvaim, Hena yet' Iva? ¿Tokwal ix kolchaj Samaria t'a yol ko k'ab' ha honh Asiria honh tik yuj sdiosal?

¿Mach junok t'a skal juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh nación chi' ix yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria? ¿Tas yuj tze na' to ha Jehová ol yal skolanel Jerusalén tik? xchi winh yajal soldado yik Asiria chi'.
Palta tz'innhej xchi masanil heb' anima chi'. Manhxa mach ix tak'wi, yujto ha winhaj rey Ezequías ix halani to malaj mach stak'wi.

Yuj chi' ix stzilchitanb'at spichul heb' winh oxwanh chi', yujto ix te tak sk'o'ol heb' winh yuj tas ix yal winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi'. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey Ezequías tas ix alchaj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul winh yik kusk'olal, ix b'at lesalwok winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Ix schekanb'at winhaj Eliaquim winh, winhaj Sebna yet' pax heb' winh yajal heb' winh sacerdote. Ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh yil winh schekab' Dios, haton winhaj Isaías yuninal winhaj Amoz.

Ix b'at yalan heb' winh tas syal winh rey: Ha tikne'ik ayonh och t'a yahelal, t'a kusk'olal yet' t'a k'ixwelal. Icha junok ix ix wan sb'o sk'o'ol yuj unin, manhxa jab'ok yip skani, icha wal chi' kaj tikne'ik.

Komonok wal ix yab' Jehová ko Diosal tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria ayik ix b'uchwaj winh t'a ko Diosal pitzan. Komonok tz'ak'ji'och yahelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová, yuj tas ix yal chi'. Lesalwanh ku'uj mach honh ayonh to ek' tik, xchikot winhaj Ezequías, xchi heb' winh.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Isaías tas ix yal heb' winh schekab' winhaj Ezequías chi',

ix schekanxib'at heb' winh winh yal t'a winh rey icha tik: Icha wal tik yalan Jehová: Manh hex xiw yuj tas ix yal jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Asiria chi', te chuk tas ix yal winh t'ayin, max yal-laj hin kolwaj yalan winh.
Ha hin swala' to ol wak'och jun xiwk'olal t'a winh, yuj chi' ayik ol yab'an junok ab'ix winh, ol meltzaj winh t'a schonhab', hata' ol wak' miljokcham winh, xchi Jehová, xchib'at winhaj Isaías chi'.
