Ix yab'an winh sat yajalil heb' soldado yik Asiria to manhxo ayok ek' winh sreyal Asiria chi' t'a chonhab' Laquis. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winh, ix schalan sb'a winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a chonhab' Libna, wan yak'an owal winh yet' jun chonhab' chi'.
Hata' ix yab' winh rey chi' yalji to ha winhaj Tirhaca sreyal Etiopía wan skot yet' heb' soldado ul yak' owal yet' winh. Yuj chi' ix schekxikot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi'.
Ix yalankot winh icha tik: Ha ha Diosal tz'alan t'ayach to manh ol ak'jokoch Jerusalén t'a yol hin k'ab', palta manh ak' musansatil ha b'a yuj tas syal ha Diosal chi' t'ayach.
Tekan ix ab'i tas ix aj ko satanel juntzanhxo nación ha honh sreyal honh Asiria tik, ¿tom ol yal ha kolji yuj ha Diosal chi' ha na'ani?
¿Tokwal ix kolji heb' anima yuj sdiosal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' hin mam wicham? Haton heb' aj Gozán, heb' aj Harán, heb' aj Resef heb' aj Bet-edén kajan t'a Telasar, ix satji'el heb'.
¿B'ajtil ay winh sreyal chonhab' Hamat, Arpad, Sefarvaim, Hena yet' Iva? xchikot winh sreyal Asiria chi'.

Ix scha'an jun carta winhaj rey Ezequías chi' b'aj tz'ib'ab'il juntzanh lolonel ix alchaj chi'. Ix yilan winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winh t'a stemplo Jehová, ix xuyanel jun carta chi' winh t'a yichanh Jehová chi'.

Ix lesalwi winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, hach ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, ayach ek' t'a skal snanhal querubín, ha hachnhej Dios hach t'a yib'anh masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha hach ix ha b'o satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tzab'an tas ix yalkot winhaj Senaquerib t'ayin. Hach Dios pitzan, ix te b'uchwaj winh t'ayach.
Wal yel tzijtum nación satnakxo'el yuj heb' winh sreyal Asiria chi'.
Ix snhusantz'a sdiosal heb', heb' winh. Yujto ha juntzanh chi' manh diosoklaj, nab'a te', nab'a k'e'en b'ob'il yuj heb' anima, yuj chi' ix yal satanel heb' winh.

Ha tikne'ik jun, hach Jehová ko Diosal, kolonhel t'a yol sk'ab' jun winh rey chi', yik syojtakejel masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik to ha hachnhej Dios hach, malaj junokxo, xchi winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalankot winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, ha tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ix wab' ha lesal yuj tas syal winhaj Senaquerib sreyal Asiria.

Yuj chi' ha hin Jehová hin tik swal yuj winh sreyal Asiria chi' icha tik: Hach Senaquerib, ha heb' ix kob'estak aj chonhab' Sion, malaj elk'och t'a yol sat heb' ix, tonhej ol hach stzetzej heb' ix. Ha heb' aj Jerusalén, ol b'at miknaj heb' ol hach sb'uchan heb'.
¿Mach jun ix ha b'uchu' ix ha xib'tani? ¿Mach jun b'aj cha'anh ix utej ha jaj, ix ik'ancha'anh ha b'a t'ay? Haton t'ayin ha hin sDiosal hin Israel tik to ha hinxonhej ochi.

Ix ha chek yal b'uchwal lolonel heb' winh ha chekab' t'ayin Yajal hin tik. Ix halan icha tik: Ix hin k'e t'a jolomtak witz yet' jantak hin carruaje, haton t'a jolomtak witz cha'anh t'a yol yik Líbano. Ix hin ch'akanel te' k'ute' cha'anh ste'el yet' te' taj manh jantakok swach'il. Ix hin k'enhejk'och t'a jolomtak witz cha'anh b'aj te k'ayum te te' wach' yilji.
Ha t'a ch'ok chonhab'il ix wak' joychaj ha' uk'b'ila', hata' ix wuk' ha'. Ha ix hin ek' t'a yoltak ha ha' t'a Egipto, ix hin tek'ankan tup ha', xa chi.

Palta, ¿tom malaj b'aj ix ab'i to ha hin ton Jehová hin? Wu'uj tz'elk'och juntzanh tik. Atax t'a peka' ix hin na'a to ol ha k'ulej juntzanh tik. Ha tikne'ik jun, wan yelk'och wu'uj, yuj chi' syal ha satanel juntzanh nación te ay yip ix k'ekan b'ulan sk'ajil hu'uj.

Manhxalaj yip heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh nación chi', ix te xiw heb', ix k'ixwi heb'. Lajan ix aj heb' icha anh itaj ya'ax, mato icha anh ank'ultak sk'ib'k'e t'a yib'anhtak pat, kotakto anh stakji'el anh, icha chi' yaj heb' anima chi'.
Wojtak masanil tas tza k'ulej yet' tas nab'il hu'uj tzach ek'i. Wojtakpaxi to te aykot owal t'ayin.

Toxo ix wab'i to aykot owal t'ayin, tzik'ancha'anh ha b'a. Yuj chi' ol wak'och jun k'e'en argolla t'a ha nhi' yet' jun freno t'a ha ti', ol hach wak'an meltzaj t'a b'e b'aj ix hach koti, xchi Jehová t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.

Ix yalanpax winhaj Isaías t'a winhaj rey Ezequías chi': Ha jun tik yechel ol ch'oxjok heyila' yuj tastak toto ol ujok: Ol he wa ixim trigo munil syawej sb'a t'a jun ab'il tik yet' t'a junxo ab'il sjawi. Manhok hexlaj ol yawej ixim. Haxo wal t'a yoxil ab'il jun, ha hexxo ol heyawej ixim he trigo chi', ol he jochank'e wa'an. Ol heyawejpax heyuwa, ol he lo'an sat.
Ha jaywanhokxo hex ol hex kan t'a Judá, lajan ol hex ajkan icha junok te te' sb'at sch'anhal yib' t'a yol lu'um syak'an sat.
Haxo t'a Jerusalén, ayto mach ol kan t'ay. Yet' pax t'a tzalan Sion, manh ol satel-laj anima smasanil. Ha jun tik, ol sk'ulej Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yujto te xajan hex yuj.

Yuj chi' syal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh sreyal Asiria icha tik: Manh ol ochlaj winh t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén, malaj wal junok sjul-lab' winh ol yak'lej sjulankoti. Manh ol jawoklaj winh yak' owal t'a Jerusalén tik, manh ol sb'ok'elaj stek'nub' winh t'a spatiktak smuro'al chonhab' tik.
Ha hin Jehová hin tik swala' to ha t'a b'e b'aj ix jawi winh, hanheja' ta' ol meltzajpax winh. Manh wal jab'ok ol yal yoch winh t'a yol chonhab' tik.
Ha hin ol hin tanhwej jun chonhab' tik, yujto xajan winh hin chekab' aj David wu'uj, yuj pax hin b'inaji, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi', ix ek' jun yángel Jehová smilcham 185 mil heb' soldado asirio t'a scampamento heb', yuj chi' chamnakxo heb' ix sakb'i t'a junxo k'u.
Icha chi' ix aj yik'anel scampamento winhaj Senaquerib chi' ta', ix paxkan winh t'a Nínive.

Ha t'a jun k'u ayik ayoch winh ejmelal t'a sdiosal skuch Nisroc t'a yol stemplo, ix tekjicham winh yuj heb' winh yuninal ta', haton winhaj Adramelec yet' winhaj Sarezer. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'atkan heb' winh elelal t'a yol yik Ararat, haxo junxo yuninal winh skuchan Esarhadón ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', te ow jun ilya ix och t'a winhaj Ezequías, wanxo scham winh. Haxo winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, yuninal winhaj Amoz ix b'at ilan winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Toxo ix yal Jehová to tzalkani tas ol ajkan masanil tas ay t'ayach, yujto ol hach chamnhej, manhxo ol hach b'oxok, xchi winh t'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix sutmajoch winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a sat pat, ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, ix yalan winh:
Mamin Jehová, tzin tewi t'ayach to tzin ha nakot yuj tas ix wutej hach wak'an serwil yet' hin k'anab'ajan t'ayach t'a wal yel. Ix hin k'ulej tas scha ha k'o'ol, xchi winh. Ix ok' wal winh sik'lab'il.
Haxo ix aji, ayik manto wal elk'och winhaj Isaías t'a snanhal yamak'il spat winh rey chi', ix lolonpax Jehová t'a winh, ix yalani:

Meltzajanh, b'at al t'a winhaj Ezequías yajal hin chonhab': Icha tik yalan Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax winh ha mam icham aj David: Toxo ix wab' ha lesal, ix wil yel yal ha sat ok'i. Ol wak' b'oxok ha k'o'ol, haxo chab'ej syalxo ha b'at t'a templo.

Olto wak' 15-okxo ab'il ha k 'inal. Ol hach hin kolnhej yet' chonhab' Jerusalén tik t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Asiria. Ha hin ol hin tanhwej chonhab' tik, yuj sniwanil welk'ochi, yuj pax hin ti' wak'nak t'a winh hin chekab' aj David, xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Isaías chi'.
Ix schekan winhaj Isaías b'ojok sat te' higo, ix ak'chajoch t'a sat jun yab'il chi', ix b'oxikan sk'o'ol winh yuj.

Ayik manto b'o jun remeyo chi', ix sk'anb'an winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi' icha tik: --¿Tas junok yechel ol wila' yik ol nachajel wu'uj to ha Jehová ol ak'an b'oxok hin k'o'ol, yik syal hin b'at t'a stemplo t'a chab'ej chi'? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Isaías chi': --Ay jun yechel ol sch'ox Jehová t'ayach yik wach' ol nachajel hu'uj to ol elk'och tas ix yala'. Ha hach tzala' tato sb'ab'laj wewen t'a lajunhe' b'akhkiltak t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u, mato scha'el yich yemxi jun wewen chi' t'a spatik lajunhe'ok b'akhkiltak chi', xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ayik sb'at wewen chi' t'a yichanh, sekojtak, palta tato schaxi'el yemxi lajunhe'ok b'akhkiltak t'a spatik, ha jun chi' ajaltak, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix tewi winhaj Isaías chi' t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'anxi yik tz'elxi yich yemxita wewen chi' t'a lajunh b'akhkiltak chi' t'a jun tz'ilan jantak yek' k'u yik winhaj Acaz.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ha winh sreyal Babilonia, haton winhaj Merodac-baladán yuninal winhaj Baladán, ix yab' winh to pena'ayaxnak winhaj Ezequías, yuj chi' ix schekkot heb' winh schekab' winh yik tzul yak'ankan jun carta heb' winh yet' junok silab' t'a winhaj Ezequías chi'.

Ix chaji heb' winh chekab' chi' yuj winhaj Ezequías chi'. Masanil tas sik'an yuj winh, ix sch'ox winh t'a heb' winh: Haton k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro, perfume yet' aceite te wach' yet' pax b'aj molanek' yamk'ab' yik owal yet' jantak tas molan yuj winh. Manhxa junokxo tas ay t'a spalacio winh yet' t'a yol smakb'en to maj sch'oxlaj t'a heb' winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios t'a winhaj Ezequías chi', ix sk'anb'an winh t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ix kot juntzanh heb' winh winak chi'? ¿Tas xchi heb' winh t'ayach? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Ezequías chi' t'a winh: --Ix kot heb' winh t'a jun nación te najat, t'a Babilonia, xchi winh.

Ix sk'anb'anxi winhaj Isaías chi': --¿Tas ix yil heb' winh t'a yol ha palacio tik? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi winhaj Ezequías chi': --Masanil tas ix yil heb' winh, manhxa jab'ok tas ayek' tik maj yil heb' winh, masanil ix hin ch'ox t'a heb' winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winhaj Isaías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ab' tas syal Jehová t'ayach:
Ol k'och wal sk'uhal, masanil tas ay t'a ha palacio yet' masanil tas ix smolb'ejkan heb' ha mam icham, ol ik'chajb'at smasanil t'a Babilonia, manhxa jab'ok tas ol kanok.
Yet' pax heb' inhtilal, ol ik'chajb'at heb' t'a Babilonia chi', ol ik'chajel snholob' sk'e'en heb', ol ak'chajoch heb' yak'umalok serwil winh sreyal Babilonia chi', xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a winhaj Isaías chi': --Ha jun lolonel ix al t'ayin yuj Jehová tik te wach', xchi winh. Ix yal winhaj Ezequías chi' icha chi', yujto ix sna' winh to ay junk'olal yakb'an pitzanto winh.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Ezequías yet' tas niwan yelk'och ix sk'ulej winh, haton tas ix aj sb'o'an jun nhajab' winh yet' tas ix aj yik'ankot ha ha' winh t'a yol chonhab', tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ha winhaj Manasés yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Manasés chi', 12 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 55 ab'il ix yak' reyal chi' winh t'a Jerusalén. Hepsiba sb'i ix snun winh.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha masanil chukal sb'eyb'alej juntzanh nación ix yik'el Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel, ha ix sb'eyb'alej winh.

Ix schekan winh to sb'ojixik'e juntzanh lugar cha'anh b'aj tz'och ejmelal, juntzanh ix schek winhaj Ezequías mak'jipojok. Ix sb'o'anxik'e altar yik Baal winh, ix sb'o'anpaxk'e jun yechel Asera winh, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Acab sreyal Israel. Ix och winh ejmelal t'a k'e'en k'anal.
Ix sb'o'anpaxk'e juntzanh altar winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton t'a jun lugar yalnak Jehová icha tik: Ha t'a jun templo t'a Jerusalén ol och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.
Ay juntzanhxo altar ix sb'ok'e winh t'a chab' yamak'il stemplo Jehová, yik tz'och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh k'e'en k'anal.

Hanhejtona' ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il t'a junok sdiosal chi'. Ix sk'anb'an sb'a winh t'a heb' ajb'a'al, t'a heb' ajchum, t'a heb' na'umel lolonel. Ix sk'anb'anpax sb'a winh t'a heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh, yuj chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová winh t'a yib'anh.

Ix yak'paxoch jun te' yechel Asera winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton jun templo chi' yalnakkan Jehová t'a winhaj David yet' t'a winh yuninal haton winhaj Salomón icha tik: Ha t'a hin templo t'a Jerusalén, jun chonhab' ix hin sik'kanel t'a skal masanil chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Israel tik, ha t'ay ol hin kajnaj t'a jun'elnhej.

Tato ol sk'anab'ajej masanil hin cheknab'il heb' heyetchonhab' yet' hin kachnab'il yet' pax hin k'ayb'ub'al hin cheknak yal winh hin chekab' aj Moisés t'a heb', manhxo ol wik'el heb' t'a sat jun lum lum wak'nak t'a he mam heyicham, xchi Jehová.

Palta maj scha yab' juntzanh chi' heb'. Ha wal winh rey chi' ix kuchb'an heb' t'a chukal chi'. Ek'b'al chukal ix sk'ulej heb' t'a yichanh juntzanh nación satb'ilel yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a heb' schekab':

Ha winhaj Manasés chi', ha tas te yajb'entak sk'ulej winh t'a wichanh, yelxo wal ek'b'al chukal sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh heb' amorreo, heb' ek'nak t'a yalanhtaxo. Skuchb'an heb' yetchonhab' winh t'a chukal yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel.
Yuj chi' ha hin Jehová sDiosal Israel swal icha tik: Ol wik'kot yahelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén yet' t'a yib'anh Judá tik, ol te sat sk'o'ol heb' ol ab'anok.

Ol wak'och yahelal t'a yib'anh Jerusalén tik icha ix wutej Samaria yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab. Ol wik'el masanil heb' anima kajan t'ay, lajan ol ajkan icha junok uk'ab' ayik slajwi sb'ikchaji nhojan tz'ajkani.
Haxo jaywanhokxo heb' hin chonhab' tik, ol waktejkan heb', ol wak'kanoch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, yik wach' ol ik'chajek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb'.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' smam yicham heb' t'a Egipto, stzuntzejnhejkot yowal hin k'o'ol heb' yuj chukal sk'ulej heb' t'a wichanh, xchi t'a heb' schekab'.
Ix te kuchb'aj wal heb' aj Judá yuj winhaj Manasés chi' t'a chukal t'a yichanh Jehová. Tzijtum pax heb' anima malaj smul ix smilcham winh, ix laj b'ey schik'il heb' smasanil t'a smakb'en Jerusalén.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Manasés chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh yet' jantak smul winh ix ochi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ayik ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza t'a sti' spalacio winh ix mukchaji. Haxo winhaj Amón yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Amón chi', 22 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Judá. Chab' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Mesulemet sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Haruz aj Jotba.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés smam winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al winh smam winh chi' ix sb'eyb'alej, ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh yechel b'aj ochnak winh smam winh chi' ejmelal.
Icha chi' ix aj spatikanel Jehová Dios winh, haton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh. Maj sk'anab'ajejlaj scheknab'il Jehová winh.
Ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix meltzajoch heb' winh ajk'olal t'a winh, ix miljicham winh yuj heb' winh t'a yol spalacio.

Yuj chi', haxo heb' aj Judá ix milancham heb' winh ix milancham winh rey chi', haxo winhaj Josías yuninal winh ix yak'och heb' reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amón yet' tastak ix sk'ulej, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ayik ix cham winh, ha t'a skaltak te' awb'en te' yik winhaj Uza ix mukji winh.
Ha winhaj Josías wajxake' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 31 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jedida sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Adaías aj Boscat.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh, manh wal jab'ok ix yik'el sb'a winh t'a sb'eyb'al winh smam yicham chi'.

Ayik 18 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal, ix schekanb'at winh stz'ib'um winh t'a stemplo Jehová, haton winhaj Safán yuninal winhaj Azalías yixchikin winhaj Mesulam. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik:
--Ixik t'a winhaj Hilcías winh sat sacerdote, tzalan t'a winh to smolb'ej k'e'en tumin winh tz'ak'ji t'a stemplo Jehová, k'e'en scha heb' stanhwan puerta b'aj tz'och heb' anima,
syak'an k'e'en winh t'a heb' winh yajal yaj yilan sb'ochajxi templo chi' yik stupchaj heb' winh smunlaj t'ay,
haton heb' winh nhikum te' yet' heb' winh tz'ilan tas tz'aj sb'o munlajel chi' yet' heb' winh albañil. Smanchajpax te te' yet' k'e'en k'e'en tzeyb'il, yik sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Manh yowalilok sk'anchaj yumal k'e'en tumin chi' t'a heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', yujto tz'akan syutej heb' winh sb'o'ani, xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj Hilcías chi' t'a winhaj Safán to ix cheklaj b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan ley t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix yak'an ch'anh winh t'a winhaj Safán chi', ix yawtan ch'anh winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Safán chi' yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Toxo ix smol k'e'en tumin ay t'a yol templo heb' winh ha chekab', ix yak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yajalil yilan sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Hanhejtona' ix yalanxi winh to ix ak'ji jun ch'anh hu'um t'a winh yuj winhaj sacerdote Hilcías, yuj chi' ix yawtej ch'anh winh yab' winh rey chi'.
Ayik ix yab'an winh rey chi' tas syal t'a yol ch'anh, ix snhik'chitan spichul winh,

ix schekan winh awtaj winhaj Hilcías chi', winhaj Safán tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán chi', winhaj Acbor yuninal winhaj Micaías yet' winhaj Asaías schekab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik:

--Ixikek he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová wu'uj, yuj heb' chonhab', yuj pax masanil heb' aj Judá, tas syalelk'och ch'anh ley tik. Ay am kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová chi' t'a kib'anh, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej heb' ko mam kicham tas syal ch'anh, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj sacerdote Hilcías, winhaj Ahicam, winhaj Acbor, winhaj Safán yet' winhaj Asaías yil ix schekab' Dios, ix skuchan Hulda yetb'eyum winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Ticva, yixchikin winhaj Harhas. Ha winhaj Salum chi', ha winh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj k'apak pichul t'a templo. Ha ix Hulda chi', ha t'a junxo makan yik Jerusalén toto b'onak, hata' kajan ix. Ayik ix lolonb'at heb' winh t'a ix,
ix tak'wi ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, ha tz'alan icha tik: Alek t'a winh ix hex chekankot he k'anb'ej tik t'ayin
to ha hin ol wak'kot junok yahelal t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a yib'anh heb' kajan t'a tik, icha yalan ch'anh ley ix yawtej winh sreyal Judá chi'.

Yujto ix hin yaktejkan heb' anima tik, ix snhusan incienso heb' t'a juntzanh komon Dios, ix stzuntzankot yowal hin k'o'ol heb' yuj juntzanh sdiosal heb' ix sb'o chi'. Yuj wal chi' ix kot wowal t'a jun lugar tik. Manhxo ol sikb'ilaj wowal chi', xchi Jehová.
Alek t'a winh rey chi', winh ix hex chekankot he k'anb'ej t'a Jehová: Ha Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik tz'alan icha tik: Yujto ix awtej tas ayem t'a yol ch'anh hu'um chi',

ix ak'anoch t'a ha k'o'ol, yuj chi' ix al ha b'a t'ayin, ix ha nhik'chitanb'at ha pichul, ix hach ok'k'e t'a wichanh. Yujto ix ab'pax tas ix wala' to ol satjokel ha chonhab' tik, ol hin katab'an heb' kajan t'ay, yuj chi' toxo ix wab' tas ix ala'. Swal t'ayach

to ix hach wak' niwank'olal, ol hach mukjok t'a junk'olal. Manhxo ol il-laj jun yahelal ol wak'kot t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik, xchi Jehová, xchi ix Hulda chi'. Ix paxta heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' yik tzul yalan heb' winh t'a winh tas ix b'at yab' heb' winh chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' to tz'awtaj masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yik wach' smolb'ej sb'a heb' winh yet' winh.

Ayik ix jawi heb' winh, ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh, heb' winh sacerdote, heb' winh schekab' Dios yet' masanil heb' komon anima, heb' malaj wal yelk'ochi yet' heb' niwak yelk'ochi. Ix b'at heb' smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová. Hata' ix yal winh rey chi' to ha ch'anh yumal strato Jehová ix chax t'a stemplo, tz'awtaj ch'anh t'a yichanh heb' anima chi'.

Ix och tek'tek' winh rey chi' t'a stz'ey jun niwan oy, ix yak'an sti' winh t'a yichanh Jehová to ol sk'anab'ajej juntzanh cheknab'il winh yet' k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, icha syal jun trato tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yol ch'anh hu'um chi'. Hanheja' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajani.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a winh sat sacerdote aj Hilcías yet' t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote yet' t'a heb' winh stanhwan spuerta'il templo to syik'elta heb' winh masanil tastak ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová, haton yamk'ab' sk'an heb' anima yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Baal, t'a Asera yet' t'a k'e'en k'anal. Ix yik'el heb' winh t'a sti'el chonhab' Jerusalén, ix snhusantz'a heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix lajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sta'anhil t'a Betel.

Ix yik'anel yopisio heb' winh sacerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh snhusantz'a incienso b'aj cha'anh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a stitak chonhab' Jerusalén, haton heb' winh ak'b'il yopisio yuj heb' winh rey ek'nak. Ix ik'chajpaxel heb' winh sacerdote snhusantz'a incienso t'a Baal, t'a k'u, t'a k'e'en uj, t'a k'e'en k'anal yet' t'a juntzanh niwak k'anal sb'eyek' t'a satcha'anh.

Ix yik'anpaxel jun yechel Asera winh rey chi', haton jun ayoch t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Ix b'at yak'ankan heb' t'a sti'el chonhab' Jerusalén. Ix nhuschajtz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón, ix stenanchojok stanhil chi' winh, ix stzikanb'at winh t'a yib'anh b'aj mukan heb' komon anima.
Ix pojjipaxem juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh ix-winak yuj winh, haton b'ob'il t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Hata' sch'alwipax heb' ix ix sb'o'an k'apak mantiado yik Asera.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh sacerdote winh rey chi', haton heb' winh ay t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yixtanb'at masanil altar winh t'a masanil lugar cha'anh t'a Geba masanto t'a Beerseba, haton b'aj snhustz'a incienso juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote. Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh, juntzanh ay t'a spuerta'il chonhab' skan t'a stojolal sk'exan mach tz'och t'a yol chonhab' chi', haton jun puerta yik winhaj Josué yajal t'a Jerusalén.

Ha heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal Leví ix ak'an silab' t'a juntzanh lugar cha'anh, majxo k'ochlaj heb' winh t'a altar yik Jehová t'a Jerusalén, haxonhej swa'el heb' winh tz'ak'ji yuj heb' winh yetsacerdote'al chi'.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at jun lugar winh rey chi', jun skuchan Tofet t'a sch'olanil Ben-hinom b'aj snhusjitz'a heb' unin silab'il t'a jun komon Dios skuchan Moloc, yik manhxa junok mach sk'ulan jun chukal chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxel nok' chej winh, nok' ayoch yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá yik tz'och ejmelal t'a k'u. Ix snhusantz'a scarruaje nok' chej chi' winh. Ha juntzanh chi', ha t'a jun amak' t'a slak'anil b'aj tz'och anima t'a yol stemplo Jehová, hata' ay, t'a stz'ey scuarto jun winh ay yopisio skuchan Natán-melec.

Ix spojanpaxem juntzanh altar winh rey chi', juntzanh b'ob'ilkan yuj heb' winh sreyal Judá t'a spanhanil yib'anh scuartokan winhaj rey Acaz. Ay pax juntzanh altar b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Manasés t'a chab' yamak'il stemplo Jehová, ix smak'poj winh, ix syumankanb'at sk'ajil winh t'a yol ha' Cedrón.

Ix yixtanpaxb'at juntzanh lugar winh, juntzanh cha'anh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Jerusalén, t'a stojolal sur t'a tzalan Olivo, haton jun sb'onakkan winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel, haton Astarté sdiosal heb' aj Sidón, Quemos sdiosal heb' moabita yet' Milcom sdiosal heb' amonita. Masanil juntzanh chi' yajb'ilel yuj Jehová.
Ix smak'anpaxpoj k'e'en k'e'en winh, k'e'en chajul yaj t'a heb' anima, ix ch'akchajpaxel te' yechel Asera. Ix saklemajb'at sb'akil chamnak ta' yuj winh.

Ix smak'paxpoj jun altar winh yet' templo t'a Betel, haton sb'onakkan winhaj rey Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, winh kuchb'annakb'at heb' yetisraelal t'a chukal. Pokokxonhej ix aji, ix snhusantz'a yechel Dios Asera chi' winh.

Ix ek' k'elelok winhaj Josías chi', ix yilanb'at juntzanh yet'tal chamnak winh t'a jun tzalan, ix yalan winh to tz'ik'chajelta sb'akil chamnak ayoch t'a yo'ol chi', ix snhusantz'a winh t'a yib'anh altar yik tz'ixtaxb'ati. Icha chi' ix aj yelk'och tas yalnakkan jun winh schekab' Jehová t'a peka'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj rey Josías chi': --¿Mach ay yik jun yet'tal chamnak swilb'at chi'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' kajan t'a Betel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Haton b'aj mukan jun winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Judá, ha winh aljinakkan yuj tas ix utej jun altar t'a Betel tik, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix yalan winh: --Aktejekkani, malaj junok mach syaman sb'akil chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' majxo yamjilaj sb'akil jun winh schekab' Dios chi' yet' sb'akil junxo winh schekab' Dios kotnak t'a Samaria.

Icha ix yutej winhaj Josías chi' t'a Betel chi', icha pax chi' ix yutej winh satanel juntzanh lugar cha'anh, juntzanh b'ob'il t'a Samaria chi' yuj heb' winh sreyal Israel, juntzanh stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', haxo t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar ix smilcham masanil heb' winh sacerdote winh, haton heb' winh yik juntzanh lugar cha'anh t'a Samaria chi'. Ix snhusantz'a sb'akil juntzanh chamnak winh t'a yib'anh juntzanh altar chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Josías t'a masanil heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kak'ekoch k'inh yik sko na'ankot tas aj yelnakkot heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto yik skik'ancha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal, icha syalkan t'a yumal trato, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix och jun k'inh chi'. Yiktax ix lajwi'ek' stiempo'al heb' juez, heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a chonhab' Israel, malaj jun'elok ix och jun k'inh icha jun chi' t'a stiempo'al heb' winh ix ak'an reyal t'a Judá yet' t'a Israel.
Yik wal 18 ab'il yoch winhaj Josías chi' reyal ix och jun k'inh chi' t'a Jerusalén, yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová.

Masanil heb' tz'awtan spixan heb' chamnak, heb' ajb'a'al yet' juntzanh yechel t'a yoltak pat, ix satji'el yuj winhaj Josías chi'. Masanil pax juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak ay t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a yol smakb'en Judá ix satel winh. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yik sk'anab'ajan winh tas syalkan t'a yumal ley ix chax yuj winhaj sacerdote Hilcías t'a yol stemplo Jehová.

Malaj junokxo rey ek'nakxo ix sk'ex spensar yik syak'anoch sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, t'a smasanil spensar yet' t'a smasanil yip, icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Josías chi', yujto ix sk'anab'ajej winh tas alb'ilkan t'a ley Moisés. Manhxalaj pax junokxo rey icha chi' ix yutej sb'a.
Wach'chom icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh, palta yuj tas te chuk sk'ulejnak winhaj Manasés, yuj chi' aykot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová icha tik: Ol wik'el Judá t'a wichanh, icha wutejnak Israel. Ol hin patikejkanel Jerusalén, jun chonhab' sik'b'ilel wu'uj yet' jun templo tik, jun walnak yuj to ha t'ay tz'och ejmelal t'ayin, xchi.

Ha t'a stiempo'al chi' ix kot winhaj Necao sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado yik sb'at heb' t'a ha' niwan Éufrates, yik sb'at kolwaj winh yet' winh sreyal Asiria. Ix b'at winhaj rey Josías yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winhaj Necao chi' t'a Meguido. Ayik ix schalan sb'a heb' winh t'a owal chi', ix miljicham winhaj Josías chi' yuj winh. Ix ak'jik'e sniwanil winh t'a yol carruaje yuj heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh. Ix kot heb' winh t'a Meguido chi' masanto ix jawi heb' winh t'a Jerusalén, ix ak'jikanoch sniwanil winh chi' t'a jun yet'tal b'ob'ilxo. Haxo heb' anima smasanil t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Joacaz yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok. Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josías chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Ha winhaj Joacaz chi', 23 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal t'a Jerusalén. Oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal chi' winh. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix ak'ji'och winh t'a preso yuj winhaj rey Necao t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat, yik wach' maxtzak yak' yajalil winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix yak'anoch k'e'en tumin winhaj Necao chi' t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi', 75 quintal k'e'en plata yet' oxe' arroba k'e'en oro.

Haxo winhaj Eliaquim yuninal winhaj Josías chi' ix yak'och winhaj rey Necao chi' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ix sk'exan sb'i winhaj Eliaquim chi' winh, Joacim ix sb'i'ej winh. Ix yik'anb'at winhaj Joacaz chi' winh t'a Egipto. Hata' ix cham winhaj Joacaz chi'.

Ix yak'an k'e'en oro winhaj Joacim chi' yet' k'e'en plata sk'an winh sreyal Egipto chi'. Yuj chi' ix yak'och k'e'en winh t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a yol smakb'en chi', junjun anima ix yak' k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata, icha tastak ay t'a junjun heb'. Icha chi' ix aj smolan k'e'en tumin winh ix kan t'a yib'anh chi'.
Ha winhaj Joacim chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Zebu sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Pedaías aj Ruma.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej heb' smam yicham winh.

Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Joacim chi', ix kot winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' winh. Icha chi' ix aj yochkan winhaj rey Joacim oxe' ab'il t'a yalanh smandar winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajoch winhaj Joacim chi' ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia chi'.

Palta ix ak'jikot heb' soldado caldeo yuj Jehová, heb' soldado sirio, heb' soldado moabita yet' heb' soldado amonita yik sjawi heb' elk'al t'a Judá yik syixtanb'at heb', icha ix aj yalan heb' schekab' Jehová.
Wal yel ix jawi jun tik t'a yib'anh Judá, yujto ha Jehová ix halani yik syik'anel Judá t'a yichanh, yuj smul winhaj Manasés,
yuj pax schamel heb' anima malaj smul t'a Jerusalén ix cham yuj winh. Yuj chi' majxo yak'laj niwank'olal Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joacim chi' yet' tastak ix sk'ulej winh, tz'ib'ab'ilkan b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ha winhaj Joaquín yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Majxo eltalaj winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado t'a yol smakb'en, yujto ha winh sreyal Babilonia ix ik'anxi'ek' tas ik'b'ilek' yuj winh, skot t'a ha' eluma' yik Egipto masanto t'a ha' Éufrates.
Ha winhaj Joaquín chi', 18 ab'ilxo sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, oxenhej ujal ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Nehusta sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Elnatán aj Jerusalén.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal ix sk'ulej winh smam winh.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix kot heb' soldado winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia yak' owal t'a Jerusalén, ix oymaj heb' t'a spatik.
Wan yak'an owal heb', ix k'och winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a winhaj Joaquín sreyal Judá yet' ix snun, heb' winh yetyajalil winh yet' pax heb' winh schekab' winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Nabucodonosor chi'. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia ayik swajxakilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' reyal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' ik'chajelta masanil k'e'en tumin ay t'a yol stemplo Jehová yet' t'a yol spalacio winh sreyal Judá chi'. Ix smak'anpoj masanil yamk'ab' winh nab'a oro yik templo chi' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj Salomón sreyal Israel. Ix elk'och jun tik icha ajnak yalankan Jehová.

Ix schekan winh ik'chajb'at masanil anima kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' heb' yajal, heb' soldado te jelan, heb' winh jelan sb'o'an tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'e'en. 10 mil heb' ix ik'jib'at t'a Babilonia chi' t'a smasanil. Manhxa mach ix kani, haxonhej heb' meb'a' ixto kani.

Ha winhaj rey Joaquín chi', ix snun winh, heb' ix yetb'eyum winh, heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' heb' anima niwak yelk'och t'a yol smakb'en winh chi', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winhaj Nabucodonosor chi' t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal masanil anima ix ik'chajb'at chi', ay 7 mil heb' winh soldado, ay pax mil heb' winh syal sb'o'an tastak yet' heb' winh tenum k'e'en. Masanil heb' winh tik te tek'an heb' winh, te jelan pax heb' winh t'a owal.
Haxo winhaj rey Nabucodonosor chi' ix ak'anoch winhaj Matanías yuk'tak smam winhaj Joaquín chi' reyal sk'exulok winh. Ix k'exji sb'i winh yuj winh, Sedequías ix sb'i'ejkan winh.
Ha winhaj Sedequías chi', 21 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal, 11 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Hamutal sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Jeremías aj Libna.
Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Joacim.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, ix yik'ankanel heb' t'a yichanh. Ix meltzajoch winhaj Sedequías ajk'olal t'a winh sreyal Babilonia.

Ayik slajunhil k'uhal yoch slajunhil uj, ayik sb'alunhil ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías reyal, ix jawi winhaj rey Nabucodonosor yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal t'a Jerusalén. Ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatiktak Jerusalén chi', ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' winh t'a spatiktak, ix sb'o'ank'e stek'nub' heb' winh t'a spatiktak smuro'al.
Oyb'ilnhej jun chonhab' chi' yuj heb' winh, masanto ayik 11 ab'il yoch winhaj Sedequías chi' reyal.
Ayik sb'alunhil k'uhal yoch schanhil uj t'a yol jun ab'il chi', ix em jun niwan wejel t'a yol chonhab' chi', manhxa jab'ok tas wach' swa'an heb' anima chi'.

Ix sb'o'an jun olan heb' winh soldado caldeo chi' t'a smuro'al chonhab' chi'. Wach'chom oyanoch heb' winh soldado t'a spatiktak chi', palta ix el winhaj rey Sedequías chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'ak'walil. Ix elk'och heb' winh t'a jun puerta t'a skal chab' muro t'a stz'ey b'aj ay yawb'en te' heb' winh rey, ix b'at heb' winh t'a jun b'e sk'och t'a sch'olanil ha' Jordán.
Palta ix b'at heb' winh soldado caldeo chi' t'a spatik heb' winh, ix yamchaj winhaj Sedequías chi' yuj heb' winh t'a yak'likal Jericó. Ix saklemkanb'at heb' winh soldado winh.
Ix syaman winh rey chi' heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' winh t'a winhaj Nabucodonosor sreyal Babilonia chi' t'a Ribla, t'a yol yik Hamat. Hata' ix yal winh tas ol utaj winhaj Sedequías chi'.
T'a wal yichanh winhaj Sedequías chi' ix xikjicham heb' yuninal. Ix ik'chajk'eta yol sat winh, ix tzek'chaj winh t'a k'e'en cadena nab'a bronce, ix ik'chajb'at winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayik uke' k'uhalxo yoch yo'il uj t'a 19 ab'il yoch winhaj Nabucodonosor reyal t'a Babilonia, ix jawi winhaj Nabuzaradán yajalil heb' winh soldado stanhwumal winh rey chi' yet' heb' winh soldado t'a Jerusalén.
Ix snhusantz'a stemplo Jehová heb' winh yet' spalacio winh rey, masanil spat heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi' yet' masanil niwak pat.
Ix spojanem masanil smuro'al chonhab' Jerusalén chi' heb' winh.
Masanil heb' anima ayto kani, ix yik'b'at heb' winhaj Nabuzaradán chi', haton heb' ix yak'och sb'a yet' winh sreyal Babilonia yet' heb' jelan sb'o'an tastak.
Haxonhej heb' te meb'a' ix yaktejkan winh, yik smunlaj heb' t'a awoj uwa yet' juntzanhxo tas tz'awchaji.

Masanil tastak nab'a bronce ay t'a yol templo ix smak'poj heb' winh soldado chi', haton chab' oy ayoch t'a sat templo chi', juntzanh sb'akhnub' yich kotak pila yet' jun niwan pila. Ix yik'anb'at k'e'en bronce chi' heb' winh t'a Babilonia.

Hanhejtona' b'aj tz'em k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh, k'e'en pala, k'e'en ik'lab'el stanhil b'aj tz'och sk'ak'al candil, k'e'en niwak cuchara yet' masanil tastak nab'a bronce sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal t'a Jehová, ix yik'b'at heb' winh smasanil.
Ix yik'paxb'at juntzanh niwak waso heb' winh yet' k'e'en b'aj snhusji incienso yet' juntzanhxo tastak nab'a oro ma nab'a plata.

Manhxa yalb'anil jantak yalil k'e'en bronce ayoch t'a chab' niwak oy yik templo, t'a jun pila yik ha ha' yet' t'a juntzanh yich b'akhnub' b'ob'ilkan yuj winhaj rey Salomón yik tz'ochkan t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha junjun oy chi', ek'b'al wajxake' metro ste'el. Ha sjolom oy chi' nab'a bronce, nanhal schab'il metro yaj k'e'i, haxo spatiktak sjolom oy chi', aypaxoch yelwanub' icha yilji te' granada. Ha juntzanh chi' nab'a bronce. Lajannhej yaj chab' oy chi'.
Ha winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' ix yaman winhaj Seraías sat sacerdote, winhaj Sofonías schab'il sacerdote yet' oxwanh heb' winh stanhwan sti' templo, ix ik'jib'at heb' winh yuj winh t'a Babilonia.

Ha t'a skal heb' anima ix kan t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix yamchajpax jun winh sat yajal skuchb'an heb' winh soldado yet' pax owanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey yet' jun winh tz'ib'um sb'o'an slista'il heb' winh soldado yet' pax 60-xo heb' winh niwak winak yaj t'a yol chonhab' chi'.

Masanil juntzanh heb' anima chi' ix yik'b'at winhaj Nabuzaradán chi' t'a Ribla t'a yol yik Hamat. Hata' ix yal winh rey to scham heb'. Icha chi' ix aj yik'ji'el heb' aj Judá chi' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slu'um, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Babilonia.
Ix och winhaj Gedalías yuninal winhaj Ahicam yixchikin winhaj Safán gobernadoral yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi'. Ha winh ix kan yil jantakto anima ix kan t'a Judá chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an jun lolonel chi' heb' winh yajal heb' winh soldado ixto kani, ix b'at heb' winh t'a Mizpa yet' heb' winh soldado chi', yik b'at lolon heb' winh yet' winhaj Gedalías chi'. Ha heb' winh chi', haton winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías, winhaj Johanán yuninal winhaj Carea, winhaj Seraías yuninal winhaj Tanhumet aj Netofa yet' winhaj Jaazanías yuninal jun winh aj Maaca.

Ix yak'an sti' winhaj Gedalías chi' t'a heb' winh yet' t'a heb' winh soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: Manh hex xiw he kan t'a yalanh smandar heb' caldeo chi', kajnajanhek t'a yol nación tik, tzex och t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh sreyal Babilonia. Tato icha chi' wach'nhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, xchi winh.

Haxo t'a yukil uj, ix jawi winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Netanías yixchikin winhaj Elisama, t'a yinhtilal heb' winh sreyal Judá. Ay lajunhwanhxo heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh, ix smilancham winhaj Gedalías chi' heb' winh yet' heb' aj Judá yet' pax heb' caldeo ayek' yet' winh t'a Mizpa chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima ix b'at elelal t'a Egipto yuj xiwelal t'a heb' caldeo chi'. Hata' ix b'at heb' anima niwak yelk'ochi, heb' malaj yelk'ochi yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado.

Ayik 27 k'uhal yoch slajchawil ujal, ayik 37 ab'ilxo yik'chajb'at winhaj rey Joaquín t'a Babilonia, ix och winhaj Evil-merodac reyal t'a Babilonia chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el ab'il yoch winh reyal chi' ix sch'oxan swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Joaquín chi', ix yik'anelta winh winh t'a preso.
Te wach' ix yutej sb'a winh rey chi' t'a winh t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' winh rey ayoch preso t'a Babilonia chi'.
Yuj chi' ix sk'exel spichul winhaj Joaquín sk'an t'a yol preso chi', ix wa winh yet' winh rey chi' t'a jantakto tiempo'al pitzan winh.
Ix ak'jinhej sgasto winh yuj winh sreyal Babilonia chi' masanto ix cham winh.
Haton stzolal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik: Winhaj Set, winhaj Enós,
winhaj Cainán, winhaj Mahalaleel, winhaj Jared,
winhaj Enoc, winhaj Matusalén, winhaj Lamec,
winhaj Noé. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Noé: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jafet chi': Winhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gomer chi': Winhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Javán chi': Haton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cam: Haton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut, winhaj Canaán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cus chi': Haton winhaj Seba, winhaj Havila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Raama chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus chi', haton winh smam winhaj Nimrod. Haton jun winh chi' te niwan ajnak yelk'och t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yujto te jelan ajnak winh t'a owal.
Ha t'a winhaj Mizraim, hata' kotnak heb' ludeo, heb' aname'o, heb' lehabita, heb' naftuhítas,
heb' patruseo, heb' casluhítas yet' heb' caftoritas. Ha t'a heb' chi' kotnak yinhtil heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Sidón, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Canaán. Ha junxo yuninal winh, haton winhaj Het.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' ay yinhtilal heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heveo, heb' araceo, heb' sineo,
heb' arvadeo, heb' zemareo yet' heb' hamateo.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sem: Haton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aram chi': Haton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mesec.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad chi' smam winhaj Sela, haxo winhaj Sela chi' smam winhaj Heber.
Ha winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh: Ha winh b'ab'el skuch Peleg, yujto ha t'a stiempo'al winh ix pojchajb'at lum lum. Haxo junxo winh yuninal winh chi' skuchan Joctán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joctán chi': Haton winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Ebal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Havila yet' winhaj Jobab. Ha masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Joctán.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sem tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Sela,
winhaj Heber, winhaj Peleg, winhaj Reu,
winhaj Serug, winhaj Nacor, winhaj Taré,
yet' winhaj Abram, haton winhaj Abraham.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Abraham: Haton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ismael: Haton winhaj Nebaiot, b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Massa, winhaj Hadad, winhaj Tema,
winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedema.

Haxo heb' yune' ix Cetura, schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi': Haton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jocsán chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Madián chi': Haton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh ix Cetura.
Ha winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaac chi', haton winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esaú chi': Haton winhaj Elifaz, winhaj Reuel, winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elifaz chi': Haton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam, winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Amalec yune' ix Timna.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Reuel chi': Haton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Seir: Haton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Lotán chi': Haton winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Homam. Ha winhaj Lotán chi' ay yanab' ix Timna.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sobal chi': Haton winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zibeón chi': Haton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná.
Ha winhaj Aná chi', smam winhaj Disón, haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disón chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ezer: Haton winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Jaacán. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disán chi': Haton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Haton heb' winh tik ix ak'an yajalil t'a Edom ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel tz'ochi: Ha winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Beor, Dinaba sb'i schonhab' winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Bela chi', haxo winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera, aj chonhab' Bosra ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', ha t'a yol yik Temán kajan winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Avit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Madián t'a ak'lik yik Moab.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj chonhab' Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. kajan winh t'a chonhab' Rehobot t'a sti' ha' Éufrates.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán, yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj chonhab' Pai ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Mehetabel sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh, ha winhaj Matred ay yisil ix, yixchikin ix winhaj Mezaab.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', ha heb' winh ix och reyal t'a Edom chi': Haton winhaj Timna, winhaj Alva, winhaj Jetet,
winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón,
winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar,
winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'an reyal t'a Edom chi'.
Haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel tik: Winhaj Rubén, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón,
winhaj Dan, winhaj José, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Neftalí, winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Haton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán yet' winhaj Sela. Ha snun heb' winh oxwanh tik, haton ix yisil winhaj Súa aj Canaán. Ha winhaj Er chi' b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Judá, te chuk sb'eyb'al winh, yuj chi' ix satji'el winh yuj Jehová.
Haxo ix Tamar, ix yalib' winhaj Judá chi', ay chawanh yune' ix yet' winh: Haton winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá chi' owanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Fares chi': Haton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zera chi': Haton winhaj Zimri, winhaj Etán, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Dara. Owanh heb' t'a smasanil.
Haxo winhaj Carmi smam winhaj Acán. Ha winhaj Acán chi' ix ik'ankot yahelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel, yujto ix yik'kot juntzanh tas winh t'a skal tas ix yal Dios to satji'el t'a jun'elnhej.
Haxo yuninal winhaj Etán, haton winhaj Azarías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hezrón: Haton winhaj Jerameel, winhaj Ram yet' winhaj Quelubai.
Ha winhaj Ram chi' smam winhaj Aminadab. Haxo winhaj Aminadab chi' smam winhaj Naasón. Ha winhaj Naasón yajal ix aj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.
Ha winhaj Naasón chi' smam winhaj Salmón. Ha winhaj Salmón chi' smam winhaj Booz.
Ha winhaj Booz chi' smam winhaj Obed, haton winh smam winhaj Isaí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', haton heb' winh tik: B'ab'el winhaj Eliab, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Simea,
schanhil winhaj Natanael, yo'il winhaj Radai,
swakil winhaj Ozem, yukil winhaj David.
Eb' ix yanab' heb' winh tik: Haton ix Sarvia yet' ix Abigail. Haxo heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Abisai, winhaj Joab, winhaj Asael.
Haxo winh yune' ix Abigail chi', haton winhaj Amasa. Ha winh smam winhaj Amasa chi', haton winhaj Jeter ismaelita.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Hezrón, ay jun yuninal winh skuch Jeriot, yune' ix Azuba. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yune' ix: Haton winhaj Jeser, winhaj Sobab yet' winhaj Ardón.
Haxo ix cham ix Azuba chi', haxo ix Efrata ix yik' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ay jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Hur.
Ha winhaj Hur chi' smam winhaj Uri. Haxo winhaj Uri chi' smam winhaj Bezaleel.
Ayik 60 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Hezrón, ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Maquir winh, haton winh smam winhaj Galaad. Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hezrón chi', haton winhaj Segub.
Ha winhaj Segub chi' smam winhaj Jair. Ha winhaj Jair chi' ayoch yajalil t'a 23 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad.

Haxo pax heb' aj Gesur yet' heb' aj Aram ix ik'ankan juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jair chi' yet' chonhab' Kenat yet' yaldea'il, 60 chonhab'il t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Maquir.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Hezrón chi', haxo winhaj Caleb ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Efrata. Ix alji jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Asur smam yicham heb' aj Tecoa.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jerameel tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Hezrón: Winhaj Ram winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Buna, winhaj Orén, winhaj Ozem yet' winhaj Ahías.
Ha winhaj Jerameel chi', ay junxo ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Atara snun winhaj Onam.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ram tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jerameel: Winhaj Maaz, winhaj Jamín yet' winhaj Equer.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Onam chi': Haton winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Jada. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Samai chi': Haton winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abisur.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abisur chi', haton ix Abihail. Ha ix chi' snun winhaj Ahbán yet' winhaj Molid.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nadab chi': Haton winhaj Seled yet' winhaj Apaim. Ha winhaj Seled chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo winhaj Apaim chi' smam winhaj Isi. Haxo winhaj Isi chi' smam winhaj Sesán. Haxo winhaj Sesán chi' smam winhaj Ahlai.
Haxo winhaj Jada yuk'tak winhaj Samai, ha winh smam winhaj Jeter yet' winhaj Jonatán. Ha winhaj Jeter chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi': Haton winhaj Pelet yet' winhaj Zaza. Ha heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Jerameel.
Ha winhaj Sesán, malaj yuninal winh, yuj chi' ha junok heb' ix yisil winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' jun winh schekab' winh skuch Jarha aj Egipto. Ix alji jun yune' ix skuch Atai.

Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Atai t'a stzolal: Winhaj Natán, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Eflal, winhaj Obed, winhaj Jehú, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Heles, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Sismai, winhaj Salum, winhaj Jecamías yet' winhaj Elisama.
Ha winhaj Caleb yuk'tak winhaj Jerameel chi', ha winh smam winhaj Mesa b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Zif yet' winhaj Maresa smam winhaj Hebrón.
Haxo winhaj Hebrón chi' smam winhaj Coré, winhaj Tapúa, winhaj Requem yet' winhaj Sema.
Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Sema t'a stzolal: Winhaj Raham, winhaj Jorcoam, winhaj Requem, winhaj Samai, winhaj Maón yet' winhaj Bet-sur.
Ha ix Efa schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb, haton ix ay yune' winhaj Harán, winhaj Mosa yet' winhaj Gazez. Haxo winhaj Harán chi' smam junxo winhaj Gazez.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jahdai: Haton winhaj Regem, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Gesam, winhaj Pelet, winhaj Efa yet' winhaj Saaf.

Haxo ix Maaca schab'il pax yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb chi', ha ix ay yune' winhaj Seber yet' winhaj Tirhana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Saaf smam winhaj Madmana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Seva smam winhaj Macbena yet' winhaj Gibea. Haxo ix yisil winhaj Caleb chi', haton ix Acsa.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hur, winh sb'ab'el une' ix Efrata, haton winhaj Sobal, winh smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim,
winhaj Salma, smam yicham heb' aj Belén yet' winhaj Haref smam yicham heb' aj Bet-gader.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sobal smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton winhaj Haroe, nanhal heb' manahetita,
yet' junjun makan heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton heb' itrita, heb' futita, heb' sumatita yet' heb' misraita. Haton t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' zoratita yet' heb' estaolita.
Haxo winhaj Salma ix kajnajkan t'a chonhab' Belén. Ha winh smam yicham heb' netofatita, heb' aj Atrot-bet-joab yet' nanhalxo heb' manahetita, heb' zoraíta,
yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' soferita ix ek' kajan t'a Jabes, haton heb' tirateo, heb' simateo yet' heb' sucateo. Yet' heb' ceneo kotnak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hamat smam yicham heb' yinhtilal Recab.

Ha winhaj rey David nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Hebrón. Ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Hebrón chi', wakwanh heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, haton heb' tik: Ha winh b'ab'el, ha winhaj Amnón, yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel. Haxo winh schab'il, ha winhaj Daniel yune' ix Abigail aj Carmel. Haxo winh yoxil, ha winhaj Absalón, yune' ix Maaca, ix yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur. Haxo winh schanhil, ha winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit. Haxo winh yo'il, ha winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital. Haxo winh swakil, haton winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Ixlajwi chi' 33 ab'il pax ix yak' reyal winhaj David chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Jerusalén chi', 13 to heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Simea, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán yet' winhaj Salomón. Ha heb' winh tik, yune' heb' winh ix Betsabé, ix yisil winhaj Amiel.
Ha juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj David chi': Haton winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.
Yanab' pax ix Tamar juntzanh heb' winh tik. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum max b'inajlaj t'a skal heb' winh tik.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Salomón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Roboam, winhaj Abías, winhaj Asa, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram, winhaj Ocozías, winhaj Joás, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz, winhaj Ezequías, winhaj Manasés, winhaj Amón yet' winhaj Josías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Josías chi', winh b'ab'el, ha winhaj Johanán, winh schab'il, ha winhaj Joacim, winh yoxil, ha winhaj Sedequías, winh schanhil ha winhaj Salum.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joacim chi': Haton winhaj Jeconías yet' winhaj Sedequías.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeconías winh ik'b'ilb'at preso t'a Babilonia, haton winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Malquiram, winhaj Pedaías, winhaj Senazar, winhaj Jecamías, winhaj Hosama yet' winhaj Nedabías.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Pedaías, haton winhaj Zorobabel yet' winhaj Simei. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi': Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hananías yet' pax ix Selomit yanab' heb' winh.
Ay pax owanhxo yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hasuba, winhaj Ohel, winhaj Berequías, winhaj Hasadías yet' winhaj Jusab-hesed.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hananías chi': Haton winhaj Pelatías yet' winhaj Jesaías. Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jesaías chi' t'a stzolal haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Refaías, winhaj Arnán, winhaj Abdías yet' winhaj Secanías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Secanías chi', haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Hatús, winhaj Igal, winhaj Barías, winhaj Nearías yet' winhaj Safat. Wakwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nearías oxwanh sb'ey heb' winh. Haton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Ezequías yet' winhaj Azricam.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elioenai chi', ukwanh sb'ey heb' winh: Haton winhaj Hodabías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Pelaías, winhaj Acub, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Dalaías yet' winhaj Anani.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Carmi, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Sobal.
Ha winhaj Sobal chi' smam winhaj Reaía, smam icham winhaj Jahat. Haxo winhaj Jahat chi' smam winhaj Ahumai yet' winhaj Lahad. Ha yinhtilal heb' winh ix kajnaj t'a Zora.

Ha winhaj Hur sb'ab'el yune' ix Efrata yet' winhaj Caleb. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Belén. Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Etam, winhaj Penuel yet' winhaj Ezer. Ha winhaj Etam smam winhaj Jezreel, winhaj Isma, winhaj Ibdas yet' ix Haze-lelponi. Ha winhaj Penuel chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Ezer chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Husa.
Haxo winhaj Asur ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Tecoa, chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winh: Haton ix Hela yet' ix Naara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Naara chi', haton winhaj Ahusam, winhaj Hefer, winhaj Temeni yet' winhaj Ahastari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Hela chi', haton winhaj Seret, winhaj Jezoar yet' winhaj Etnán.
Haxo winhaj Cos smam winhaj Anub yet' winhaj Sobeba. T'a yinhtilal winhaj Cos chi' ix kot winhaj Aharhel, yuninal winhaj Harum.
Ay jun winh skuchan Jabes, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha ix snun winh ix ak'an skuch Jabes, yujto ix yal ix: Te ya ix hin ek' yuj jun wune' ix alji tik, xchi ix.

Ha winhaj Jabes chi', ix och winh ejmelal t'a sDiosal Israel, ix yalan winh t'ay: Tzin k'an t'ayach Mamin to tzak' ha wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh, yik niwan tz'aj hin makb'en, to tzach och wet'ok tzin ha kolanel t'a chukal, yik wach' max wab' sya'il, xchi winh t'a slesal chi'. Ix yak'an Dios masanil tas ix sk'an winh chi'.
Ha winhaj Quelub yuk'tak winhaj Súa, ha winh smam winhaj Mehir, haxo winhaj Mehir chi', smam winhaj Estón.

Haxo winhaj Estón chi' ay oxwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bet-rafa, winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Tehina. Ha winhaj Tehina chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Nahas. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' winh oxwanh chi' ek'nak kajan t'a Reca.
Haxo winhaj Cenaz ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Otoniel yet' winhaj Seraías. Chawanh pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Otoniel chi', haton winhaj Hatat yet' winhaj Meonotai.

Ha winhaj Meonotai chi' smam winhaj Ofra. Haxo winhaj Seraías chi' smam winhaj Joab, haton winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a ak'lik Carisim. Icha chi' sb'i jun lugar chi', yujto hata' kajan heb' anima jelan sb'o'an tastak.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Iru, winhaj Ela yet' winhaj Naam. Ha winhaj Ela chi' smam winhaj Cenaz.
Haxo winhaj Jahalelel ay chanhwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zif, winhaj Zifa, winhaj Tirías yet' winhaj Asareel.

Ha winhaj Esdras ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Jeter, winhaj Mered, winhaj Efer yet' winhaj Jalón. Ha winhaj Mered chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Bitia, yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Haxo yalyuninal winh yet' ix, haton ix María, winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Isba. Ha winhaj Isba chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Estemoa. Haxo junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Mered chi', aj Judá ix. Oxwanh yuninal winh yet' ix, haton winhaj Jered, winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Jecutiel. Ha winhaj Jered chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Heber, ha t'a chonhab' Soco ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh. Haxo pax winhaj Jecutiel chi', ha t'a chonhab' Zanoa ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hodías ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix yanab' winhaj Naham. T'a yinhtilal heb' ix kot heb' garmita, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Keila. Hanheja' t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hodías chi' ix kot heb' maacateo, haxo t'a Estemoa ix kajnaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Simón chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amnón, winhaj Rina, winhaj Ben-hanán yet' winhaj Tilón. Haxo winhaj Isi ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zohet yet' winhaj Benzohet.

Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Er, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Leca yet' winhaj Laada, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Maresa, smam yicham heb' sch'alan k'apak lino t'a chonhab' Bet-asbea. Hanhejtona' winhaj Er chi' smam winhaj Joacim yet' heb' anima kajan t'a Cozeba yet' winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf. Ha winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab. Slajwi chi' smeltzajnakxi heb' winh t'a Belén, icha chi' yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a peka'.
Ha juntzanh heb' chi' tz'akum heb'. Ha t'a Netaim yet' t'a Gedera kajan heb', yak'nak serwil winh rey heb'.
Ha winhaj Simeón owanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Salum, winhaj Mibsam, winhaj Misma.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Misma chi', haton winhaj Hamuel, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Simei.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', 16 heb' winh, wakwanh pax heb' ix yisil winh. Haxo pax heb' winh sk'ab'yok winh, malaj wal yuninal heb' winh, yuj chi' maj k'ib' sb'isul heb' winh icha yinhtilal Judá.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar tik: T'a Beerseba, t'a Molada, t'a Hazar-sual, t'a Bilha, t'a Esem, t'a Tolad, t'a Betuel, t'a Horma, t'a Siclag, t'a Bet-marcabot, t'a Hazar-susim, t'a Bet-birai yet' t'a Saaraim. Hata' kajan heb' masanto yik ix och winhaj David reyal.
Ayto pax oyexo schonhab' heb': Haton Etam, Aín, Rimón, Toquén yet' Asán,
yet' masanil yaldea'il juntzanh chonhab' chi' masanto t'a chonhab' Baal. Haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' b'aj kajan heb' yet' yinhtilal icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Ayik ix k'ib' sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi', haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Winhaj Mesobab, winhaj Jamlec, winhaj Josías (yuninal winhaj Amasías), winhaj Joel, winhaj Jehú (yuninal winhaj Josibías, haxo winhaj Josibías chi' yuninal winhaj Seraías, haxo winhaj Seraías chi' yuninal winhaj Asiel) yet' pax winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Jaacoba, winhaj Jesohaía, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jesimiel, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Ziza. (Ha winh smam winhaj Ziza chi' haton winhaj Sifi, yuninal winhaj Alón, yuninal winhaj Jedaías, yuninal winhaj Simri yuninal winhaj Semaías).

Yujto ix k'ib' sb'isul heb', yuj chi' ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Gedor. Ix sayan heb' b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a jun ch'olan b'aj skan jun chonhab' chi'.

Hata' ix ilchaj anh ank'ultak te ya'ax yuj heb', te wach' anh, te ay pax anh. Te lewan yek' jun lum lum chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas tz'ik'an heb', haton ta' ek'nak kajan heb' yinhtilal Cam t'a peka'.

Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, hata' ix jawi juntzanh heb' toxo ix b'inaj sb'i tik. Ha heb' satjinakel heb' anima kajan ta' yet' scampamento heb' yet' spat heb'. Jun'elnhej ix satel heb' smasanil. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan t'a slu'um heb' chi', yujto te ay swa'el nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Hanhejtona', ay pax 500-xo heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix k'och kajan t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isi, haton winhaj Pelatías, winhaj Nearías, winhaj Refaías yet' winhaj Uziel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha heb' ix satanel heb' amalecita ayto'ek' ta'. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan ta'.

Ha winhaj Rubén, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jacob, palta maj scha chab' makan smakb'en winh yik sb'ab'el uninal chi', yujto ix way winh yet' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam. Yuj chi' ha junxo makan smakb'en winh chi', ix ak'chajkan t'a heb' winh yuninal winhaj José, haton junxo yuninal winhaj Jacob chi'.

Wach'chom ha t'a winhaj José chi' ix ak'chajkan jun makb'en yik b'ab'el uninab'il chi', palta ha winhaj Judá te niwan ix aj yelk'och t'a skal heb' yuk'tak chi', yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal winh ix kot heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Rubén chi': Haton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi.

Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Joel t'a stzolal: Winhaj Semaías, winhaj Gog, winhaj Simei, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Reaía, winhaj Baal yet' winhaj Beera. Ha winhaj Beera chi', yajal yaj winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', haton winh ik'jinakb'at preso yuj winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria.
Ha heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Beera chi', t'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chajkan heb' yet' yinhtilal. Haton winhaj Jeiel yajal yaji, winhaj Zacarías,

winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Azaz, yixchikin winhaj Sema, yinhtilal winhaj Joel. Ha winhaj Bela chi' yet' yinhtilal winh, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Aroer, ix k'och smakb'en heb' chi' t'a Nebo yet' t'a Baal-meón.
Ix kajnaj pax heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto t'a tzinan lu'um, haton lum sk'ochnhej t'a ha' Éufrates, yujto ix te k'ib' sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayik ayoch winhaj Saúl reyal, ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' agarenos, yak'nak ganar heb' agareno chi' heb', haxo heb' kajnajnakkan t'a schonhab' heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Galaad chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix kajnaj heb' t'a snorte'al smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yol yik Basán, masanto t'a chonhab' Salca t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton sb'i heb' winh tik:
Ha winhaj Joel yajal t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Basán chi', schab'il winhaj Safán.Ix kajnajpax winhaj Jaanai yet' winhaj Safat ta'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, icha syal stzolal smam yicham heb' winh: Winhaj Micael, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Seba, winhaj Jorai, winhaj Jacán, winhaj Zía yet' winhaj Heber, ukwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.

Ha heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Abihail yuninal winhaj Huri. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham heb' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Abihail, winhaj Huri, winhaj Jaroa, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jesisai, winhaj Jahdo yet' winhaj Buz.
Yet' pax winhaj Ahí, yuninal winhaj Abdiel yixchikin winhaj Guni, yajal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Ix kajnaj heb' smasanil t'a Galaad yet' t'a Basán yet' t'a yaldea'il yet' t'a masanil b'aj wach' swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a Sarón, masanto t'a smojon heb'.
Masanil juntzanh heb' tik ix tz'ib'chaj yet' yinhtilal ayik ayoch winhaj Jotam reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Jeroboam ayoch reyal t'a Israel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 44 mil 760 heb' soldado te tek'an, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', yespada heb' yet' sjul-lab' heb', te k'ayb'ab'il heb' yak'an owal.
Ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' agareno yet' winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Nodab.
Ix yak'och Dios heb' yipok sk'o'ol, ix sk'anan skolwal Dios chi' heb'. Ix spakan tas ix sk'an heb', yuj chi' ix ak'ji'och heb' agareno yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', haton tik ix yik'kan heb' t'a heb' agareno chi': 50 mil nok' camello, 250 mil nok' kalnel, 2 mil nok' b'uru yet' 100 mil anima ix yik'b'at heb' chekab'wumal.
Te niwan heb' ajk'o'ol chi' ix chami, yujto ha jun owal chi' ha Dios ay yiko'. Icha chi' ix aj skajnajkan heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a juntzanh lugar chi', masanto ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi', yujto te tzijtum sb'isul heb', ix kajnaj heb' t'a sat lum sb'atnhej t'a Basán masanto sk'och t'a Baal-hermón, skuchanpax lum Senir yet' lum switzal Hermón.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Haton winhaj Efer, winhaj Isi, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Azriel, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Hodabías yet' winhaj Jahdiel. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', soldado te tek'an, te jelan pax heb' winh, b'inajnak heb' winh, yajal heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Palta ix te och wal spitalil heb' winh t'a Dios, ix yaktejkan sDiosal smam yicham heb' winh, haxo t'a juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' ix satel Dios t'a yichanh heb' chi', hata' ix och heb' ejmelal.

Yuj chi' ha Dios chi' ix chekankot winh sreyal Asiria, haton winhaj Pul, skuchan pax Tiglat-pileser. Ix jawi winh t'a slu'um heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'. Ix ak'ji'och heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a chonhab' Halah, t'a Habor, t'a Hara yet' t'a stitak ha' Gozán. Hata' ix kannhej heb'.
Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo winhaj Coat chi' chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés yet' jun yisil winh, haton ix María. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik sb'eyb'at t'a stzolal t'a heb' winh uninab'il yet' t'a heb' winh ichikinab'il: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías, (haton winh sacerdote yaj t'a templo ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón t'a Jerusalén), winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Salum, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Seraías yet' winhaj Josadac. Ha winhaj Josadac chi' ix ik'jib'at winh preso yet' heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor, yujto ha Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví oxwanh heb': Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari chi': Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yinhtilal Leví heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Libni, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Zima, winhaj Joa, winhaj Iddo, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Jeatrai.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Coré, winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Asir, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Uriel, winhaj Ozías yet' winhaj Saúl.

Haxo winhaj Elcana chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Ahimot. Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Ahimot chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Elcana, winhaj Safai, winhaj Nahat, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Samuel.
Haxo winhaj Samuel chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Vasni sb'ab'el yuninal winh, schab'il winhaj Abías.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari t'a stzolal: Winhaj Mahli, winhaj Libni, winhaj Simei, winhaj Uza, winhaj Simea, winhaj Haguía yet' winhaj Asaías.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'ji'och yuj winhaj rey David yik sb'itan heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová, yiktax ix ak'ji'och te' skaxa'il trato t'a yol skajnub' Jehová t'a Jerusalén.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh sb'itan t'a yichanh kajnub' chi' masanto yik ix b'ojik'e stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio sb'itan chi' yet' heb' winh yuninal, haton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán skuchb'an jun makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Ha sb'i heb' winh b'aj ix kot yinhtilal winhaj Hemán chi' tz'el yich t'a winh smam winh masanto t'a slajwub'xo smam yicham winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Joel, winhaj Samuel, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Toa, winhaj Zuf, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Mahat, winhaj Amasai, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Joel, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Sofonías, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Asir, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Coré, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Coat, winhaj Leví yet' winhaj Israel.

Ha t'a swach' winhaj Hemán chi' skan winhaj Asaf, haton winh skuchb'an junxo makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Haton sb'i heb' winh smam yicham winhaj Asaf chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Berequías, winhaj Simea, winhaj Micael, winhaj Baasías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Etni, winhaj Zera, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Etán, winhaj Zima, winhaj Simei, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Leví.

Haxo t'a sk'exanh winhaj Hemán chi' skan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari sb'itan paxi. Ha winhaj Etán skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi'. Haton stzolal smam yicham winhaj Etán tik: Winhaj Quisi, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Amsi, winhaj Bani, winhaj Semer, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi, winhaj Merari yet' winhaj Leví.
Haxo juntzanh heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, hanheja' yinhtilal Leví heb' winh, ix kan heb' winh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal, ha heb' snhusan ofrenda t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' t'a altar yik incienso. Hanhejtona' ha heb' tz'ilan masanil opisio t'a jun Lugar Yiknhej Jehová yaji yet' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul heb' yetisraelal heb', icha wal yutejnak winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios yalankani.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas.

Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' smakb'en b'aj ix kajnaj heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix em jun b'ab'el makan, yuj chi' ha chonhab' Hebrón t'a yol yik Judá, ha ix kan t'a heb' winh yet' slu'umal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh. Palta ha juntzanh yaldea'il yet' slu'umal t'a spatiktak chi' ak'b'il t'a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ix ak'chaj Hebrón, haton jun chonhab' chi' b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima manh sk'anok sk'o'ol. Ix ak'jipax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb': Libna, Jatir, Estemoa, Hilén, Debir, Asán yet' Bet-semes. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol yik Judá ay. Haxo t'a yol yik Benjamín ix ak'chaj juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Geba, Alemet yet' Anatot. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', 13 t'a smasanil, ix kannhej yet' slu'umal t'a spatiktak b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix ak'chajpax lajunhexo chonhab' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat chi'.

Haxo pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha jay makan yaj heb', 13 chonhab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yik Aser, heb' yik Neftalí yet' t'a yik heb' Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton t'a Basán.

Hanheja' pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj 12 chonhab' icha jay makan yaj heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén ay, heb' yik Gad yet' heb' yik Zabulón.
Ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví yuj heb' yetisraelal yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a smakb'en Judá, yik Simeón yet' yik Benjamín, hata' ay juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix b'inaj ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha ix aj yik'an heb' t'a suerte'al.
Ay juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix cha'an juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tz'aj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Efraín:
Haton Siquem t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín chi', haton t'a jun chonhab' chi' syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima to manh sk'anok sk'o'ol. Ix yik'anpax juntzanh chonhab' tik heb': Gezer,
Jocmeam, Bet-horón, Ajalón yet' Gat-rimón. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix schapax chonhab' Aner yet' Bileam heb' yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha syal jay makan yaj heb', ix ak'chaj chonhab' Golán t'a yol yik Basán, chonhab' Astarot yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ha chab' chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en Manasés t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Isacar: Cedes, Daberat, Ramot yet' Anem. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Aser: Masal, Abdón, Hucoc yet' Rehob. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Cedes t'a yol yik Galilea, Hamón yet' Quiriataim. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Zabulón: Rimón yet' Tabor. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhb'at Jericó, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Beser t'a jun ak'lik tzinan lu'um, Jaza, Cademot yet' Mefaat. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix ak'chajpax juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, Mahanaim, Hesbón yet' Jazer. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isacar chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Tola chi': Haton winhaj Uzi, winhaj Refaías, winhaj Jeriel, winhaj Jahmai, winhaj Jibsam yet' winhaj Semuel. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal. Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj rey David, 22 mil 600 sb'isul heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Tola chi'.

Ha winhaj Uzi chi' ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Israhías. Ha winhaj Israhías chi' ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Winhaj Micael, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Isías. Ha winh yet' heb' winh yuninal chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Yujto tzijtum heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' yal yuninal junjun heb' winh, yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh, ay 36 mil sb'isul heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado yinhtilal heb' chanhwanh yuninal winhaj Isacar chi' te jelan t'a owal, ay 87 mil heb'.
Oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Benjamín: Haton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Jediael.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi', owanh heb' winh: Winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Jerimot yet' winhaj Iri. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 22 mil 34 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bequer: Haton winhaj Zemira, winhaj Joás, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Omri, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Abías, winhaj Anatot yet' winhaj Alemet.
Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 20 mil 200 heb'.

Ha winhaj Jediael ay jun yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bilhán. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bilhán chi': Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Aod, winhaj Quenaana, winhaj Zetán, winhaj Tarsis yet' winhaj Ahisahar.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', ay 17 mil 200 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ir, haton winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hupim. Haxo yuninal winhaj Aher, haton winhaj Husim.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Neftalí: Haton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Salum. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Jacob yet' ix Bilha.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Manasés yet' ix aj Siria schab'il yetb'eyum: Haton winhaj Asriel yet' winhaj Maquir, smam winhaj Galaad.

Ha winhaj Maquir chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Maaca, yinhtilal winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Supim. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Maquir chi', haton winhaj Zelofehad. Ha jun winh chi', anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay.

Haxo ix Maaca yetb'eyum winhaj Maquir chi', ix alji chawanh swinak unin ix. Peres ix yak' ix sb'i'ej jun, haxo junxo Seres. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Peres chi', Ulam sb'i winh b'ab'el, Requem sb'i junxo winh.
Haxo jun yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', haton winhaj Bedán. Ha heb' winh tik ha winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir ay yinhtilal heb' winh, haton winh yixchikin winhaj Manasés.
Ha jun ix yanab' winhaj Maquir chi': Haton ix Hamolequet, haton ix snun winhaj Isod, winhaj Abiezer yet' winhaj Mahala.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semida: Haton winhaj Ahián, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Likhi yet' winhaj Aniam.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Efraín sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Sutela, winhaj Bered, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Elada, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Sutela. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efraín chi', haton winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Elad, milb'ilcham heb' winh yuj heb' kajan t'a Gat, yujto ix emk'och heb' yelk'ej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajan t'a Gat chi'.
Ha winhaj Efraín smam heb' winh chi', tzijtum k'uhal ix te kus winh. Ix jawi heb' sk'ab'yok winh yak' sniwanil sk'o'ol.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji pax junxo yuninal winhaj Efraín chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, Bería ix yak' winh sb'i'ej, yujto ix ek' jun niwan kusk'olal chi' t'a heb'.
Ha ix Seera yisil winhaj Bería chi', ha ix ix b'o'ank'e chonhab' Bet-horón jun ay t'a yalanh yet' Bet-horón ay t'a yib'anh yet' chonhab' Uzen-seera.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Bería sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Refa, winhaj Resef, winhaj Telah, winhaj Tahán, winhaj Laadán, winhaj Amiud, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Nun, winhaj Josué.

Haxo slu'um heb' winh b'aj kajan: Haton Betel yet' Naarán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, Gezer t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' Siquem masanto sk'och t'a Ayah. Ix scha juntzanh chonhab' chi' heb' winh yet' yaldea'il.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés, ix kajnaj heb' winh t'a chonhab' Bet-seán, Taanac, Meguido, Dor yet' yaldea'il juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Haton t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal José, yuninalkan winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aser: Haton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix Sera yanab' heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bería chi': Haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel smam winhaj Birzavit.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Heber chi': Haton winhaj Jaflet, winhaj Semer, winhaj Hotam yet' ix Súa yanab' heb' winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaflet chi': Haton winhaj Pasac, winhaj Bimhal yet' winhaj Asvat.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semer chi': Haton winhaj Ahí, winhaj Rohga, winhaj Jehúba yet' winhaj Aram.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Helem: Haton winhaj Sofa, winhaj Imna, winhaj Seles yet' winhaj Amal.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sofa chi': Haton winhaj Súa, winhaj Harnefer, winhaj Súal, winhaj Beri, winhaj Imra,
winhaj Beser, winhaj Hod, winhaj Sama, winhaj Silsa, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Beera.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeter: Haton winhaj Jefone, winhaj Pispa yet' winhaj Ara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ula: Haton winhaj Ara, winhaj Haniel yet' winhaj Rezia.
