Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal Aser heb' winh. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal, te niwak pax yelk'och heb' winh. Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Aser chi', ay 26 mil heb'.
Ha winhaj Benjamín owanh yuninal winh: Haton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Bela, winh b'ab'el, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Ahara, winhaj Noha yet' winhaj Rafa.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi': Haton winhaj Adar, winhaj Gera, winhaj Abiud, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahoa, winhaj Gera, winhaj Sefufán yet' winhaj Hiram.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aod: Haton winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahías yet' winhaj Gera. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Geba, palta ik'jinakel heb' t'a Geba chi', ik'chajnakb'at kajan heb' t'a Manahat yuj winhaj Gera smam winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahiud.
Ha winhaj Saharaim ayto juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Moab, ayik toxo ix spuklaj sb'a winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum, haton ix Husim yet' ix Baara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' junxo ix yetb'eyum skuchan Hodes: Haton winhaj Jobab, winhaj Sibia, winhaj Mesa, winhaj Malcam,
winhaj Jeúz, winhaj Saquías yet' winhaj Mirma. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ay chawanh yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum skuchan Husim chi', haton winhaj Abitob yet' winhaj Elpaal.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal chi': Haton winhaj Heber, winhaj Misam yet' winhaj Semed. Ha winhaj Semed chi' b'o'annakk'e chonhab' Ono, chonhab' Lod yet' yaldea'il.
Ha winhaj Bería yet' winhaj Sema, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' kajan t'a Ajalón, pechjinakel heb' kajan t'a Gat yuj heb' winh.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bería chi': Haton winhaj Ahío, winhaj Sasac yet' winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Arad, winhaj Ader, winhaj Micael, winhaj Ispa yet' winhaj Joha.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal: Haton winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hizqui, winhaj Heber, winhaj Ismerai, winhaj Jezlías yet' winhaj Jobab.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei: Haton winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Zabdi, winhaj Elienai, winhaj Ziletai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Adaías, winhaj Beraías yet' winhaj Simrat.

Eb' winh yuninal winhaj Sasac: Haton winhaj Ispan, winhaj Heber, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Abdón, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Elam, winhaj Anatotías, winhaj Ifdaías yet' winhaj Peniel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Jeroham: Haton winhaj Samserai, winhaj Seharías, winhaj Atalías, winhaj Jaresías, winhaj Elías yet' winhaj Zicri.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilal ix kajnaj t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón ek'nak winhaj Jehiel smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zequer yet' winhaj Miclot, smam winhaj Simea. Hanhejtona' juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnajpax heb' winh yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner chi' smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi', haton winhaj Merib-baal, smam winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Haton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.
Haxo winhaj Acaz chi' smam winhaj Joada, haxo winhaj Joada chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmavet yet' winhaj Zimri. Haxo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Mosa chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Bina, winhaj Rafa, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Azel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azel wakwanh heb' winh: Winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Hanán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esec yuk'tak winhaj Azel: Haton winhaj Ulam winh b'ab'el unin, schab'il winhaj Jehús, yoxil winhaj Elifelet.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', te tek'an heb' winh yak'an owal, yojtak wal heb' winh sjulwaji. Tzijtum yuninal heb' winh yet' yixchikin, 150 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', ha winhaj Benjamín ay yinhtilal heb' winh.
Icha tik ix aj stz'ib'chajkan masanil heb' israel t'a stzolal tas yaj yinhtilal heb' b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel. Ha heb' anima ay t'a Judá, ik'chajnakb'at heb' t'a Babilonia yuj schukal.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Israel b'ab'laj meltzajxikot t'a slu'um yet' t'a schonhab', haton heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.
Ha t'a Jerusalén ix kan kajan heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yik Benjamín, heb' yik Efraín yet' heb' yik Manasés.

Ha t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 690 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá, ha winhaj Utai yuninal winhaj Amihud yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' smam yicham t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Omri, winhaj Imri, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá chi'. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá chi', ha winhaj Asaías winh b'ab'el unin, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' sk'ab'yok. Haxo t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Zera, yuninal pax winhaj Judá chi', ha winhaj Jeuel yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín tik: Winhaj Salú yuninal winhaj Mesulam yixchikin winhaj Hodabías, yinhtilal winhaj Asenúa, winhaj Ibneías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ela yixchikin winhaj Uzi, yinhtilal winhaj Micri, winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Sefatías, yixchikin winhaj Reuel, yinhtilal winhaj Ibnías. 956 heb' t'a smasanil.

Haxo heb' winh sacerdote kajan t'a Jerusalén yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok: Haton winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jaquín yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Azarías t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Meraiot yet' winhaj Ahitob. Ha winhaj Azarías chi' yajal t'a stemplo Dios. Hanheja' t'a skal heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ayoch winhaj Adaías yuninal winhaj Jeroham. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winhaj Adaías chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Pasur, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Masai, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jahzera, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Mesilemit yet' winhaj Imer. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ay mil 760 heb' winh te nhikan smunlaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' levita kajan t'a Jerusalén: Haton winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Hasub, yixchikin winhaj Azricam, schab'il yixchikin winhaj Hasabías, yinhtilal winhaj Merari.
Yajal pax winhaj Bacbacar, winhaj Heres, winhaj Galal yet' winhaj Matanías yuninal winhaj Micaía, yixchikin winhaj Zicri, yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.

Yajal pax yaj winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Semaías, yixchikin winhaj Galal, yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Berequías, yuninal winhaj Asa, yixchikin winhaj Elcana ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh aldea yik heb' netofatita.
Haxo heb' winh stanhwan puerta: Haton winhaj Salum, winhaj Acub, winhaj Talmón, winhaj Ahimán yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh. Ha winhaj Salum yajal yaj t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh tik stanhwannhej puerta yik heb' winh rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haton heb' winh stanhwan puerta chi' t'a skal heb' yetlevita'il.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Coré, yixchikin winhaj Ebiasaf, yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, ha heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios, icha ajnak stanhwan spuerta'il skajnub' Dios chi' heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Ha t'a peka' chi', ha winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar ayoch yajalilok heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios chi'. Aynhej wal och Jehová yet' winh.
Haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Meselemías, ha winh stanhwan spuerta'il b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios.

Ha sb'isul heb' stanhwan spuerta'il kajnub' sik'b'ilel chi', 212 heb' tz'ib'ab'ilkani icha tas yinhtilal junjun makan b'aj kajan heb'. Ha winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios ak'jinakkanoch heb' t'a yopisio niwan yelk'och chi'.
Masanil heb' yet' pax yuninal heb', ayoch heb' t'a stzolal stanhwan spuerta'il skajnub' Dios.
Aynhejoch stanhwumal chi' t'a schanhil pak'anh: T'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a stojolal sur.
Ha heb' yetlevita'il heb' kajan t'a juntzanhxo aldea, t'a junjun yuktakil k'uhal sjawi heb' stanhwej templo chi', yik skolwaj heb' yet' heb'.
Ay chanhwanh heb' levita niwak yopisio stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha heb' chi' ayoch heb' t'a masanil tiempo stanhwan juntzanh cuarto yet' b'aj smolchaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ha heb' chi' aynhejek' heb' t'a spatiktak kajnub' chi' tz'ek' ak'wal, yujto ha heb' stanhwani. Haxo t'a junjun k'inhib'alil sjakan kajnub' chi' heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' t'a skal heb' chi' stanhwan juntzanh yamk'ab' sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a Dios. Yowalil sb'is heb' jantak tz'elta, slajwi chi' sb'isan heb' yochxikani.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilan juntzanhxo yamk'ab' niwak yelk'ochi yet' pax ixim harina, wino, aceite, incienso yet' perfume.
Ay pax heb' sacerdote sb'o'an perfume chi'.
Haxo jun winh levita skuchan Matatías, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Salum, yinhtilal winhaj Coré, ha winh sb'o'an ixim pan tz'ak'ji ofrenda'il.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetlevita'il heb' winh, heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, ha heb' winh sb'o'an ixim pan tz'em tzolan t'a sat mexa t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a junjun k'uhal ik'oj ip.

Hanhejtona' ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal heb' winh levita chi' sb'itani. Ha t'a juntzanh cuarto yik templo chi' ay heb' winh, malaj yalan yik heb' winh t'a juntzanhxo munlajel, yujto k'uhal t'ak'wal yajoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi'.
Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha yaj stzolal yinhtilal heb' winh. Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan heb' winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón, hata' ek'nak kajan winhaj Jehiel, smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Miclot.
Ha winhaj Miclot chi' smam winhaj Simeam. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis chi' smam winhaj Saúl. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ha winhaj Jonatán chi' smam winhaj Merib-baal smam winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Haton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.

Haxo winhaj Acaz smam winhaj Jara. Haxo winhaj Jara chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmavet yet' winhaj Zimri. Haxo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa. Haxo winhaj Mosa chi' smam winhaj Bina. Haxo winhaj Bina chi' smam winhaj Refaías, winhaj Elasa yet' winhaj Azel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Azel chi', wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías yet' winhaj Hanán.
Ix yak' owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, ix el lemnaj heb' israel chi', te niwan heb' ix cham t'a lum witzal Gilboa.
Ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal: Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Malquisúa. Ix miljicham heb' winh yuninal winh chi' yoxwanhil.
Ix ochwal heb' winh filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix lajwi winh sjulan heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' icha tik: Ik'k'eta k'e'en espada chi', tza tipanoch k'e'en t'ayin, yik wach' manhok juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik ol tzalaj hin smilani, xchi winh. Palta ha winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi', maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix sk'ulej icha ix yal winh chi', yujto xiw winh. Yuj chi' ha winh ix ik'ank'eta k'e'en yespada, ix syumanb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'e'en.
Ayik ix yilan winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' to toxo ix cham winh, ix syumanpaxb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'e'en yespada chi', ix champax winh.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl t'a jun k'u chi' yet' oxwanh heb' winh yuninal. Manhxo junok yinhtilal winh ix elkani.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel kajan t'a jun ch'olan chi' to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb', toxo ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb', ix b'at heb' elelal. Haxo heb' filisteo ix k'ochkan kajan t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' spojek' tastak ay t'a heb' ix cham chi'. Ix yilan heb' to ha winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal chamnakxo heb' winh, teljab'kan sniwanil heb' winh t'a lum witzal Gilboa.

Ha spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik owal ayochi, elanhchamel ix yik'el heb', ix xikanel sjolom winh heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb'. Ix schekan heb' b'at alchaj t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' yet' t'a sdiosal heb'.
Ix b'at yak'anoch syamk'ab' winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a stemplo jun sdiosal skuchan Dagón, ix yak'ank'e lokan sjolom winh heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Jabes ay t'a yol yik Galaad tas ix yutej sniwanil winhaj Saúl heb' filisteo chi',

ix slajti'an sb'a masanil heb' winh winak te tek'an. Ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winhaj Saúl chi' heb' yet' pax sniwanil heb' winh yuninal winh, ix k'och yuj heb' t'a Jabes chi'. Ha t'a yich jun te' ji ix smuk sniwanil heb' winh chi' heb'. Uke' k'uhal ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yuj kusk'olal.

Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl yuj chukal ix sk'ulej, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová winh, yujto ix sk'anb'ej pax sb'a winh t'a jun ix sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, manhok t'a Jehová ix sk'anb'ej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj Jehová, haxo t'a winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí ix ak'jikan yopisio winh chi'.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel, ix b'at lolon heb' yet' winhaj David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha honh tik, junnhej ko mam kicham het'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wach'chom ha winhaj Saúl ayoch reyal, palta ha hach ix honh ha kuchb'ej ayik ix kak'an owal. Hanhejtona', ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach to ha hach ol honh ha kuchb'ej, ol hach ochpaxkan ko reyalok, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ayik ix k'och heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel lolonel yet' winh t'a Hebrón chi', ix sb'o'an jun strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Hata' ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom winh yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok Israel, icha wal tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Samuel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj rey David chi' yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal t'a Jerusalén, skuchan pax Jebús, b'aj kajan heb' jebuseo.

Ix yalan heb' jebuseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ha hach tik, manh ol yal-laj ochta t'a tik, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ix ak'ji ganar scuartel heb' t'a tzalan Sion chi' yuj winh, yuj chi' ix skuchkan schonhab' winhaj David.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha mach ol b'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ol wak'och yajalilok heb' soldado, xchi winh. Haxo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia ix b'ab'laji, yuj chi' ix och winh yajalilok heb' soldado chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj rey David t'a cuartel t'a Sion chi', yuj chi' Schonhab' Winhaj David ix sb'i'ejkani.
Ix sb'ok'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak chi', ix schab'at t'a ch'olan masanto ix k'och t'a smuro'al chonhab'. Haxo winhaj Joab ix wach' b'o'an stz'akub' chonhab' Jebús chi'.
Ix yik'an stek'anil yopisio winhaj rey David chi', yujto ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil aynhejoch yet' winh.

Ha heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak, ix och heb' winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ayik ix yak'anoch winhaj David chi' heb' reyal t'a yol smakb'en Israel smasanil. Ix te och wal heb' winh yet' winh yik syak'an reyal winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Haton slista'il heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak chi': Ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Hacmoni, sat yaj winh t'a skal oxwanhxo heb' winh yetb'inajnakil chi'. Ha t'a jun'el ix smilcham 300 heb' winh winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza.
Haxo junxo winh t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo, yinhtilal winhaj Aho.

Ha t'a jun'el ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a Pas-damim ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo yak' owal ta'. Hata' ay jun munlajel b'aj awab'il ixim cebada. Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' soldado Israel t'a yichanh heb' filisteo,

haxo heb' winh chawanh chi' ix kan tek'naj t'a skal jun munlajel chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo chi' yuj heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkan chonhab' Israel yuj Jehová.

Ha t'a jun'el, ha oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a sattak k'e'en yik b'at schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a jun k'e'en nhak'e'en skuchan Adulam. Haxo heb' filisteo ay scampamento heb' t'a sch'olanil Refaim.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en chi', ayek' scampamento heb' filisteo t'a Belén.
Yujto ste takji sti' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Komonok ha ha ha' ay t'a sti'el chonhab' Belén swuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'anelta ha ha' heb' winh t'a ha' uk'b'ila' t'a sti'el chonhab' Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'o'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mokab' scha Dios wuk' ha ha' tik. Ichato ha' schik'il heb' winh tik swuk'ej tato swuk' ha', yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj yuk'ejlaj ha' winh. Haton jun tik ix sk'ulej heb' winh oxwanh te b'inajnak chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, yajal yaj winh t'a 30-xo heb' winh te b'inajnak. Ha t'a jun pekti', ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an sb'inajnakil winh t'a skal heb' winh 30 chi'.
Yuj chi' te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'. Ix och winh yajalok heb' winh, palta maj k'ek'och winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te b'inajnak pax winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Ha winh ix milancham chawanh soldado yuninal winhaj Ariel aj Moab. Haxo t'a jun'el ayik te ay k'e'en sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun jul. Hata' ix smilcham jun nok' choj winh.

Hanhejtona' ix smilcham jun winh aj Egipto winh. Nanhal am yoxil metro ste'el winh aj Egipto chi', haxo ste'al k'e'en slanza winh yet'nak, niwan spatik. Palta ha winhaj Benaía chi' anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh. Ix yik'ek' k'e'en slanza winh aj Egipto chi' winh, haxo yet' k'e'en slanza winh chi', ix smilcham winh.
Ha yuj juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' ix yik' wal sb'inajnakil winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el b'inajnak chi'.
Niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a yichanh heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj k'ochlaj icha heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'ji'och winhaj Benaía chi' yuj winhaj rey David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha heb' winh 30 b'inajnak chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Samot aj Harod, winhaj Heles aj Pelón,
winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa, winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot,
winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, winhaj Ilai aj Aho,
winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, winhaj Heled yuninal winhaj Baana aj Netofa paxi,
winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa ay t'a yol yik Benjamín, winhaj Benaía aj Piratón,
winhaj Hurai kajan t'a sti' ha' Gaas, winhaj Abiel aj Arba,
winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim, winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón,
heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén aj Gizón, winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Sage aj Harar,
winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sacar aj Harar paxi, winhaj Elifal yuninal winhaj Ur,
winhaj Hefer aj Mequera, winhaj Ahías aj Pelón,
winhaj Hezro aj Carmel, winhaj Naarai yuninal winhaj Ezbai,
winhaj Joel yuk'tak winhaj Natán, winhaj Mibhar yuninal winhaj Hagrai,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Berot. Ha jun winh chi' et'jinak syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
winhaj Urías hitita, winhaj Zabad yuninal winhaj Ahlai,
winhaj Adina yuninal winhaj Siza, yinhtilal Rubén, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal chi', 30 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh,
winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Maaca, winhaj Josafat aj Mitán,
winhaj Uzías aj Astarot, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Jehiel, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hotam aj Aroer,
winhaj Jediael yuninal winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Joha yuk'tak winh, aj Tiza heb' winh,
winhaj Eliel aj Mahab, winhaj Jerebai yet' winhaj Josavía. Ha heb' winh tik yuninal heb' winh winhaj Elnaam, winhaj Itma aj Moab,
winhaj Eliel, winhaj Obed yet' winhaj Jaasiel, aj Soba heb' winh.
Ayik wan spechji b'eyek' winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, ay jun nhilanh heb' winh jelan yak'an owal ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winh t'a Siclag.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh soldado chi' ay sjul-lab' heb' winh yet' ch'anh smejme'ech yet'nak. Syal sjulwaj heb' winh t'a schab'il sk'ab'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Haton heb' winh tik:

Ha winhaj Ahiezer sat yajal yaj winh yet' winhaj Joás yuk'tak winh, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Semaa aj chonhab' Gabaa, winhaj Jeziel yet' winhaj Pelet, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azmavet, winhaj Beraca yet' winhaj Jehú aj chonhab' Anatot heb' winh,
winhaj Ismaías aj Gabaón. Ha jun winh tik ayoch winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh 30 b'inajnak, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' winh, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Jahaziel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Jozabad aj Gedera,
winhaj Eluzai, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Bealías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Sefatías aj chonhab' Haruf,
winhaj Elcana, winhaj Isías, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Joezer yet' winhaj Jasobeam, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Coré,
winhaj Joela yet' winhaj Zebadías heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeroham aj chonhab' Gedor.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ayek' winh t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi' te jelan heb' winh, k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb' winh yak'an owal, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' k'e'en slanza. Te ow sat heb' winh icha nok' choj. Te jelan sb'ey heb' winh icha sb'ey nok' k'ultakil chej.

Ha sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal, scha'el t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh yuxluchil: Winhaj Ezer, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Mismana, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Jeremías yet' winhaj Macbanai.

Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha junok winh kennhej yopisio t'a skal heb' winh, yajal winh t'a junok 100 soldado, haxo junok winh niwan yopisio, yajal yaj winh t'a junok mil soldado.

Haton heb' winh ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán t'a b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ayik ix te k'e ha', wan yel ha' t'a stitak b'aj sb'eyi. Ha heb' winh ix pechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'lik ay t'a sk'axepaltak ha'.
Hanhejtona' ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Judá ix k'och yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David t'a k'e'en nhak'e'en chi'.

Ix elta winhaj David chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Tato t'a junk'olal tzex jawi, yik tzex kolwaj wet'ok, tzex hin cha t'a smasanil hin k'o'ol, palta tato tzex jawi yik tzin heyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'o'ol jun, wach'chom malaj junok tas chuk ix hin k'ulej, a'okab' ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham ol yil sb'a heyet'ok, syak'anoch heyahelal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Amasai yajalil heb' winh 30 soldado b'inajnak, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Skak' wal och ko b'a het'ok hach David yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ha hach tik yet' heb' ayoch het'ok, wach'nhej ol aj heyelk'ochi, yujto ha ko Diosal skolwaj wal het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix chaji heb' winh yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji yopisio heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado chi' yuj winh.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado yinhtilal Manasés, ix och heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh filisteo yak' owal yet' winhaj Saúl yalani. Haxo ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi', ix yalan heb' winh to max yal-laj sb'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix schek meltzaj winh heb' winh t'a Siclag. Yujto ix yal heb' winh icha tik: Haxo talaj tz'aji, ha yet' winhaj Saúl syak'och sb'a winh, yujto yajal winhaj Saúl chi' winh, ha honh xo tzonh smilcham winh t'a skal owal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ayik wan sjaxkan winhaj David t'a Siclag chi', hata' ix k'och heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés chi' yik syak'och sb'a heb' yet' winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Adnas, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Jediaiel, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Ziletai. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun mil soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'.

Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kolwaj yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um yujto te jelan heb' smasanil t'a owal. Ix och heb' winh yajalilok heb' winh soldado winhaj David chi'.
Junjun k'u sk'ib' sb'isul heb' winh soldado ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi'. Te niwan heb' winh, te ay pax smay heb' winh.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh soldado te jelan ix k'och t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal sk'exulok heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl yuj heb' winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová, haton heb' winh tik:
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 6 mil 800 soldado yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab', yet'nak pax slanza heb' winh, lista yaj heb' winh yak'an owal.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ay 7 mil 100 heb' winh soldado tek'an.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ay 4 mil 600 heb' winh soldado.
Ay pax 3 mil 700 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, ha winhaj Joiada ayoch yajalilok heb' winh.
Ha winhaj Sadoc kelem winh, te tek'an winh t'a owal. Ay 22 heb' sk'ab'yok winh, yajal yaj heb' winh, ajun heb' winh yet' winh.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Saúl, ay 3 mil heb' winh soldado ix k'och yet' winhaj David chi'. Ayik mantzak uji jun tik, ken manh masanilok heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ay 20 mil 800 heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te b'inajnak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 18 mil heb' winak ix chekjikoti yik tz'ak'jikanoch winhaj David reyal.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ix jawi 200 heb' winh yajal yet' pax masanil heb' winh soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh. Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak tik, snachaj wal el yuj heb' winh tas smoj sk'ulej chonhab' Israel.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ay 50 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal, syalnhej sk'anan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal heb' winh, b'ekan sk'o'ol heb' winh skolwaj yet' winhaj David chi'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ay mil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' 37 mil heb' winh soldado yet'nak slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay 28 mil 600 heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, ay 40 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.

Haxo t'a heb' ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ay 120 mil heb' winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' pax t'a nanhalxo yinhtilal Manasés. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'akan yaj heb' winh yet' masanil syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ha masanil juntzanh heb' winh soldado tik, ix ja heb' winh t'a Hebrón ayik ix yak'ankanoch winhaj David heb' winh sreyalok chonhab' Israel. Hanhejtona' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb' smasanil.
Oxe' k'uhal ix ek' heb' yet' winhaj David chi' ta'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', yujto ha heb' yetchonhab' heb' ix ak'an jantak tas ix swa heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'aniltak chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a najat, icha heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix yik'kot wa'el heb' kuchb'il yuj nok' b'uru, nok' camello, nok' mula yet' pax nok' wakax. Tzijtum makanhil wa'el ix yik'kot heb', icha ixim harina, takinh higo, takinh uwa, wino, aceite, nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Te niwan tas tz'ab'laj ix yik'kot heb', yujto manhxo jantakok tzalajk'olal t'a Israel chi'.
Ix lolon winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun nhilanh heb' winh soldado.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal icha tik: Hex wetisraelal, tato scha he k'o'ol, scha'anpax sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal, skawtej heb' ketisraelal ay t'a yol ko makb'en tik, heb' aytokan t'a juntzanhxo lugar. Skawtej pax masanil heb' sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita ayek' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slu'um b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',
yik wach' b'at kik'kot te' skaxa'il strato ko Diosal. Yujto atax t'a stiempo'al winhaj Saúl ix b'atkan te' satk'olal ku'uj, xchi winhaj David chi'.
Masanil heb' chonhab', ix cha sk'o'ol heb' to icha chi' tz'aji, yujto wach' jun pensar chi' ix yab' heb'.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj rey David t'a yol masanil smakb'en, skotnhej t'a ha' Sihor t'a smojonal Egipto, masanto b'aj tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Amat, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxa'il strato Dios t'a Quiriat-jearim,
skuchanpax Baala t'a yol yik Judá. Ix b'at yik'kot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová Dios chi' heb' ta', haton Dios ay t'a yib'anh heb' querubín b'aj tz'ik'chajcha'anh sb'i.
Ix yik'elta te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Abinadab, ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun te' ak' carreta. Haxo winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, ix kuchb'an b'ey te' carreta chi'.

Haxo winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal, ste tzalaj wal heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Yet' wal smasanil yip heb' sk'e cheneljok, sb'itan heb' yet' arpa, salterio, panderas, platillo yet' trompeta.
Palta ayik ix jawi heb' t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Quidón, ha winhaj Uza chi' ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxa'il trato chi', yujto ijan ix telwi nok' wakax tok'jinak te' carreta chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix chamkan winh ta' yuj, yujto ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxa'il trato chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj rey David chi', yujto ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a winhaj Uza chi', ix cham winh yuj. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'i'ejnhejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix te xiw winhaj rey David t'a Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: Tekan manhxo ol yal-laj wik'anb'at te' skaxa'il strato Dios b'aj kajan hin, xchi winh.
Majxo yik'kot te' winh b'aj kajan chi', anhej to ix yal winh to skan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.

Ha te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi', oxe' ujal ix kan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'. Ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix yak'kot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey David. Ix yak'anpaxkot heb' albañil winh yet' heb' nhikum te', ix yik'ankot te' k'ute' heb' yik sb'ochaj spalacio winhaj rey David chi'.
Yuj chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' to ha Jehová ix ak'anoch winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ix ik'jicha'anh yopisio winh yuj Jehová yujto xajan chonhab' Israel yuj.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj rey David ix yik' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil ix alji yet' heb' ix.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón,
winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Elpelet,
winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía,
winhaj Elisama, winhaj Beeliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok masanil heb' israel, ix och ijan heb' sayan tas tz'aj yak'an ganar, palta elanhchamel ix yab' winh, ix elta winh t'a yichanh heb' chi'.
Ix jawi heb' filisteo chi' yak' chukal t'a heb' anima kajan t'a sch'olanil Refaim.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj rey David t'a Dios icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo tik? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol hin k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ak' owal yet' heb', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj rey David b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Icha wal tz'aj sjakan sb'e junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ix aj sjakan b'e Jehová t'ayin t'a skal heb' wajk'o'ol, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix yak' winh sb'i'ej jun lugar chi'.
Ix yaktejkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey David chi' nhusjoktz'a'ok.
Palta ha heb' filisteo chi', ix jaxxi heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios, ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, manh hach och t'a sat heb' ak'an owal, palta to ha t'a spatik heb' tzach koti, b'aj ay te' bálsamo.

Ayik ol ab'ani ichato ay mach wan sb'eyek' t'a sk'ab'tak te te' chi', tzach och ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to ha hin ol hin b'ab'laj t'a heyichanh yik tzin milancham heb' soldado filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Dios, icha wal chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix satel heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix b'atnhej t'a Gabaón masanto ix k'och t'a Gezer.
Icha wal chi' ix aj sk'echa'anh sb'inajnakil winhaj rey David t'a masanil nación. Ha Jehová ix ak'an xiwk'e masanil nación chi' t'a winh.
Ix schekan winhaj rey David b'ochajk'e juntzanh pat t'a jun chonhab' skuch Schonhab' winhaj David. Ix sik'anel jun lugar winh b'aj tz'aj te' skaxa'il strato Dios t'a yol jun mantiado ix b'ochaji.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' manh levita'ok, max yal yik'anb'ey te' skaxa'il trato heb', yujto ha Jehová ix sik'anel heb' levita chi' yik syik'an b'ey te' kaxa chi' heb', yik tz'ak'jipax serwil yuj heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot masanil heb' yetisraelal winh, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'ilxo yuj winh.
Ix smolb'an pax masanil heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, 120 heb' ix molchaji, ha winhaj Uriel yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, 220 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Asaías yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, 130 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Joel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán, 200 heb' ix molchaji: Ha winhaj Semaías yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, 80 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Eliel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Uziel, 112 heb' ix molchaji, ha winhaj Aminadab yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.

Ix yawtan heb' winh sacerdote winhaj rey David chi', haton winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Abiatar yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Uriel, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Joel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eliel yet' winhaj Aminadab.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha hex levita hex tik, yajal heyaj t'a skal masanil heb' he k'ab' heyok, b'o'ek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' masanil heb' he k'ab' heyok, yik syal heyik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'il wu'uj.
Yujto ha t'a sb'ab'elal, manhok hex ix heyik'kot te', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh, yujto manh chamok ix ko k'anb'ej kab'i tas sko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley, yik wach' syal yik'ankot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová sDiosal Israel chi' heb' winh.
Ix sb'akhankot te' heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yet' te' sb'akhlab'il, icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' levita to ha t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', sik'chajelta heb' winh sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton salterio, arpa yet' platillo.

Yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal Leví chi' ix sik'chajel heb' winh stzinhan platillo, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán yuninal winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Asaf yuninal winhaj Berequías sk'ab'yok winhaj Hemán chi' yet' winhaj Etán yuninal winhaj Cusaías. Ha heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Merari. Ix sik'chajpaxoch juntzanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an te' arpa: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jaaziel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Uni, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Elifelehu, winhaj Micnías yet' heb' winh stanhwan puerta, haton winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel.
Haxo winhaj Quenanías yajalil heb' winh levita chi'. Ha winh skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', yujto te jelan winh.

Haxo heb' winh stanhwan te' skaxa'il trato: Haton winhaj Berequías, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jehías. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Eliezer. Haton heb' winh spu'an trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi'.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb' ayik ix xit' yik'an te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' heb' levita chi' ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', yuj chi' ix yak' ukwanh nok' mam wakax heb' yet' ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il.

Ha pichul lino te wach' ayoch yuj winhaj rey David chi', icha pax chi' yik heb' winh levita b'akhjinak te' kaxa chi' yet' yik heb' winh sb'itani yet' yik winhaj Quenanías skuchb'an heb' winh. Ay pax och jun chaleka nab'a lino yuj winhaj rey David chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix ik'jikot te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi', ix puchaj nok' ch'a'ak kalnel yet' trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo, salterio yet' arpa.

Ayik ix jawi te' skaxa'il strato Jehová chi' t'a Schonhab' winhaj rey David, haxo ix Mical ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winhaj Saúl, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentena. Ayik ix yilan ix to ha winhaj rey David chi', sk'echennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' ix schakel winh ix t'a spensar.

Ix ak'ji'och te' skaxa'il strato Dios chi' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'ilxok'e yuj winhaj rey David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanh silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan wach' lolonel winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' nok' chib'ej yet' juntzanh te' takinh sat uwa t'a junjun anima chi'.

Ix yak'ankanoch yopisio heb' winh levita winh yik smunlaj heb' winh b'aj ay te' skaxa'il strato Jehová, haton heb' winh chi' yowalil tz'ak'an yuj diosal, syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel t'a b'ital.

Ha mach skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', haton winhaj Asaf, haxo winh schab'il, haton winhaj Zacarías. Slajwi chi' skot pax winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel. Haton heb' winh chi' ay syamk'ab' yik b'it, ay salterio heb' winh, ay pax yarpa heb' winh. Haxo winhaj Asaf chi' stzinhan platillo.
Haxo pax heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Jahaziel, ha heb' winh spu'annhej k'e'en trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxa'il strato Dios.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' b'ab'elto ix yal winhaj rey David t'a winhaj Asaf yet' pax t'a heb' winh ayoch yet' winh to sb'itej juntzanh ak'oj yuj diosal tik heb' winh t'a Jehová:
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová. Kalekel yab'ixal. Kalek t'a masanil chonhab' tas ix sk'ulej.
Ko b'itejek b'it yuj kik'ancha'anh. Kalekel tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová.
Konh tzalajek yujto yik honhxo. Ayokab' tzalajk'olal yik skak'anem ko b'a t'ay.
Ko k'anek skolwal Jehová, kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.

Ha honh yuninal honh winhaj Jacob schekab' Jehová, ha honh chonhab' israel honh tik, to sik'b'il honh eli, ko na'ekkot tastak satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' tas syutej sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, Yajal t'a masanil sat lu'um tik.
Syak'nhej elk'och strato t'a masanil k 'inal. Ha tas yalnakkani, syak'nhej elk'och t'a smilal makanhil anima tz'ek'i,
haton jun strato sb'onak yet' winhaj Abraham, b'aj yak'nakpax sti' t'a winhaj Isaac.
Ley ajnakkan jun tik t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha jun strato tik ix kan t'ayonh ha honh israel honh tik t'a jun'elnhej,
ayik yalannakkan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' lum Canaán t'ayach, ol ochkan lum ha makb'enok, xchinakkan t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Jaywanhanto sb'isul heb' ta'. Tonhej skomon ek' heb' t'a sat lum lum tik.
Tzijtum chonhab' b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' t'a yoltak smakb'en heb' rey.
Manh yalnakoklaj sk'o'ol Dios ixtajnak heb', yuj chi' icha tik yalnak t'a juntzanh heb' rey chi':
Manh heyixtej heb' hin chekab' sik'b'ilel tik, xchi.
Konh b'itanek t'a Jehová ko masanil ha honh kajan honh t'a sat lu'um tik. Kalekeli to tzonh skolnhej Jehová t'a junjun k'u.
Kalekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulej t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a masanil nación.
Yujto ha Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay. Te ay spoder t'a yichanh juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha sdiosal juntzanh chonhab', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, palta ha Jehová b'o'annak satcha'anh.
Niwan chekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' sb'inajnakil. Ha swach'il yilji yet' spoder scheklaj t'a skajnub'.
Hex anima t'a junjun chonhab', alek to ha Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay yujto niwan yelk'ochi. Ochanhek yet' heyofrenda t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Ochanhek ejmelal t'ay t'a skajnub' te wach' yilji.
Ib'xokab'k'e masanil anima t'a yichanh. Ha' ix tzatzb'itan yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj.
Tzalajokab' satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Kalek yab' junjun chonhab' to ha Jehová rey toni.
k'anhokab' ha' mar, elokab' yaw masanil tas ay t'a yol ha'. Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum b'aj sb'o munlajel yet' masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Elokab' yaw te' niwak te' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto sja yak' yajalil t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach'nhej, tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek icha tik: Mamin, ko Kolumal hach, kolonh. Tzonh ha molb'anxikot t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok nacional, yik skak' yuj diosal, skalan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a tzalajk'olal.

Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a masanil tiempo ha honh israel honh tik, xe chi, xchi winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan masanil anima: Ujokab' icha tzal chi', xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', ha winhaj rey David chi' ix ak'ankanoch winhaj Asaf yet' heb' winh yetlevita'il yik syilannhej heb' winh yoch ejmelal b'aj ix kan te' skaxa'il strato Jehová t'a junjun k'u.

Ix kanpax winhaj Obed-edom yet' 68 heb' winh ajun yet' winh yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh. Haxo pax winhaj Obed-edom yuninal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hosa, ha heb' winh ix tanhwankan spatil chi'.
Ix kanpax winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' heb' winh yetsacerdote'al ajun yet'ok yik syilan heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Gabaón, haton jun anhej Jehová ay yiko'.
Ha heb' winh snhusan silab' t'a Jehová t'a masanil tiempo t'a altar, t'a k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil, icha wal yajkan t'a sley Jehová ak'b'ilkan yuj t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha yet' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix kan pax winhaj Hemán, winhaj Jedutún yet' pax jaywanhxo heb' winh sik'b'ileli yik sb'itan heb' winh, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, spu k'e'en strompeta heb' winh, stzinhan splatillo heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it t'a Dios. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jedutún chi' stanhwan ti' puerta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj meltzaj masanil heb' anima chi' t'a spat. Ix meltzaj pax winhaj rey David yik b'at yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan yet'ok t'a spat.

Ayik kajanxo'ek' winhaj rey David t'a yol spalacio ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Dios icha tik: --Ilnab'i, ha hin tik ayinxo och t'a yol hin palacio nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, palta haxo skaxa'il strato Jehová, ha t'a yol mantiado ayek'i, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Natán chi' icha tik: --Syalnhej ha b'o'an masanil tas tza nib'ej yujto ayoch Dios het'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winh hin chekab' aj David to ha hin Jehová hin swal icha tik t'a winh: Manhok hach ol ha b'ok'e junok hin templo b'aj ol hin kajnajok.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' he mam heyicham t'a Egipto masanto tikne'ik, manta b'aj tzin kajnaj t'a yol junok pat, palta to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado ix hin ajek'i.

Masanil tiempo ix hin b'eyek' yet' heb' he mam heyicham chi', malaj b'aj walnak t'a heb' yajalil heb' skuchb'ani to sb'o junok templo heb' nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay b'aj tzin kajnaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Tzalanpax t'a winh to ha hin swal icha tik: Ha hin Jehová Yajal waj t'a smasanil, ha hin swal icha tik: Ha hin ix hach wik'el t'a tanhwum kalnelal yik tzach och yajalil t'a hin chonhab' Israel tik.
B'ajtaktil ix hach ek'i ayinnhej och het'ok, ix hin satel masanil heb' ajk'o'ol ix ak'an owal het'ok, ol hach wak'an b'inajok, icha sb'inaj heb' niwak yajal ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Hanhejtona' ix hin sik'elta jun lum b'aj tzex kajnajkan ha hex hin chonhab' hex tik. Ha tik ol hex kannhej kajan t'a jun'elnhej. Manhxa mach ol hex xib'tanok, manhxo ol hex tzuntzaj yuj heb' heyajk'o'ol icha ix hex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix hex kuchb'ani. Ha hin ol hin satel masanil heb' heyajk'o'ol. Swak'anpax ojtakejeli to ol wak'nhej opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayik ol lajwokek' ha k 'inal, yik mukb'il hachxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal ha k'exulok, tek'an wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha jun uninal chi' ol b'o'ank'e hin templo b'aj ol hin b'inajok. Ha hin ol wak'nhejkan yopisio chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Ha hin ol hin och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Malaj b'ak'inh ol waktejkan hin xajanani. Manh icha'ok wutejnak waktankan hin xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'nakel winh t'a yopisio yik hach och sk'exulok winh, manh ichok ta' ol wutok.
Ol wak'nhej yopisio uninal chi' t'a hin chonhab'. Ha yopisio chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winh rey chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová hin Diosal, ¿tas wal welk'och ha hin tik? ¿tas pax wal yelk'och heb' hin mam wicham, yuj chi' niwan ha wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayin?

Hach hin Diosal, manhoknhej juntzanh tik ix ak' t'ayin, wan alanpaxkani to ol ak' ha wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winhtilal t'a b'ak'inh. Lajan tzin utej icha juntzanh heb' niwak winak t'a sat lu'um tik.
¿Tasto wal syal walan t'ayach yuj sniwanil welk'och tzak'a'? Ha hach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak wal tas waji.
Mamin Jehová, yujto tzin ha xajanej ha hin ha chekab' hin tik, yuj chi' ix el t'a ha k'o'ol, ix ak'an juntzanh opisio satub'tak tik t'ayin, ix ak'an wojtakejeli.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok. Ha hachnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha hach tik.

Ha honh pax ha chonhab' Israel honh tik, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan ket'ok, yujto ha hach ix honh ha kolo', yik tzonh ochkan ha chonhab'ok. Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, te niwan ix aj ha b'inaj ku'uj, yujto ha k'ulejnak tas satub'tak ayik ha kolannakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Ik'annakel juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yujto ix honh ak'och ha chonhab'ok t'a jun'elnhej. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, hach ochkan ko Diosalok.
Ha tikne'ik Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och tas ix alkan t'ayin ha hin ha chekab' hin tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal.

Elokab'k'och tas ix ala', yik wach' tzach ik'jicha'anh. Mamin Jehová, ol alchajok to ha hach Yajal aj t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal hach pax ha honh israel honh tik. Ol ochnhej pax winhtilal t'a reyal t'a jun'elnhej t'a ichanh.
Mamin hach hin Diosal, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ol ochnhejkan winhtilal t'a wopisio. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej hin b'a hin lesalwi t'ayach.
Ha hach tik Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal hach, ha hach ix alkan jun wach'ilal tik t'ayin.

Ha tikne'ik jun, elokab' t'a ha k'o'ol ak'an ha wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal, yik wach' ol ajnhej ek' heb' t'a ichanh. Ha hach ol ak' ha wach'k'olal t'a heb', ol scha'annhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' juntzanh tik, ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj winhaj rey David. Ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Gat winh yet' yaldea'il t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'e'en tumin t'a winh.
Hanhejtona' ix ak'jipax ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba ay t'a stojolal Hamat yuj winh. Ha jun winh rey chi' wan smakan yikok lum lum masanto t'a ha' Éufrates.

Ix yamchaj mil carruaje yik owal yuj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado. Ix yamchajpax 7 mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 20 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok. Ix spol t'inhchaj sch'anhal yok masanil nok' chej et'jinak carruaje yik owal chi' heb', haxonhej nok' sk'anchaj yik stok'an 100 carruaje ix kani.
Ix k'och heb' soldado sirio aj Damasco yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix miljicham 22 mil heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a skal heb' sirio aj Damasco chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'e'en tumin t'a winh. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winhaj David chi', ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Hanhejtona', ix yik'anpaxek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh ayoch oro t'ay sk'an heb' yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Niwan pax k'e'en bronce ix yik'ek' winh t'a Tibhat yet' t'a Cun, haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'. Haton yet' k'e'en bronce chi' ix sb'o jun niwan pila winhaj rey Salomón. Ix sb'o pax juntzanh niwak oy winh yet' masanil yamk'ab' nab'a bronce ix k'anchaj t'a templo.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Toi sreyal Hamat to toxo ix ak'ji ganar masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winhaj rey David,

ix schekankot jun yuninal winh, skuchan Adoram. Yet'nak k'e'en oro winh, k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en bronce yik tz'ak'ji stzatzil sk'o'ol winhaj rey David yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a winh, yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winh. Ha winhaj Toi chi' yak'nak owal winh yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ix yak' masanil juntzanh k'e'en chi' winhaj rey David t'a Jehová. Junnhej ix aj yak'an k'e'en winh yet' k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata yik'nakek' winh t'a juntzanh nación tik: Haton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a heb' filisteo yet' t'a heb' amalecita.
Yet' pax winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia, yajalil jun makan heb' soldado winhaj rey David, ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Edom yuj winh. 18 mil heb' ix smilcham winh t'a yak'likal Atz'am Atz'am.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a Edom chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' edomita ix ochkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey David chi'. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winh, ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Ha winhaj David, ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh, t'a stojolal ix sb'o yaj winh tas yaj heb' chonhab'.
Ha winh yajalil heb' soldado, haton winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia. Haxo pax winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sacerdote heb' winh, haxo winhaj Savsa, tz'ib'um ab'ix winh.

Ha pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' quereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo, haton heb' stanhwumal winh rey, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', yajal yaj heb' yik skolwaj heb' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto ha winh smam winh ix sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'o'ol winh yuj schamel winh smam winh chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita,

ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a ha k'o'ol to niwan yelk'och winh ha mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yujnhej chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil ha k'o'ol heb' winh? Ma'ay. Ix chekjikot heb' winh yuj winh yik syil heb' winh tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb' winh, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' winh schekab' winhaj rey David chi'. Ix joxji'el xil sti' heb' winh, ix polji'el yoktak sti' spichul heb' winh masanto ix k'e'ul t'a sti' syo'op heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tas ix aj heb' winh, ix schekanb'at scha'umal heb' winh yujto te k'ixwelal ix utaj heb' winh. Ix alji t'a heb' winh to skan heb' winh t'a Jericó masanto sk'ib'xi xil sti' heb' winh chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj paxta heb' winh.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix yak'b'at 660 quintal k'e'en plata winhaj Hanún chi' t'a Mesopotamia, t'a Siria, t'a Maaca yet' t'a Soba yik skot carruaje yet' heb' winh soldado et'jinak yet' heb' winh soldado ayk'e yib'anh nok' chej yik skolwaj yet' winh.

Ix stupanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Maaca yik skot winh yet' 32 mil carruaje yik owal yet' soldado. Ix sb'o'ank'e scampamento heb' ix tupchaj chi' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Medeba. Ix elpaxkot masanil heb' amonita chi' t'a yoltak schonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Ix yak' lista sb'a heb' amonita chi' t'a owal t'a yichanh schonhab' heb'. Haxo heb' winh rey ix yawtejkot heb' chi', ch'ok ix kan heb' winh t'a ak'lik.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab to ay heb' ajk'o'ol t'a yichanh yet' t'a spatik, ix sik'anel heb' soldado te jelan winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' ix yak'och winh yik skuchb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: Tato max honh tzak'wan t'a heb' sirio chi', elanhchamel tzex kolwaj ket'ok. Tato max hex tzak'wan t'a heb' amonita chi' jun, ha honhxo ol b'at honh kolwaj heyet'ok.
Tek'b'ej ha b'a, kak' owal yuj ko kolan heb' ketchonhab', haton schonhab' ko Diosal. Yak'okab' Jehová tas tz'el t'a sk'o'ol, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix el pax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai chi', ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joab chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' ay t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates yik skot heb' kolwal yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Sofac yajalil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer skuchb'an heb'.

Ix alchaj juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado Israel winh, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' heb' sirio chi'. Ix sb'o'anoch soldado winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an owal yet' heb'.
Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'. Ay 40 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok ix chami yet' 7 mil heb' ayk'e t'a yol carruaje. Ix champax winhaj Sofac chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix och heb' t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj rey David chi', ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Atax ta' majxo yal sk'o'ol heb' sirio chi' ix kolwaj yet' heb' amonita.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempo'al sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix kan winhaj rey David t'a Jerusalén, haxo winhaj Joab ix molb'anb'at heb' soldado yetisraelal yik syixtanb'at heb' tastak ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' amonita. Ix b'atnhej heb', ix yoymitan chonhab' Rabá heb', ix yak'an owal heb' yet'ok, masanto ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och winhaj rey David yik'kot scorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi'. Nab'a oro jun corona chi', tzijtum k'e'en k'e'en wach' yilji ayoch t'ay, ay am oxe'ok arroba yalil. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winhaj rey David chi'. Manh jantakok tas caro stojol ix yik' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo masanil heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel yet' k'e'en sierra, k'e'en pi'ocha yet' k'e'en ch'akab'. Hanheja' icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' amonita t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajkot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och jun owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gezer. Ha t'a jun owal chi', ha winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Sipai. Ha winhaj Sipai chi' yinhtilal winh heb' cha'anh ste'el. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' filisteo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel.

Ix och junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jair ix milancham winhaj Lahmi yuk'tak winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Te niwan spatik yok slanza winhaj Lahmi chi', icha am spatik te te' b'aj sb'ak'chajoch anh ch'al yik heb' sch'alwi.
Ix och junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay junxo winh winak ta' te cha'anh ste'el, lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh, yinhtilal pax winh heb' cha'anh ste'el.
Ha jun winh chi', ix b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey David chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh niwak winak chi', ha winhaj Réfah aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb' winh, palta ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado winh.
Ha winh Satanás ix och ajk'olal t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yak' winh sk'ulej winhaj rey David yik syik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado israel winh smasanil.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yet' pax t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ixikek heyik'cha'anh sb'isul heb' soldado. Sb'at he chakot t'a chonhab' Beerseba, masanto tzex k'och t'a chonhab' Dan. Ayik slajwi chi' tzeyik'ankot sb'isul heb' chi' t'ayin, yik swila' jantak heb' t'a smasanil.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --A'okab' Jehová tz'ak'an k'ib' sb'isul schonhab' masanto maxtzak yal sb'ischaji. Mamin rey ayoch heb' t'a yol ha k'ab' smasanil, ¿tas yuj tza nib'ej jun tik? Ha t'a jun tik ol och smul ko chonhab' tik hu'uj, xchi winh.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal winhaj Joab chi', yuj chi' ix b'at heb'. Ayik ix lajwi yik'ancha'anh sb'isul masanil heb' soldado Israel chi' heb', ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yak'an jantak sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado winhaj Joab t'a winhaj David chi', ay 470 mil heb' winh soldado yik Judá yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo smakb'en Israel ay jun millón yet' 100 mil heb' winh winak stiempo sb'at t'a owal.
Palta maj ochlaj heb' winh winak yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín sb'isulok, yujto maj scha sk'o'ol winhaj Joab jun scheknab'il winh rey chi'.
Maj schapaxlaj sk'o'ol jun chi' Dios, yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun yahelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.

Ichato chi' ix yalank'eta smul winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Te niwan hin mul ix ochi, yujto ix hin k'ulej jun tik, palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal jun hin mul tik, yujto icha junok kistal anima ix wutej hin b'a, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at il winhaj rey David, tzalan t'a winh to ha hin Jehová hin swal icha tik: Ay oxe' tas swak' ha sik'lej, ha hach ol ha sik'lej tas junok ol wak' t'ayach, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Gad chi' yil winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Sik'lej junok t'a skal juntzanh yahelal tik:

¿Tom ha' oxe' ab'il wejel, ma oxe' ujal ol yak' heb' ajk'o'ol hex smilanchamok, mato oxe' k'uhal ilya ol yak' t'a yol ha makb'en tik? Ha jun chi' wespada ha hin Jehová hin tik, yujto ha jun wángel ol satanel anima t'a yol ha makb'en tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' sik'lej tikne'ik yik wach' ol yal wak'an spak t'a Jehová, haton hin chekankoti, xchi winhaj Gad chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Gad chi' icha tik: --Maxtzak nachajlaj wu'uj tas tzin sik'lej. Wach' hama to ha Jehová tz'em sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, manhok anima swa sk'ab' t'ayin, yujto wojtak to niwan yok'elk'olal Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ilya Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', 70 mil heb' ix cham yuj.

Ix schekankot jun yángel Jehová yik satanel heb' anima t'a Jerusalén. Ayik wan satanel heb' anima chi', ix kusk'e sk'o'ol Jehová yuj jun yahelal chi', ix yalan t'a jun yángel wan smilancham anima chi' icha tik: Yechelxo chi', aktej, xchi t'ay. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', ha jun yángel Jehová chi', ay wal ek' b'aj wan stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo.

Haxo ix k'e k'elan winhaj rey David, ix yilan winh to ayek' jun yángel Jehová chi' t'a snanhal lum lum tik yet' satcha'anh, yet'nakk'e jun k'e'en espada, wan yak'anem k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yib'anh Jerusalén. Yet'nhej chi' ix em nhojan winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel masanto t'a sat lu'um, ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Mamin, ha hin wal ix wala' to tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'isul heb' chonhab' tik. Ha hin wal ix och hin mul. Malaj smul heb' anima tik. Mamin Jehová, hach hin Diosal, tzin tewi t'ayach to ha jun yahelal tik, ha t'a wib'anh yet' winhtilal tz'emi, manh ha satel ha chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Gad to syal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' to sb'ok'e junok altar winh b'aj stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' sb'ok'e jun altar yik tz'ik'jicha'anh sb'i Jehová, icha ix aj yalchaj chi'.
Ha winhaj Ornán yet' chanhwanh yuninal winh, wan stek'wi trigo heb', haxo ix yilan heb' to ayek' Yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix b'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ornán chi' to wan sk'och winh rey t'a slak'anil, ix elta winh b'aj wan stek'wi trigo chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tzok wal el t'a ha k'o'ol, tza chonh jun lugar b'aj tzach tek'wi trigo tik t'ayin, yik tzin b'ok'e junok altar t'a Jehová, yik tz'och wa'an jun ilya tik t'a kal chonhab' tik. Chonh t'ayin icha wal jantak stojol, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Ornán chi' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, syal hin si'an jun lugar tik t'ayach yik tza b'o'an tas snib'ej ha k'o'ol. Swak'anpax nok' toro yik tz'och nok' silab'il yet' te' tek'lab' tik syal yoch te' t'a k'atzitzal, haxo ixim trigo tik, syal yoch ixim t'a ofrenda'il. Mamin rey, masanil juntzanh tik swak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach yuj masanil juntzanh tik, palta ha hin tik yowalil ol hin tup juntzanh tik smasanil icha wal stojol, yujto max yal-laj wik'anek' ha tastak, swak'an silab'il t'a Jehová. Max yal-laj wak'an junok tas silab'il to manh ol hin tupu', xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smanan jun lu'um chi' winh rey chi' t'a 600 siclo k'e'en oro.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, ix snhusan silab' winh yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh jun silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a jun ángel chi' to syak'xi'em k'e'en yespada chi' t'a yol yatut.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj rey David to ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán chi', ix yak'an juntzanhxo silab' winh t'a Jehová ta'.
Wach'chom ha jun mantiado sb'onakk'e winhaj Moisés yikok Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' ay t'a Gabaón jun lugar cha'anh yik ejmelal,
palta maj yal-laj sb'at winhaj rey David ta' yik sk'anb'ej t'a Dios, yujto ix te xiw winh ayik ix yilan jun k'e'en espada winh yet'nak Yángel Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ha tik ol aj stemplo Jehová Dios yet' jun altar b'aj sko nhustz'a ko silab' ha honh israel honh tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to smolchaj masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a skal heb' israel. Ix sik'chajel heb' tzeyum k'e'en, haton k'e'en ol och t'a yik sb'ochaj stemplo Dios.
Niwan pax k'e'en hierro ix smolb'ej heb' yik tz'och k'e'en t'a lawuxal sk'anchaj t'a puerta. Niwan pax k'e'en bronce ix molb'aji, maxtzak yal-laj yechtaj k'e'en.
Niwan pax te' k'ute', maxtzak nachaji jantak sb'isul te' ix molchaji, yujto ha heb' aj Sidón yet' heb' aj Tiro te niwan te' k'ute' chi' ix yik'kot heb'.

Ix sna'a winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: Ha winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, te uninto winh, haxo pax jun stemplo Jehová ol b'o chi', te niwan ol ajok. Ol te b'inaj yuj swach'il yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' ha tikne'ik yowalil ol hin molb'ejkan tastak ol och t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ayik pitzanto winhaj David chi', te niwan tas ix smolb'ejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Salomón chi' winh, haton winh yuninal winh. Ix yalankan winh to ha winh ol b'o'ank'e jun stemplo Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Hach wuninal, nab'ilxo wal wu'uj to tzin b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak t'ayin icha tik: Ix wila' to ha hach tik, manh jantakok anima ix ha milchamok, manh jantakok pax owal ix ak'a', yuj chi' manhok hach ol ha b'ok'e jun hin templo chi'.

Palta ay jun uninal toto ol ajok, Salomón ol ak' sb'i'ej, malaj owal ol yak'a', yujto ha hin ol wak'och junk'olal t'a skal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha t'a stiempo'al chi' ol wak' junk'olal yet' tzalajk'olal t'a hin chonhab' Israel. Ha' ol b'o'ank'e jun hin templo chi'. Ol och wuninalok, ha hinxo ol hin och smamok. Ol wak'nhejkan yopisio t'a yinhtilal t'a chonhab' tik t'a jun'elnhej, xchinak Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' ha tikne'ik hach wuninal, a'okab' Jehová tz'ochnhej het'ok yik ol ha b'o'ank'e jun templo chi', icha ajnak yalan chi' hu'uj.
A'okab' Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an ha jelanil, yik wach' ayik ol ak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol ha k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il.

Wach'nhej ol ajelk'och smasanil, tato ol ha k'anab'ajej wal masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés ku'uj ha honh israel honh tik. Ak' ip, tek'annhej tzutej ha b'a. Manh ak' chab'ax ha k'o'ol, manh hach xiwok.

Ix wak' wal wip yik smolb'ajkan 66 mil quintal k'e'en oro yik tz'och t'a stemplo Jehová chi' yet' 660 mil quintal k'e'en plata yet' jun niwan b'ulanh k'e'en bronce yet' k'e'en hierro maxtzak yal yechtaji. Manh jantakok pax te te' ix hin chek molb'ajkanok yet' k'e'en k'e'en. Ha hachxo ol ak' tz'akwok.

Tzijtum heb' winh munlajwum ayek' t'a yol ha k'ab' ol munlaj het'ok, heb' tzeyum k'e'en, heb' albañil yet' heb' nhikum te'. Maxtzak b'ischaj jantak heb' winh winak te jelan t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal, icha t'a k'e'en oro, k'e'en plata, k'e'en bronce yet' t'a k'e'en hierro ol munlaj het'ok. Yuj chi' jun, ochokab' munlajel, ochokab' Jehová het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil to tz'och heb' winh yet' winhaj Salomón chi' t'a munlajel. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. Ha' ix ak'annhej junk'olal t'ayonh t'a masanil ko makb'en, yujto ha' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a yol hin k'ab', yuj chi' ix ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yet' t'a yol ko k'ab' ha honh schonhab' honh tik.

Yuj chi' ak'ek wal och t'a he k'o'ol heyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal. Tzeyak' wal och t'a he k'o'ol he b'o'ank'e templo b'aj tz'ik'jicha'anh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol ak'jokoch te' skaxa'il strato chi' t'a yo'ol yet' pax masanil syamk'ab'il jun templo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ayik te icham winakxo winhaj rey David, ix yak'ankanoch yopisio winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Salomón yik tz'och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.
Ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yuj winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita.
Ix schekan b'ischaj heb' winh levita winh, haton heb' winh winak ek'alxo t'a 30 ab'il sk'inal, 38 mil sb'isul heb' winh.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi', ix sik'chajel 24 mil heb' winh skuchb'an heb' smunlaji yik sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová. Haxo 6 milxo heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a juezal yet' t'a yajalilok chonhab' chi'.

Chanhe' mil heb' winh ix och stanhwumalok puerta. Chanhe' mil pax heb' winh ix och yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová, sk'anan jantak yamk'ab' yik b'it heb' winh, haton juntzanh yamk'ab' scheknak winhaj rey David chi' b'ojok yik sk'anchaj ta'.
Makkiltakil ix yutej heb' winh levita chi' winh, icha smam yicham junjun makan heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Laadán yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Laadán chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jehiel, winh b'ab'el yuninal winh, winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', oxwanh pax heb' winh: Winhaj Selomit, winhaj Haziel yet' winhaj Harán. Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal winhaj Laadán chi'.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jahat b'ab'el, winhaj Zina schab'il, winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería. Ha winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería chi', manh wal tzijtumok yinhtilal heb' winh yik stzak'wan heb' yilan yopisio, yuj chi' junnhej makan ix aj heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat, chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Amram chi', haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Aarón chi' ix sik'chajel yet' yinhtilal yuj Jehová t'a jun'elnhej, yik syil heb' tastak yiknhej Jehová yaji, yik snhusan incienso heb', skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och ejmelal yet' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Haxo pax heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios jun, ix och heb' stz'akub'ok heb' yetlevita'il.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Moisés, haton winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón chi', ha winhaj Sebuel yajal yaji.
Ha winhaj Eliezer chi' junnhej yuninal winh, haton winhaj Rehabías, winh yajal yaji. Haxo pax winhaj Rehabías chi', tzijtum yuninal winh.
Ha winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Izhar, yajal yaj winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hebrón: Haton winhaj Jerías winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Amarías winh schab'il, winhaj Jahaziel winh yoxil yet' winhaj Jecamán winh schanhil.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Uziel: Haton winhaj Micaía winh b'ab'el yet' winhaj Isías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari, haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis.
Ha winhaj Eleazar chi' malaj junok yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay, haton heb' ix chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cis.
Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi, oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jeremot.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Leví, icha syal smakanhil ix aj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh ek'alxo t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio t'a templo.
Ix yal winhaj rey David icha tik: Yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal ix honh ak'ankan kajan t'a tik ha honh schonhab' honh tik, ix kan pax skajnub' t'a Jerusalén tik,
yuj chi' ha heb' levita manhxo ol skuch b'eyek' smantiado Jehová heb' yet' pax jantak syamk'ab'il yik tz'och ejmelal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ha heb' winh yinhtilal Leví, ayik stz'akwi 20 ab'il sk'inal heb' winh, stz'ib'an sb'a heb' winh icha ajnak yalankan winhaj rey David t'a slajwub' slolonel.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix kan heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová, yik syilan yamak'il heb' winh yet' yoltak cuarto yet' yilan heb' winh sakb'itaj masanil yamk'ab' yiknhej Jehová yaji. Syilanpax juntzanh munlajel heb' winh t'a templo chi'.

Haton yik sb'ochaj ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová, syilan ixim harina heb' winh tz'ak'ji t'a ofrenda'il, ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, juntzanh ofrenda sb'ochaj t'a yol xalten yet' ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite. Syilanpax echlab' heb' winh sk'anchaj t'a ofrenda.
Hanhejtona' yowalil aynhejek' heb' winh t'a templo chi', yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb' winh yet' aloj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a junjun k'inhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil,

yet' yik snhuschaj silab' t'a Jehová t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, t'a sk'uhal k'inh ayik tz'alji k'e'en uj yet' pax juntzanhxo k'inh te niwak yelk'ochi. Tz'ak'winhej serwil heb' winh t'a Jehová icha jantak sb'isul heb' winh yet' munlajel ak'b'il sk'ulej heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh chi' stanhwanpax mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' skajnub' chi'. Smunlajpax heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová chi' icha yajkan t'a yib'anh yinhtilal heb' winh yuj tas yalnakkan heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yilan yopisio heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi'. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', b'ab'laj chamnak heb' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi'. Mantalaj yuninal heb' winh schamnak heb' winh chi', yuj chi' anhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix och sacerdote'al.
Makkiltak ix aj heb' winh sacerdote yuj winhaj rey David chi', yuj winhaj Sadoc yinhtilal winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Ahimelec yinhtilal winhaj Itamar.

Haxo ix yilan heb' winh to ha heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi' tzijtum sb'isul heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, yuj chi' 16 makan ix aj heb' winh, haxo heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi', wajxak makannhej heb' winh.

T'a sorteoal ix aj yochkan junjun makan heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, yujto ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar ay heb' winh niwak yajal sik'b'iloch t'a yopisio t'a templo t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' pax heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, ix sik' sorteo heb' winh t'a stzolal, jun yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi', jun pax yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smunlaj heb' winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Natanael yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví ix tz'ib'an sb'i heb' winh ayik ix sik'an sorteo chi' heb' winh. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sacerdote chi' yet' t'a skal heb' winh levita, testigo yajkan heb' winh.

Haton sb'i heb' winh tik ix kannhej t'a junjun makan t'a stzolal, icha syal sb'i heb' winh yajalil heb' winh ix sik'an sorteo chi', scha'el yich t'a heb' winh b'ab'el masanto t'a heb' winh slajwub', 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil: Winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Harim, winhaj Seorim, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Cos, winhaj Abías, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Secanías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Hupa, winhaj Jesebeab, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Imer, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Afses, winhaj Petaías, winhaj Hezequiel, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Gamul, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Maazías.

Haton heb' winh tik ix pojchajek' t'a stzolal t'a sacerdote'al yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a templo, icha syal sley Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, icha ajnak yalan t'a winhaj Aarón smam yicham heb' winh.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Leví tik: Haton winhaj Jehedías yinhtilal winhaj Subael, yinhtilal pax winhaj Amram.
Winhaj Isías b'ab'el t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Rehabías.
Winhaj Jahat yinhtilal winhaj Selomot, yinhtilal pax winhaj Izhar.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jerías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Jahaziel yet' winhaj Jecamán.
Winhaj Samir yinhtilal winhaj Micaía, yinhtilal pax winhaj Uziel.
Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Isías yuk'tak winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Jaazías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaazías chi': Haton winhaj Beno, winhaj Soham, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Ibri.
Chawanh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi': Haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis. Ha winhaj Eleazar chi', malaj yuninal winh. Haxo pax winhaj Cis chi', ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Jerameel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi chi': Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jerimot. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví.

Hanhejtona' heb' winh chi', t'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, icha ix sk'ulej heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Haton t'a yichanh winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh sacerdote, hata' ix och sorteo chi'. Lajannhej ix aj heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal winh b'ab'el winak yet' t'a skal yinhtilal winh tzak'anto.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, ix sik'el heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf heb', winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, yik skuchb'an heb' anima heb' ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Dios, yik syalanel slolonel Dios heb' yet' sonal arpa, salterio yet' pax platillo. Haton sb'i heb' ayoch t'a yopisio tik:

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Zacur, winhaj José, winhaj Netanías yet' winhaj Asarela. Ha winhaj Asaf chi' skuchb'an heb' winh. Ha winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios ayik syalan winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún, wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zeri, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Matatías yet' winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Jedutún chi' skuchb'an heb' winh, syalanpax slolonel Dios heb' winh yet' arpa yik tz'alji yuj diosal yet' yalchaj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a b'ital.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hemán, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Buquías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Sebuel, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Romanti-ezer, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Hotir yet' winhaj Mahaziot.

Ha heb' winh chi' yuninal heb' winh winhaj Hemán. Ha winhaj Hemán chi', schekab' Dios yaj winh, ha winh tz'ak'an razón t'a winh rey. 14 yuninal winh ix yak' Dios yet' oxwanh yisil winh, yik tz'elk'och sti' Dios yak'nak t'a winh, ayik yalannak to niwan ol ajelk'och winh.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', ha winh smam heb' winh skuchb'an t'a b'it yik tz'och ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton platillo, salterio yet' arpa. Ha winhaj Asaf, winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hemán ayoch heb' winh t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh rey.
Ha sb'isul heb' winh k'ayb'annak sb'itan t'a Jehová chi' yet' yinhtilal, 288 heb' winh t'a smasanil.
T'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh sb'itani, tz'och heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' heb' winh kelemtak, heb' winh k'ayb'umxo yet' heb' winh wanto sk'ayb'ani.

Ayik ix lajwi yoch sorteo chi', icha tik ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal, 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil. Lajchawanh sb'ey heb' winh t'a junjun makan, aynhej yuj sb'a heb' winh. Ha t'a skal junjun makan heb' winh, ay junjun heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh, haton heb' winh tik, scha'el yich t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh slajwub': Winhaj José, winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zacur, winhaj Izri, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Buquías, winhaj Jesarela, winhaj Jesahías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Simei, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Subael, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Hotir, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Mahaziot, winhaj Romanti-ezer.
