Palta ha hex tik, tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, manh heyak' chab'ax he k'o'ol, yujto ha Jehová ol paktzitan he munlajel tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Asa tas ix yal winh schekab' Dios chi', ix stek'b'an wal sb'a winh. Ix schekan winh ik'chajel masanil juntzanh komon Dios yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová ay t'a yol smakb'en Judá, t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' t'a yoltak juntzanh chonhab' ix yik'ek' winh t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Ix schekan winh b'ochajxi jun altar ay t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an masanil anima winh, heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá chi', t'a yol yik Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' kotnak t'a yol yik Efraín, t'a yol yik Manasés yet' t'a yol yik Simeón, haton heb' jawinak kajan t'a skal heb', yujto tzijtum heb' kajan t'a yol smakb'en winhaj Jeroboam ix jawi kajan t'a yol smakb'en Judá yujto ix yil heb' to ayoch Jehová Dios yet' winhaj Asa chi'.
Haxo t'a yoxil ujal yik 15 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa chi' reyal, ix smolb'an sb'a masanil heb' t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', ix yak' silab' heb' t'a Jehová. 700 nok' wakax yet' 7 mil nok' kalnel ix yak' heb'. Haton nok' chi' ix yik'kanek' heb' t'a heb' ajk'o'ol t'a owal.
Hata' ix yak' sti' heb' to anhej Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham, ol yak' serwil heb' yet' smasanil sk'o'ol.
Ix yak' pax sti' heb', tato ay mach to manhok Jehová Dios syak' serwil, wach'chom icham anima, ma unin, winak, ma ix, yowalil schami.
Ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix yak'an sti' heb' t'a Jehová, ix spu'an k'e'en strompeta heb' yet' nok' ch'a'ak.

Masanil heb' ay t'a smakb'en Judá chi' ix tzalaj wal heb' yuj b'aj ix yak' sti' chi' t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol heb' yak'an serwil Jehová. Yuj chi' ix kolwaj Jehová chi' yet' heb', junk'olal ix aj heb' yet' masanil chonhab' ay t'a slak'anil.

Hanhejtona', ix yik'anel yopisio ix Maaca winhaj Asa chi', haton ix snun chichim winh, yujto ix schek ix b'ojok jun yechel Asera te yajb'entak t'a yichanh Jehová. Ha winhaj Asa chi' ix chekan mak'jipoj jun yechel chi', chok' ix aji. Ix schekan winh nhusjitz'a t'a sti' ha' Cedrón.
Wach'chom maj yik'el juntzanh lugar winh yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh t'a Israel, palta k'anab'ajumnhej ix yutej sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'anoch masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata winh t'a yol templo, haton k'e'en ak'b'il t'a Jehová yuj winh yet' smam.
Malajnhej owal ix ochi, masanto yik 35 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal.

Ayik 36 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj Asa reyal, ix kot winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel yak' owal t'a Judá. Ix scha'anel yich winhaj Baasa chi' sb'o'anoch smuro'al chonhab' Ramá yik smakan b'e winh yik manhxa mach sk'och t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yik'elta masanil k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata winhaj rey Asa chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' k'e'en ay t'a spalacio winh, ix yak'anb'at k'e'en winh t'a winhaj Ben-adad sreyal Siria kajan t'a Damasco. Ix yalanb'at winh icha tik:

Ko b'o junok ko trato, icha yutejnak sb'a heb' winh ko mam. Tik swak'b'at k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata t'ayach. Ak' lajwok ha trato yet' winhaj Baasa sreyal Israel, yik wach' tz'och wa'an winh yak'an owal t'ayin, xchib'at winhaj Asa chi'.

Ix scha sk'o'ol winhaj Ben-adad tas ix yal winhaj rey Asa chi', yuj chi' ix schekankot juntzanh heb' soldado winh yet' heb' yajalil yik skot heb' yak' owal t'a juntzanh chonhab' yik Israel. Ix yak'an ganar chonhab' Ijón heb', chonhab' Dan, chonhab' Abel-na'im yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj sik'chajkan ixim trigo t'a yol yik Neftalí.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj Baasa chi', ix yaktan winh sb'o'ank'e Ramá chi' yuj skolan schonhab'.

Ix yik'anb'at masanil anima winhaj rey Asa chi', haton heb' ay t'a yol yik Judá, ix b'at yik'ankot k'e'en k'e'en heb' yet' te te' toxo ix smolb'ej winhaj Baasa b'aj wan sb'o'ank'e Ramá chi'. Haxo yet' juntzanh chi' ix sb'ok'e smuro'al chonhab' Geba yet' chonhab' Mizpa heb'.

Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix jawi jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Hanani t'a winhaj rey Asa chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' soldado yik Siria ix ak'och yipok ha k'o'ol, manhok Jehová, yuj chi' toxo ix el heb' t'a yol ha k'ab'.

¿Tom maxtzak ha nakoti ayik yak'annak owal heb' aj Etiopía yet' heb' aj Libia het'ok? Manhxo jantakok heb' soldado, nok' chej yet' jantak carruaje yik owal yet'nak heb', palta ak'nak ganar heb' yuj Jehová, yujto ha ak'nakoch yipok ha k'o'ol.

Yujto ha Jehová syilnhej masanil tas tzuji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, sch'oxan spoder t'a heb' tojol syutej spensar t'ay, tato syak'och heb' yipok sk'o'ol sik'lab'il. Haxo tikne'ik, ha jun tas ix ha k'ulej tik, lajan wal icha sk'ulej junok anima malaj spensar. Yuj chi', ha tikne'ik yet' ol b'eynhej tiempo, aynhej heb' ol ak'an owal het'ok, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh.

Ix kot yowal winhaj rey Asa chi' sik'lab'il t'a winh schekab' Dios chi', ix schekan winh ak'chajoch winh t'a preso. Hanheja' t'a jun pekti' chi', tzijtum heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix ak'ji'och syahelal yuj winh.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Asa, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' heb' sreyal Israel.

Ayik 39 ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal, ix och jun ilya te ow t'a yok winh, palta maj sna'a sb'a sk'o'ol winh yuj jun yahelal chi', manhok t'a Jehová ix yal sb'a winh, palta to ha t'a heb' anhtum b'aj ix b'at winh.
Ayik ix tz'akwi 41 ab'il yoch winh reyal, ix cham winh.

Ix mukji winh b'aj ix schek b'ojok yet'tal t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Niwan perfume ix yak'och heb' t'a yib'anh b'aj ix b'akhchaj sniwanil winh, ix och pax masanil makanhil tas suk'uk'i sjab' t'a winh, haton tas te wach' yaj sb'o'i. Ix yak'anoch jun niwan k'ak' heb' yik sch'oxanel heb' to niwan yelk'och winh t'a sat heb'.
Haxo winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Asa chi' ix och reyal. Ix stek'b'ej sb'a winh t'a yichanh Israel.

Ix yak'och heb' soldado winh t'a juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá. Ix aj heb' soldado t'a masanil yol smakb'en Judá chi' yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' ay t'a yol yik Efraín, haton juntzanh yik'nakkanek' winhaj Asa smam winh.
Ix och wal Jehová yet' winhaj Josafat chi', yujto ha tas sb'eyb'alejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh t'a sb'ab'elal, ha chi' ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Maj yak'laj serwil juntzanh yechel Baal winh,
palta to ha Jehová sDiosal smam yicham winh ix yak' serwil, ix sk'anab'ajej wal scheknab'il Dios chi' winh. Manhok sb'eyb'al heb' ay t'a chonhab' Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh.
Yuj chi' ha Jehová ix ak'an wal tek'k'aj winh t'a yopisio chi'. Masanil heb' aj Judá chi', ix si'ej tastak heb' t'a winh, yuj chi' ix te k'echa'anh sb'eyumal winh, te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh.
Ix yak' wal och winh t'a sk'o'ol sb'eyb'alan sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, ix schekan winh ik'chajel juntzanh yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh yet' masanil juntzanh yechel Asera t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Ayik yoxil ab'ilxo yoch winh reyal chi', ix schekanb'at juntzanh heb' winh sat yajal winh: Haton winhaj Ben-hail, winhaj Abdías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Natanael yet' winhaj Micaías yik sk'ayb'aj masanil heb' anima yuj heb' winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.

Ix b'atpax juntzanh heb' winh levita tik yet' heb' winh: Haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Asael, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Adonías, winhaj Tobías yet' winhaj Tobadonías, yet' pax heb' winh sacerdote, haton winhaj Elisama yet' winhaj Joram.
Ix chekjib'at heb' winh yet' ch'anh yumal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, yik sb'at k'ayb'aj heb' anima t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi' yuj heb' winh.
Yuj chi', masanil anima t'a juntzanh nación t'a slak'anil Judá chi', ix xiw heb' t'a Jehová, majxo stek'b'ej sb'a heb' yak'an owal yet' winhaj Josafat chi'.

Haxo ix aji, ay heb' filisteo ix ik'ankot tas yik si'ej heb' t'a winhaj Josafat chi', ix yik'paxkot k'e'en plata heb', icha k'e'en tumin tz'ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh heb' yak'ani. Yet' pax heb' árabe, ix yik'kot 7 mil 700 nok' ch'ak kalnel heb', icha pax chi' sb'isul nok' chiwa ix yik'kot heb'.

Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an yip yopisio winhaj Josafat chi'. Ix schekan winh b'ochajk'e juntzanh chonhab' tz'och smuro'al t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi' yet' juntzanh chonhab' b'aj sik'chajkan tastak swaji.
Manh jantakok tas swaji sik'an yuj winh t'a masanil yol smakb'en Judá chi', ay pax heb' soldado te jelan ayek' t'a Jerusalén.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado tik icha syal yinhtilal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Adnas yajal yaj t'a 300 mil soldado te jelan t'a yinhtilal Judá.
Haxo winhaj Johanán yajal yaj t'a 280 mil soldado.
Haxo winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Zicri, ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol winh yak'anoch sb'a yak'an serwil Jehová, ha winh yajal yaj t'a 200 mil soldado te jelan.
Haxo winhaj Eliada yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' te jelan t'a owal, 200 mil sb'isul heb', yet'nak sjul-lab' heb' yet' maklab' jul-lab' chi'.
Haxo winhaj Jozabad yajal yaj t'a 180 mil soldado lista yaj yet' syamk'ab' yik owal.
Masanil heb' tik ayoch heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh rey chi'. Manh ayok ochlaj heb' ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a yol yik Judá stz'akub'ok heb' tik.
Ha winhaj Josafat chi', ix te aj sb'eyumal winh, ix te b'inaj winh. Haxo ix yisil winhaj Acab sreyal Israel ix och yalib'ok winh.

Ix ek' jaye' ab'il, ix b'at winh t'a Samaria yil winhaj Acab chi'. Tzijtum nok' kalnel yet' nok' wakax ix schek winhaj Acab chi' miljokchamok yik tz'och k'inh yujto ix k'och winhaj Josafat yet' heb' ajun yet'ok. Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winh to tz'och winh yet' winh yik syak'an owal winh yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mamax yal ha k'o'ol tzach och wet'ok yik skak'an owal t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Josafat chi': --Ha hin tik ol hin b'at het'ok yet' masanil heb' winh hin soldado t'a owal chi'.
Palta ayik manto honh b'ati, ko k'anb'ej tas xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix schek winh sreyal Israel chi' molb'aj masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios, 400 sb'isul heb' winh smasanil. Ix sk'anb'an winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --¿Tzam kak' owal t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, ma to ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi heb' winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ak' owal chi', yujto ha Dios ol ak'anoch t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb' winh.
Palta ix yalan winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --¿Mama junok winh schekab' Jehová t'a tik yik sko k'anb'ej pax t'a winh? xchi winh.

Ix tak'wi winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ay jun winh t'a tik, syal sk'anb'an winh t'a Jehová ku'uj, haton winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla. Palta tzin chak wal jun winak chi', yujto malaj jun'elok ay jab'ok tas wach' syal winh t'ayin, chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh. Palta ix yalanxi winhaj Josafat chi': --Manh al jun chi', xchi winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot jun winh schekab' winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh: --B'at awtejkot winhaj Micaías yuninal winhaj Imla t'a elanhchamel, xchi winh.

Ha heb' winh rey chi' schawanhil, ayoch spichul heb' winh yik sreyal yuj, k'ojanem heb' winh t'a sk'ojnub' b'aj tz'ochk'och anima t'a yol chonhab' Samaria. Ayek' masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a yichanh heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Sedequías yuninal winhaj Quenaana, ay juntzanh k'e'en icha nok' ch'a'ak ix sb'o winh, te cha'anh ix yal winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha yet' juntzanh ch'a'ak tik ol ak' owal yet' heb' sirio, masanto ol lajwokel heb' smasanil, xchi winh t'a winhaj Acab chi'.

Ix yalanpax masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a chekab'ok Dios chi' t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: Ochanh ak' owal yet' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi', ol ak' ganar, yujto ha Jehová ol ak'anoch t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi heb' winh.

Ha winh chekab' ix b'at awtankot winhaj Micaías chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Masanil heb' winh schekab' Dios, wach'nhej ix yutej heb' winh yalan t'a winh rey chi'. Yuj chi' swal t'ayach, icha ix yutej heb' winh yalan chi', icha pax chi' tzutej halani, wach'nhej ol utej halani, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Swak' hin ti' t'a Jehová to anhej tas ol yal t'ayin, ha' ol wala', xchi winh.

Ix k'och winhaj Micaías chi' t'a yichanh winh rey chi', ix sk'anb'an winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Micaías ¿tzam yal kak'an owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, mato ma'ay? xchi winh. Ix stz'akan yal winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ixik ak' owal chi', ol ak' ganar, yujto ol ak'chajoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol ha k'ab', xchi winh.
Palta ix yalan winh rey chi' icha tik: --Tzijtum elxo ix wal t'ayach to tzak' ha ti' to anhej tas yel tzal t'ayin t'a sb'i Jehová, xchi winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Ix wil masanil heb' soldado israel, toxonhej sakleminak ix ajkanb'at heb' t'a jolomtak witz icha nok' kalnel manhxalaj stanhwumal. Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, manhxalaj yajalil heb', junk'olalokab' smeltzaj junjun heb' t'a spat, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --Inaton wal swal t'ayach, to ha jun winak tik malaj b'aj syal jab'ok tas wach' winh t'ayin, te chuknhej tas syal winh, xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: --Ab' wal tas syal Jehová t'ayach: Ix wila' k'ojanem Jehová t'a sdespacho, masanil heb' ángel t'a satcha'anh linhjab'och t'a spatik yichanh.

Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' icha tik: ¿Mach sb'at iptzitan winhaj Acab sreyal Israel, yik sb'at yak'an owal winh yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, yik schamkan winh ta'? xchi Jehová chi'. Ch'ok tas syal juntzanh heb', ch'ok pax tas syal juntzanhxo heb'.
Palta ay jun espíritu ix och t'a yichanh Jehová, ix yalan icha tik: Ol hin b'at wak' sk'ulej winh rey chi', xchi. Ix sk'anb'an Jehová chi' t'ay tas ol yutej.

Ix yalan icha tik: Masanil heb' winh syaloch sb'a ha chekab'ok, ol wak' yak' es heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', xchi. Ix yalan Jehová chi' t'ay icha tik: Ol yal uj icha chi', ixik, b'at k'ulej icha tzal chi', xchi t'ay.

Ha tikne'ik jun, ojtakejeli to ha Jehová ix cha'an sk'ulej heb' winh syaloch sb'a schekab'ok tik yik junnhej syutej heb' winh yak'an es t'ayach, icha chi' ol aj skotkan chamel t'a ib'anh, xchi winhaj Micaías chi'.

Yuj chi' ix snitzankot sb'a winhaj Sedequías chi' ix stz'itanb'at sat winhaj Micaías chi' winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha jun espíritu tz'esan ix kot t'a Jehová chi', ¿tas ix aj yel t'ayin, haxo t'ayach sloloni? xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Micaías chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ol ha nakot jun tik t'a jun k'u chi', haton yik toxonhej ol hach ek' tik ol hach ek' tik ha say b'aj ol ha k'ub'ejel ha b'a, xchi winh.
Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' icha tik: --Yamec winhaj Micaías tik, tzeyik'anb'at winh t'a winhaj Amón yajal t'a chonhab' tik yet' t'a winh wuninal aj Joás.
Tzeyalani to ha hin swala' to tz'och winh t'a preso, jab'nhej tas tzeyak' swa winh yet' tas syuk'ej winh, masanto ayik ol hin meltzaj t'a tzalajk'olal, xchi winh.

Ixto yal jay b'elanhxo winhaj Micaías chi' icha tik: Tato wach' tz'aj ha meltzaji, syalelk'ochi to manhok Jehová tz'alan t'ayin syal chi', xchi winh. Ix yalanxi winh: He masanil hex chonhab', na'anhejokab' heyu'uj tas ix wal tik, xchi winh.
Ix b'at winh sreyal Israel chi' yet' heb' soldado yet' winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ix yalan winh sreyal Israel chi' t'a winhaj Josafat chi' icha tik: --Ayik ol ko yamanoch owal chi', ol hin k'exel hin pichul yik hin reyal tik, ha hachxo tik, ol ak'nhejkanoch ha pichul yik ha reyal chi', xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix sk'exel spichul winh sreyal Israel chi', ix och heb' winh yak' owal chi' schawanhil.
Palta ha winh sreyal Siria, toxo ix yal winh t'a heb' winh sat yajal yaj t'a carruaje yik owal to max yak' owal heb' winh yet' junokxo mach, palta anhej t'a winh sreyal Israel b'aj tz'och heb' winh.

Ayik ix ilji winhaj Josafat yuj heb' winh sat yajal yaj chi', ha sna'an heb' winh to ha winh sreyal Israel chi', yuj chi' ix oymaj heb' winh t'a spatik winh, yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winh yalani. Yuj chi', ix el yaw winh, ix kolji winh yuj Jehová, ix ik'ji'el heb' winh yajal chi' yuj Jehová t'a winh.
Haxo ix yilan heb' winh to manhoklaj winh sreyal Israel chi', ix yaktan heb' winh syaman winh.

Palta ay jun winh soldado komonnhej ix julwajb'ati, ha wal t'a winh sreyal Israel chi' ix och sirnaj jun yol jul-lab' chi'. Ha wal b'aj schalaj sb'a sk'e'en pichul winh rey chi' ayochi, hata' ix och ch'apnaj jun yol jul-lab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh et'jinak carruaje chi' icha tik: --Ik' meltzaj carruaje tik, tzin ik'anel t'a skal owal tik, yujto te niwan ix hin aj hin lajwi, xchi winh.

Te ow ix aj yoch owal t'a jun k'u chi', ixto stek'b'ej sb'a winh sreyal Israel chi' skan tek'tek' t'a yol scarruaje ayik ayoch winh t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', masanto yik ix em k'u. Palta haxo yik wan sb'at pilnaj k'u, ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix meltzajxi winhaj Josafat chi' t'a spalacio t'a Jerusalén.

Ix elta winhaj Jehú schekab' Dios yuninal winhaj Hanani scha winh rey chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: ¿Tas yuj ix hach kolwaj yet' jun winh chuk spensar chi'? ¿Tas yuj wach' ak'an yet' jun winh ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová? Yuj chi' toxo ix kot yowal Jehová t'ayach.
Palta jun, ayto wal juntzanhxo tas wach' yoch ha wach'ilok, yujto ix ha satel yechel Asera t'a yol ha makb'en tik, ix ak'anpaxoch t'a ha k'o'ol ak'an serwil Dios, xchi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh.

Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan winhaj Josafat chi', palta ay jun smodo winh, to sb'at winh yil juntzanhxo schonhab', schakot winh t'a Beerseba, masanto sk'ek'och winh t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín. Tz'ek' winh yik syak'xi'och sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham.
Ix ak'ji'och heb' winh juez yuj winh t'a junjun chonhab' ayoch smuro'al ay t'a yol yik Judá chi'.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh juez chi' icha tik: Scham wal heyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto manhok tas snib'ej heb' anima ol he k'ulej, palta to ha wal tas snib'ej Jehová. Ol ochnhej Jehová chi' heyet'ok yik tze b'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima.

Yuj chi', niwanokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, scham wal heyilan tas ol he k'ulej, yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal, manh ol techaj yuj tato ay tas manh wach'ok ol he k'ulej, tato ay sk'exanhil anima t'a yol he sat, mato ol he cha k'e'en tumin t'a elk'altak, xchi winh.

Hanhejtona' ix sik'anpaxelta juntzanh heb' winh levita winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' juntzanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', yik tz'och heb' winh juezal yik sk'ayb'aj heb' anima chi' yuj heb' winh t'a sley Jehová yet' yik sb'o'an yaj yowal heb' anima chi' heb' winh t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ix yak'ankan juntzanh cheknab'il tik winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha hex tik, ol heyil heyopisio tik, ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, tze k'anab'ajani, wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a.

Yalnhej tas yaj yowal heb' ketchonhab' tik, ol jawok heb' t'ayex, ma yuj heb' ay t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', tato ha' yuj junok lolonel, ma yuj mak'ojcham anima, ma juntzanhxo tas tz'el sk'ulan heb' to manh icha'ok yalan sley Jehová, tze b'o yaj t'a heb'. Scham wal he kachan heb' yik max och smul heb' t'a Jehová, yik max kot yowal t'a heyib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb'. Wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yik manh ol och he mul.

Ha winhaj Amarías sat sacerdote yaji, anhej winh syal yalani tas ol aj sb'o tastak yik Jehová. Haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winhaj Ismael, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá, anhej winh syal yalan tas ol aj pax yik winh rey yaji. Ol kolwaj pax heb' winh levita heyet'ok. Tek'an tzeyutej he b'a, ak'ek heyip t'a heyopisio tik. Ha mach wach'nhej tas ol sk'ulej, ol ochnhej Jehová yet'ok, xchi winh.
Ix ek' jun pekti', ha heb' moabita yet' heb' amonita, junnhej ix yutej sb'a heb' yet' heb' me'unita yik syak'an owal heb' yet' Judá.

Yuj chi' ix jawi jaywanh winak yal t'a winhaj Josafat sreyal Judá icha tik: Ha t'a Edom yet' t'a junxo sk'axepal ha' mar Muerto, wan skot jantak soldado t'ayach. Ayxo'ek' heb' t'a chonhab' Hazezon-tamar, xchi heb' winh. (Ha jun chonhab' chi' skuchan pax En-gadi.)
Ix te xiw winhaj Josafat chi', ix sna'an winh to syak'och sb'a winh t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, yuj chi' ix yal winh to masanil anima t'a yol yik Judá tz'och t'a tzek'ojk'olal.
Ix kot masanil anima t'a junjun chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi' yik sk'anan skolwal Jehová heb' yet' winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan winhaj Josafat chi' t'a skal masanil heb' anima molanek' t'a Jerusalén chi', t'a yichanh jun ak' yamak'il stemplo Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Hach Jehová, ko Diosal hach yet' heb' ko mam kicham, ha hach tik sDiosal hach satcha'anh, Yajal hach pax t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab'. Te niwan ha poder, malaj junok mach syal stek'b'an sb'a t'a ichanh.

Hach ko Diosal, ha hach ik'nakel juntzanh anima kajan t'a sat lu'um tik, haton b'aj ayonh ek' ha honh ha chonhab' Israel honh tik. Ak'annakkan lum t'a jun'elnhej t'ayonh ha honh yinhtil honh kan winhaj Abraham tik, haton winh ha wach'k'o'ol.
Ayik kajnajnakxo heb' ko mam kicham t'a tik, sb'o'annakk'e jun templo heb' to ik yaji, yalannak heb' icha tik:

Tato sjawi junok yahelal t'a kib'anh ma junok owal sjawi yuj ko chukal, ma ilya, ma wejel, ol honh jawok t'a ichanh t'a ha templo tik, yujto ayach ek' t'ay. Ha t'a skal ko yahelal chi' ol ko k'an ha kolwal, ol ab'an tas ol ko k'ana', ol honh ha kolani, xchi heb'.

Ha tikne'ik jun, ina yajek' heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' kajan t'a tzalkixtak yik Seir, haton lum slu'um heb' b'aj maj yal ha k'o'ol ek'nakkot heb' ko mam kicham ha honh israel honh tik ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, to sk'exb'e'ejnak sb'a heb', maj satji'el-laj heb' anima chi' yuj heb'.
Haxo tikne'ik jun, ha tas tz'aj spakan jun chi' heb' t'ayonh, to snib'ej heb' syak' owal ket'ok yik tzonh yik'el heb' t'a lum lum ak'nak ko makb'enej tik.

Hach ko Diosal, elok wal t'a ha k'o'ol to tzak'och syahelal heb', yujto ha honh tik malaj kip yik sko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh jantak heb' soldado wan sjawi yak' owal t'a tik. Manh kojtakok tas wal sko k'ulej, yuj chi' ha t'ayach skak'och ko pensar, xchi winh rey chi' t'a Jehová.
Masanil heb' aj Judá, linhank'e heb' t'a yichanh Jehová yet' masanil yetb'eyum yet' yal yuninal heb', wach'chom heb' te kotakto.
Ay jun winh levita yinhtilal winhaj Asaf skuchan Jahaziel yuninal winhaj Zacarías, yixchikin winhaj Benaías yuninal winhaj Jeiel, yixchikin winhaj Matanías. Ix och Yespíritu Jehová t'a winh,

yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ab'ek wal hex aj Judá, hex aj Jerusalén yet' hach rey Josafat. Xchi wal Jehová icha tik: Manh hex xiwok, manh heyek xiw he b'a t'a yichanh jantak soldado chi', yujto ha jun owal chi', manh heyikok, palta wik ha hin Dios hin tik.
Ha k'ik'an tzex emk'och heyak' owal yet' heb'. Sk'e'ul heb' t'a lum switzal yik Sis, yik tze chalan he b'a yet' heb' t'a stitak ha ha' tz'ek' t'a tzinan lum yik Jeruel.

Manhok hex ol heyak' owal chi', palta tonhej ol hex aj ta', malaj tas ol he k'ulej, tonhej ol heyila' tas ol aj hex hin kolani, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' he masanil hex kajan hex t'a Jerusalén yet' t'a Judá, manh hex xiwok, manh heyek xiw he b'a. Tzex b'at k'ik'an chi', yujto ha Jehová ayoch ket'ok, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix em kumnaj winhaj Josafat chi', ix emk'och snanhal sat winh t'a sat lu'um, ix empax kumnaj masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ay juntzanh heb' levita yinhtilal winhaj Coat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coré, ix syamanoch heb' sb'itan t'a cha'anh, syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal Israel.

Haxo t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junxo k'u chi', ak'walto ix k'e wan heb' smasanil, ix b'at heb' t'a sb'e'al tzinan lu'um yik Tecoa. Ayik wan sb'at heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winhaj Josafat, ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: Ab'ek tas ol wal hex aj Jerusalén yet' hex aj Judá: Kak'ekoch Jehová ko Diosal yipok ko k'o'ol, malaj tas ol honh ik'anok, skak'anpaxoch heb' schekab' Dios tik yipok ko k'o'ol yik wach'nhej ol aj kelk'ochi, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ayik toxo ix lajwi slolon winh yet' heb' chonhab' chi', ix sik'anel juntzanh heb' sb'itan winh. Ix yak'anoch spichul heb' yik yopisio yik b'it. Ix b'ab'laj heb' yuj heb' soldado. Syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová t'a b'ital icha tik: Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb'.

Ayik ix scha'anel yich heb' sb'itan wach' lolonel chi' t'a tzalajk'olal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch somk'olal t'a skal heb' wan skot yak' owal yet' heb' aj Judá chi', haton heb' amonita, heb' moabita yet' heb' ix kot t'a tzalkixtak yik Seir chi'. Yuj chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb'.

Yujto ha heb' amonita yet' heb' moabita chi', ix och heb' yak' owal yet' heb' ix kot t'a Seir chi', ix lajwi'el heb' smasanil yuj heb'. Ixlajwi chi', haxonhej heb' ix yutej sb'a, ix satlanel sb'a heb'.
Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh winak yik Judá b'aj chekel lum tzinan lu'um, ix yilanb'at heb' winh to ha heb' ajk'o'ol chi' latz'anem heb' t'a sat lum schami, manhxa junok heb' ixto elkani.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Josafat yet' heb' soldado ajun yet'ok chi', yik sb'at sik'ancha'anh heb' masanil tas ix kan yuj heb' ajk'o'ol ix cham chi'. Ix ilchaj yamk'ab' yuj heb', pichul yet' juntzanhxo tas te caro stojol. Yuj chi' tzijtum tas ix yik' heb', palta ayto tas majxo tzak'wan heb' yik'ankoti. Ha jantak tas ix yik'kot heb' chi', oxe' k'uhal ix yak' heb' smolank'e'i.

Haxo t'a schanhil k'uhal, ix smolb'an sb'a heb' t'a jun ak'lik skuchan Beraca. Hata' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' spanhanil Beraca ix sb'i'ejkan jun lugar chi' yuj heb'. (Beraca syalelk'ochi aloj wach' lolonel.)
Ixlajwi chi', t'a tzalajk'olal ix b'ab'laj winhaj Josafat yuj heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, yujto ha Jehová ix ak'an jun tzalajk'olal chi' t'a heb' yujto ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Haxo ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' sonal salterio, te' cítara yet' k'e'en trompeta.
Ayik ix ab'chaji to ha Jehová ix ak'an owal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a heb' israel chi', ix te xiw masanil juntzanhxo nación t'a Dios chi'.
Junk'olal ix yak' reyal winhaj Josafat chi', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an junk'olal t'a skal winh yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a slak'anil chi'.
Ayik 35 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Josafat chi' ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá, 25 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén. Azuba sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Silhi.
Ha winhaj Josafat chi', wach'nhej ix yutej sb'a winh icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Asa smam winh. Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh, tojolnhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta ha juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal b'ajtak cha'anh, maj yik'el-laj winh, yujto manh masanilok heb' anima tek'anxo spensar yoch tzak'an yuj sDiosal heb' yet' smam yicham.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Josafat chi' ayik ix el yich, masanto ix lajwi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a yumal yik winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Hanani, junnhej yajkan yet' yumal yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel.
Haxo t'a slajwub'al sreyal winhaj Josafat chi', ix sb'o'an strato winh yet' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Israel. Ha jun winh rey chi', te chuk spensar winh.
Ix sb'o juntzanh te' barco heb' winh yik sb'at t'a chonhab' Tarsis. Ha t'a chonhab' Ezión-geber ix sb'o te' heb' winh.

Yuj chi', ha winhaj Eliezer aj Maresa yuninal winhaj Dodava ix halan jun lolonel tik t'a winhaj Josafat chi': Yujto junnhej ix utej ha b'a yet' winhaj Ocozías, yuj chi' ha Jehová chok' ol utanb'at masanil tas ix ha b'o tik, xchi winh. Yuj chi', chok' ix aj juntzanh te' barco ix sb'o heb' winh chi', majxo yal-laj sb'at te' t'a Tarsis chi'.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Josafat chi', ix mukchaj winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Haxo winhaj Joram yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ix ak'ji opisio yik reyal t'a winhaj Joram chi' yuj winh smam, yujto b'ab'el unin winh. Haxo heb' winh yuk'tak winh, haton winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Micael yet' winhaj Sefatías. Masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Josafat chi'. Manh jantakok k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata ix si'aj t'a heb' winh yuj winh smam chi' yet' juntzanhxo tas te caro stojol. Ix ak'chajpax chonhab' te wach' yajoch smuro'al t'a heb' winh, haton juntzanh ay t'a yol yik Judá.
Palta ha winhaj Joram chi', ayik ix tek'k'aj winh yet' yopisio chi', ix smilancham masanil heb' winh yuk'tak winh chi', ix smilpaxcham juntzanhxo heb' winh yajal winh t'a smakb'en chi'.
Ayik ix och winh reyal chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh, wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.

Anhej sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh yet' sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, yujto ha ix yetb'eyum winh, yisil ix winhaj Acab chi'. Te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Palta yuj sti' Jehová yak'nak t'a winhaj rey David to ol ochnhej yinhtilal winh reyal t'a masanil tiempo, yuj chi' maj yal-laj sk'o'ol Jehová ix satel heb' yinhtilal winhaj David chi'.
Ayik ayoch winhaj Joram chi' reyal, ha heb' aj Edom, ix yik'el sb'a heb' t'a yalanh smandar Judá, ix yak'anoch sreyal heb' sch'okoj.

Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado yet' pax carruaje yik owal yik skanxi heb' aj Edom chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb'. Palta ha heb' aj Edom chi', ix yoy sb'a heb' t'a spatik heb'. Haxo t'ak'walil ix k'e wa'an winhaj Joram chi' yet' heb' winh yajal yik carruaje yik syak'an owal heb'. Icha chi' ix aj sjakwi b'aj ix el heb'.

Ha heb' aj Edom chi', ix yak' ganar heb' yik'anel sb'a t'a yalanh smandar heb' aj Judá chi', ix elnhejkan heb'. Haton t'a jun pekti' chi' ix yik'paxel sb'a chonhab' Libna, yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová winhaj Joram chi', haton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh.

Ix sb'o'anxik'e juntzanh lugar yik ejmelal winh, haton b'ajtak cha'anh t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén pit ix yutej sb'a t'a Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj sjuwi'el spensar heb' aj Judá chi' yuj winh.

Yuj chi' hata' ix scha jun scarta winhaj Elías schekab' Dios winhaj Joram chi', b'aj syal icha tik: Ha Jehová sDiosal winh ha mam icham aj David, ha' tz'alan t'ayach: Manh wanok ha b'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al winhaj rey Josafat winh ha mam yet' sb'eyb'al winhaj Asa winh ha mam icham,

palta to ha sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel wan ha b'eyb'alani. Yuj chi' masanil heb' aj Judá yet' heb' aj Jerusalén, hu'uj pit syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin icha wal sb'eyb'al heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'. Hanhejtona' ix ha milpaxcham heb' winh uk'tak, ha heb' winh chi' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' winh t'a ichanh.
Yuj chi' ol wak'em jun yahelal t'a yib'anh ha chonhab' tik, t'a yib'anh heb' uninal, t'a yib'anh heb' ix etb'eyum yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'ayach.

Ha hachxo tik, ay jun ilya ol jawok t'a ib'anh. Ol och jun ya k'o'ol t'ayach, junjun k'u ol te niwtajok, masanto ol yal yelta ha ch'anh tza' yuj jun ilya chi', xchi Jehová, xchi jun scarta winhaj Elías chi'.
Yuj chi', ha Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' filisteo yet' heb' árabe kajan t'a slak'anil Cus, ix kot heb' yak' yowal yet' winhaj rey Joram chi'.

Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá, ix yak' ganar heb'. Ix yik'b'at masanil b'eyumal heb', haton ay t'a spalacio winh rey chi', ix ik'chajb'at masanil yuninal winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum winh. Haxonhej winhaj Joacaz slajwub' yuninal winh ix kani.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' masanil juntzanh chi', ix yak'anoch jun ilya Jehová t'a sk'o'ol winhaj Joram chi', manhxa yanhal.

Ix ek' tiempo, ayik schab'il ab'il yoch jun ilya chi' t'a winh, ix elta sch'anhtza' winh yuj. Te ya ix aj scham winh. Ayik ix cham winh chi', malaj junok niwan k'ak' ix yak'och heb' anima, yujto malaj yelk'och winh t'a yol sat heb', palta ayik schamnak heb' smam yicham winh, ochnak niwak k'ak' chi'.

Ayik ix scha'anel yich yak'an reyal winhaj Joram chi', 32 ab'il sk'inal winh. Wajxake' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Malaj mach ix na'an winh ayik ix cham winh. Ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' rey.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'och winhaj Ocozías heb' reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi', haton winh slajwub' yuninal winhaj Joram chi. Ha winh ix och reyal chi', yujto ha heb' árabe yak'nak owal heb' t'a Judá, milb'ilcham heb' winh b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb'.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ocozías chi' yak'an reyal, 22 ab'il sk'inal winh, junnhej ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Atalía sb'i ix snun winh, yixchikin ix winhaj Omri.

Ha winhaj rey Ocozías chi', ha sb'eyb'al winhaj Acab yet' yinhtilal ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ha ix snun winh chi' ix kuchb'an t'a chukal b'eyb'al chi', yujto yisil ix winhaj Acab chi', yuj chi' te chuk tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová. Ayik toxo ix cham winh smam winh chi', ha heb' sk'ab' yok winh chi' ix kuchb'an t'a chukal, yuj chi' ix juwi'el spensar winh t'a jun'elnhej.

Yujto ix sk'anab'ajej juntzanh pensar chi' winh, yuj chi' junnhej ix aj spensar winh yet' winhaj Joram sreyal Israel, haton winh yuninal winhaj Acab. Yuj chi' ix yak' owal heb' winh yet' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria t'a chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Palta ix lajwi winhaj Joram chi' yuj heb' sirio chi'.
Yuj chi' ix meltzajkot winh t'a Jezreel yik tzul yanhtan sb'a winh ta'. Te ya yaj winh, yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Ocozías yil winh t'a Jezreel chi'.

Ha Dios toxo ix sna'a to ayik ol k'och winhaj Ocozías chi' yil winhaj Joram chi', hata' ol cham winh. Ayik ayek' winh ta', ix elta winh yet' winhaj Joram chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh yet' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Nimsi, haton winh ix sik'ji'el yuj Jehová yik satanel masanil makanhil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Ayik wan smilancham heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab winhaj Jehú chi', ix ilchajelta heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Judá yet' heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj winh, ix smilancham heb' winh. Ha heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio heb' winh yet' winhaj Ocozías chi'.

Ix schekan winh saychaj ek' winhaj Ocozías chi', yujto ha t'a Samaria ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a winh, palta ix yamchaj winh yuj heb', ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a winhaj Jehú chi', haxo ta' ix miljicham winh yuj winh. Ix yalan heb' icha tik: Ko mukek winh, yujto yinhtilal winh winhaj Josafat, winh ak'jinak serwil Jehová t'a smasanil sk'o'ol, xchi heb'. Ha t'a skal heb' sk'ab' yok winhaj Ocozías chi', manhxa junok mach ix stek'b'ej sb'a yochkan reyal.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía to toxo ix cham winhaj Ocozías yune' ix chi', ix schekan ix miljokcham masanil heb' yinhtilal heb' winh sreyal Judá chi'.

Palta haxo ix Joseba, elk'altak ix aj yik'ankanel winhaj Joás ix t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ocozías wan smiljicham chi'. Ix sk'ub'anel winh ix t'a ix Atalía chi'. Ix b'at ix sk'ub'ejel winh t'a jun cuarto yik templo b'aj sway anima, haxo jun ix ix, ix ilan k'ib' winh ta'. Yuj chi' maj chamlaj winh. Ha ix Joseba chi' yisil ix winhaj Joram, yanab' ix winhaj Ocozías chi', yetb'eyum ix winhaj sacerdote Joiada.
Ha winhaj Joás chi', wake' ab'il ix k'ub'ajel winh t'a stemplo Jehová yet' jun ix ix, ix ilan k'ib'ok. Yakb'an chi' haxo ix Atalía chi', ayoch ix yajalil t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Ayik yukil ab'ilxo winhaj Joás chi', haxo winhaj sacerdote Joiada ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix schekan winh awtaj masanil heb' winh yajal soldado, haton heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun ciento heb'. Haton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Obed, winhaj Maasías yuninal winhaj Adaías yet' winhaj Elisafat yuninal winhaj Zicri. Ix yalan winh to junxonhej tz'aj spensar heb' winh yet' winh.

Haton heb' winh tik ix b'at t'a masanil yol yik Judá, yik b'at smolb'an masanil heb' winh levita heb' winh yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Israel, yik skot heb' winh smasanil t'a Jerusalén.

Masanil heb' winh ix smolb'ej sb'a chi', ix sb'o jun strato heb' winh yet' winh rey t'a stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ina winh yuninalkan winh rey chamnak. Haton winh yowalil tz'och reyal, icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' Jehová yuj heb' yinhtilal winhaj David.

Ha tikne'ik jun icha tik ol he k'ulej: Ha hex sacerdote hex tik yet' hex levita hex tik, ha hex ton tzeyil munlajel t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, ox makan ol hex ajok. Jun makan hex ol he tanhwej sti' stemplo Jehová.

Junxo makan hex ol he tanhwej sti' spalacio winh rey. Ha hexxo junxo makan hex, ol hex kan he tanhwej t'a spuerta'il cimiento. Haxo masanil anima, wach' skannhej heb' t'a yol yamak'il stemplo Jehová tik.

Palta malaj junok mach syal yoch t'a yol templo chi', anhej heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita ayoch t'a yopisio syal yochi, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' winh. Haxo masanil anima, skan heb' t'a yamak'il templo chi', icha yalan scheknab'il Jehová.

Ha hexxo levita hex tik, ol hex och hoyan t'a spatik winh rey, junjun hex heyet'nakokab' heyamk'ab' yik owal. Ha mach syak' pural yekanoch sb'a t'a yol templo chi', b'enhej schami. Ha hexxo tik, ajun hexnhej yet' winh rey chi' yalnhej b'aj sb'at winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ha heb' winh levita chi' yet' masanil heb' anima aj Judá chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' masanil tas ix yal winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' winh yajal soldado chi', ayek' heb' winh yet' heb' ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh, haton heb' smunlaj t'a yopisio t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, yujto maj chaji'el-laj heb' yuj winhaj Joiada chi' ayik sk'och yora'il yel heb'.
Ix yak'anpax k'e'en lanza winhaj Joiada chi' yet' maklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun ciento heb' soldado chi', haton juntzanh syamk'ab' winhaj rey David aykan t'a stemplo Dios.

Ix ak'chajoch masanil heb' winh winak chi' yuj winh t'a stzolal, junjun heb' winh yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, yik stanhwan winh rey chi' heb' winh. Ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a schanh pak'anhil yamak'il stemplo Jehová chi' yet' b'aj ay jun altar yet' t'a spuerta'il templo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ha winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' yet' heb' yuninal ix ik'anelta winh yuninalkan winh rey chi'. Ix yak'ank'e scorona winh heb', ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios heb' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e aceite heb' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan heb' to reyxo winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj masanil anima yalani: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko rey, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía chi' yel yaw heb' anima chi' yek'i, syak'an b'inaj winh rey chi' heb', ix b'at ix t'a stemplo Jehová chi'.

Haxo ix yilan ix, ha winh rey chi' linhanoch winh t'a jun niwan yoyal sti' stemplo Jehová chi', haxo t'a stz'ey winh ayek' heb' winh yajal yaji yet' heb' winh spu'an k'e'en trompeta. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb'. Ay heb' spu'an k'e'en strompeta, ay pax heb' sb'itan yet' syamk'ab', haton heb' skuchb'an b'it chi' yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios. Yuj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Pechum hex el yajal ha hex tik. Pechum hex el yajal, xchi ix.

Palta ha winhaj Joiada chi' ix chekan elta heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun ciento heb' soldado, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ik'ekel ix b'aj tzolan hex och chi'. Yalnhej mach syak'och sb'a yet' ix, tze xikchamok, xchi winh. Toxo ix yal winhaj Joiada chi' to manhok t'a stemplo Jehová smiljicham ix.
Ix syaman ix heb' winh, ix yik'anel ix heb' winh t'a spuerta'il yik nok' schej winh rey, hata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'an jun trato winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' yet' masanil heb' anima chi' yet' winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová.

Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Baal, ix b'at spojanem heb', ix smak'anpaxpoj altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel komon Dios. Haxo winhaj Matán sacerdote yik Baal chi', ha t'a yichanh altar chi' ix smilcham winh heb'.

Ix yak'ankan juntzanh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi' winhaj Joiada chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' winh sb'o'an munlajel ak'b'ilkan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David. Haton yik snhusji silab' tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová icha yalan ley tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés. Ay pax heb' sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal icha yutejnakkan winhaj rey David chi'.
Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' stanhwan sti' stemplo Jehová chi' winh, yik wach' max och heb' anima manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley.

Ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Joiada chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yet' pax masanil anima chi'. Ix yik'anelta winh rey chi' heb' t'a stemplo Jehová, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a spalacio heb' rey. Ix och heb' t'a jun puerta t'a yib'anh. Ix yak'ankanem k'ojan winh heb' t'a sk'ojnub' heb' winh rey chi'.
Masanil heb' anima, ix te tzalajk'e heb', yujto toxo ix xikjicham ix Atalía. Yuj chi' junk'olal ix ajkan jun chonhab' chi'.
Ha winhaj Joás chi', uke' ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal. 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Sibia sb'i ix snun winh, aj Beerseba ix.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Joás chi', yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi', te wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha winhaj Joiada chi' ix sayan chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj Joás chi', ay yalyuninal winh yet' heb' ix.
Ix ek' jab'ok tiempo, ix sna'an winhaj rey Joás chi' to sb'ochajxi stemplo Jehová.

Yuj chi' ix smolb'ej heb' winh sacerdote winh yet' heb' winh levita, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixikek t'a masanil chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá tik, sb'at he molb'an k'e'en tumin, haton k'e'en syak'taxon heb' ketchonhab' tik t'a junjun ab'il yik sb'ochajxi stemplo Dios tik. Ak'ek wal heyip he b'ati, xchi winh. Palta maj yak'och wal heb' winh t'a sk'o'ol sb'ati.

Yuj chi' ix awtaj winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada yuj winhaj rey Joás chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj max ak'och t'a ha k'o'ol iptzitan heb' winh levita yik sb'at yik'kot k'e'en ofrenda heb' winh t'a yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, icha yalnakkan winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová to masanil heb' ketisraelal smolan k'e'en tumin yik sb'ochaj skajnub' skaxa'il strato Jehová? xchi winh rey chi'.

Yujto ha ix Atalía yet' heb' ochnak tzak'an yuj ix, ix ixtanb'at stemplo Jehová chi'. Ha juntzanh yamk'ab' niwak yelk'och yik templo chi', ha ix sk'an heb' yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a jun komon Dios Baal.
Yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey Joás chi' b'ochaj jun te' kaxa, haxo t'a sti'elta stemplo Jehová ix schek winh ak'chajkan te'.
Ix schekan winh alchajel t'a masanil yol yik Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén chi' to tz'ik'chajkot k'e'en ofrenda alb'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um.
Masanil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' masanil anima, t'a wal smasanil sk'o'ol heb' ix yak'em yofrenda t'a yol jun kaxa chi', masanto ix b'ut'ji te' yuj heb'.

Haxo heb' winh levita tz'ik'anb'at te' kaxa chi' t'a winh rey chi', haxo yik syilan winh to b'ut'anxo te', tz'awtaj winh stz'ib'um winh yet' jun winh ayoch yopisio yuj winh sat sacerdote. Sekanelta k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a yol te' kaxa chi', sb'at yak'anxikan te' heb' winh b'aj aykan chi'. Icha chi' syutej heb' winh t'a junjun k'u, yuj chi' niwan k'e'en tumin chi' ix molchaji.

Ha winh rey chi' yet' winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' ix yak' k'e'en tumin chi' heb' winh t'a heb' winh ayoch yilan munlajel sb'o t'a stemplo Jehová chi', yik saychaj heb' winh mak'umpoj k'e'en, heb' winh nhikum te', heb' winh smunlaj t'a k'e'en hierro yet' t'a k'e'en bronce, yik wach' sb'ochajxi templo chi'.
Yuj chi' ha heb' winh tz'ilan munlajel chi', ha heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh swach' b'o'anxi templo chi'. Ix sb'o heb' winh icha wal yajtaxon t'a yichb'anel, te wach' ix ajxikan sb'o yuj heb' winh.

Haxo yik ix lajwi sb'o'el yuj heb' winh, ix yik'anb'at k'e'en tumin heb' winh ixto kani, ix yak'an k'e'en heb' winh t'a winh rey yet' t'a winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi'. Haxo yet' k'e'en ix schek winh rey chi' b'ochaj yamk'ab' yik templo chi', haton juntzanh sk'anchaji ayik tz'och ejmelal yet' juntzanh sk'anchaj t'a altar yuj silab' snhusjitz'a'ok, icha k'e'en niwak cuchara yet' juntzanhxo yamk'ab' nab'a oro, ma plata. Yakb'an pitzanto winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi', snhusjitz'anhej silab' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Palta ix ichamwinakax winhaj Joiada chi', 130 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.

Ha t'a schonhab' winhaj David ix mukji winh, haton b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey. Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh te wach'nhej yuj swach'ilok heb' yetisraelal, wach' ix yutej winh yak'an serwil Dios yet' t'a stemplo.

Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Joiada chi', ix jawi heb' winh yajal yaj t'a Judá, ix em nhojan heb' winh t'a winhaj rey Joás chi' yik smontan winh heb' winh. Haxo ix aji, ix och t'a spensar winh tas ix yal heb' winh chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yaktejkan stemplo Jehová heb', haton sDiosal smam yicham heb'. Haxo t'a yechel komon Dios Asera ix och heb' ejmelal yet' t'a juntzanhxo komon Dios. Yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a heb' aj Judá chi' yet' t'a heb' aj Jerusalén chi'.
Ix schekkot heb' schekab' Jehová yik tzul yalan heb' to smeltzajxi heb' t'a Jehová chi', palta majxo schalaj yab' heb' tas ix yal heb' chekab' chi'.

Yuj chi', ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Zacarías yuninalkan winhaj Joiada chi'. Ix k'e linhan winh t'a jun lugar cha'anh, ix yalan winh t'a masanil anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová Dios tz'alan icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max he k'anab'ajej hin cheknab'il? ¿Tas yuj tze saykot heyahelal t'a heyib'anh? Yujto ix hin heyaktajkani, yuj chi' ol hex waktejpaxkani, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta ix och heb' ajk'olal smasanil t'a winh, ix sna'an heb' tas tz'aj smilancham winh heb'. Ix yalan winhaj rey Joás chi' to sjulk'enajcham winh t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Icha chi' ix aj scham winh.

Ha winhaj Joás chi', majxo snakotlaj jantak swach'k'olal winhaj Joiada chi' ix yak' t'a winh, palta to ix schek miljokcham winhaj Zacarías winh, haton winh yuninal winhaj Joiada chi'. Ayik wan scham winhaj Zacarías chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: A'okab' Jehová tz'ilan jun tik, ha' ol ak'an yowalil, xchi winh.

Ayik ix el yab'ilal scham winh, ix jawi heb' soldado sirio yak' owal yet' winhaj Joás chi'. Ix jawi heb' t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén. Tzijtum heb' yajal yaj t'a Judá chi' ix smilcham heb'. Ix yik'anek' masanil tas ay stojol heb', ix yak'anb'at heb' t'a winh sreyal Damasco.

Jaywannhej heb' soldado sirio ix jawi yak' owal chi', haxo Jehová ix ak'anoch jantak heb' soldado yik Judá chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb', yujto ix aktajkan Jehová chi' yuj heb', haton sDiosal heb' yet' heb' smam yicham. Icha wal chi' ix aj yab'an sya'il winhaj Joás chi' yuj chukal ix sk'ulej.

Ayik ix el heb' sirio t'a yol yik Judá chi', te niwan ix ajkan winhaj Joás chi' slajwi yuj heb'. Haxo heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix sna' heb' winh tas syutej heb' winh swach' milancham winh, yik syak'anek' spak schamel winh yuninal winhaj sacerdote Joiada chi' heb' winh. Yuj chi' ix swach' milejcham winh heb' winh t'a sat sch'at. Ixlajwi chi', ix mukji winh t'a schonhab' winhaj David, palta manhok b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey.
Ha heb' winh ix wach' milancham winhaj Joás chi', haton winhaj Zadad yune' ix Simat aj Amón yet' winhaj Jozabad yune' ix Simrit aj Moab.

Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Joás chi' yet' heb' yuninal winh yet' lolonel ix yal heb' schekab' Dios t'a winh yet' yab'ixal b'aj swach' b'o'ejxi stemplo Jehová winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh rey. Haxo winhaj Amasías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik 25 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Amasías ix och winh reyal, 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Joadán sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach' t'a yichanh Jehová, anhej to maj sk'ulej wal winh t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Ayik ix tek'k'aj yopisio winh chi', ha heb' winh ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix smilcham heb' winh, haton heb' winh miljinakcham winh smam winh.

Palta maj miljicham heb' winh yuninal heb' yuj winh, yujto tz'ib'yajkan t'a ley Moisés, b'aj syal Jehová: Ha heb' mamab'il, max yal scham heb' yuj smul yuninal, max yal pax scham heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam, yujto junjun mach scham yuj smul, xchikani.

Ix schekan winh to smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' winh aj Judá yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín. Makkiltakil ix aj heb' winh t'a junjun yinhtilal. Icha chi' ix aj yoch heb' winh yajalil t'a junjun mil yet' t'a junjun cien anima. Ix yik'ancha'anh sb'isul anima winh, scha'el yich t'a heb' 20 ab'il sb'eynhejb'ati. Ha sb'isul heb' ix k'e wa'an chi', 300 mil, haton heb' stiempo'alxo sb'at t'a owal, lista yaj heb' yet' slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ix smajnan 100 mil heb' soldado yik Israel winh, 75 quintal k'e'en plata ix yak' winh stojolok heb'.
Palta ay jun winh schekab' Dios ix k'och t'a winh, ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Hach rey, manh ik'och heb' soldado yik Israel yet' heb' yik Efraín het'ok, yujto manh ayokoch Jehová yet' heb',

wach'chom tza na'a to yuj heb' ay yip heb' ha soldado t'a owal, palta ha Dios ol hach ak'an ak'jok ganar yuj heb' ajk'o'ol chi', yujto ay spoder skolwaji, ay pax spoder satanel masanil, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ix sk'anb'an winhaj Amasías chi' t'a winh schekab' Dios chi' icha tik: --Palta, ¿tas ol aj pax 75 quintal k'e'en plata ix wak' t'a heb' soldado israel chi' jun? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová syal yak'an ek'alokxo icha k'e'en chi' t'ayach, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix chekji pax heb' soldado ix kot t'a yol yik Efraín chi' yuj winhaj Amasías chi', palta ix te kot yowal heb' t'a heb' yik Judá chi', yuj chi' te yowal heb' ayik ix pax heb' chi'.
Ix stek'b'an sb'a winhaj rey Amasías chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' soldado t'a spanhanil yik Atz'am Atz'am. Hata' ix smilcham 10 mil soldado aj Seir heb'.
Hanheja' ix syam pax 10 mil heb' aj Seir chi' heb', ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb' t'a sjolom jun lum witz sattak k'e'en yek'i. Hata' ix laj yumjikanb'at heb' yuj heb', chok' ix laj ajkan heb'.

Haxo heb' soldado yik Israel maj chajokb'atlaj yuj winhaj Amasías t'a owal chi', haton heb' ix chekjikan meltzaj t'a spat, ix satel jaye' chonhab' heb' t'a yol smakb'en Judá, schab'at t'a Samaria masanto t'a Bet-horón. Ix smilancham 3 mil anima heb', tzijtum tastak ix yelk'ejb'at heb'.

Ayik ix meltzaj winhaj Amasías chi', ayik toxo ix satel heb' aj Edom yuj winh, haton heb' aj Seir, ix yik'ankot juntzanh skomon diosal heb' aj Seir chi' winh, ix yak'anoch winh sdiosalok. Ix yalan sb'a winh t'ay, ix snhusan pax incienso winh t'ay.

Yuj jun chi' ix kot wal yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix schekkot jun winh schekab' yal t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tzach och ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios maj yal skolanel schonhab' t'a yol ha k'ab'? xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'.

Ayik wanto yalan juntzanh chi' winh schekab' Dios chi', ix tak'wi winh rey chi' icha tik: --¿Tom ix wal t'ayach to ha hach ol ak' hin razón ha hin rey hin tik? Aktej halan juntzanh chi'. ¿Mato tza nib'ej tzach miljichamok? xchi winh. Haxo winh schekab' Dios chi' manhxa tas ix yal winh, haxonhej ix yal winh t'a winh rey chi' icha tik: --Wojtak ha hin tik to nab'ilxo yuj Dios to ol hach satelok, yujto ix ha k'ulej jun tik, maj ha k'anab'ajej tas ix wal t'ayach, xchi winh.

Ha winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá chi', ix sk'anb'ej yab' winh t'a juntzanh heb' ak'um razón. Yuj chi' ix schekan winh b'at alchaj t'a winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz, yixchikin winhaj Jehú, sreyal Israel, ix yalan winh icha tik: Kotanh, kak' owal, xchib'at winh.

Ix spakanpaxkot winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ayab' jun te' sak k'i'ix t'a Líbano, ix yalb'at te' t'a jun te' k'ute' ay pax ta' icha tik: Ak' ix isil yetb'eyumok winh wuninal, xchib'at te'. Palta ay jun nok' chi'um nok' ix ek' ta', haxo nok' ix tek'anem jun te' k'i'ix chi'.

Ha hach tik tzala' to ix ak' ganar heb' aj Edom, yuj chi' tzik' wal cha'anh ha b'a, tza say tas tz'aj ik'jicha'anh. Palta te wach' tato tzach kannhej t'a ha pat. ¿Tas yuj tza nib'ej tzik'kot junok yahelal t'a ib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Judá? xchikot winhaj Joás chi' t'a winh.

Palta haxo winhaj Amasías chi', maj schalaj yab' winh, yujto toxo ix sna'a Dios to ol ak'jokoch winh t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Joás chi' yuj, yujto ha t'a juntzanh sdiosal heb' aj Edom chi' tz'och winh ejmelal.
Ixlajwi chi' ix kot winhaj Joás chi' yak' owal yet' winhaj Amasías chi', ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a Bet-semes, t'a yol smakb'en Judá chi'.
Ix ak'ji ganar Judá chi' yuj heb' aj Israel, yuj chi' ha heb' soldado aj Judá chi' toxonhej ix el lemeljok heb', ix paxkan heb' t'a spat.

Ix yamchaj winhaj Amasías sreyal Judá t'a Bet-semes chi' yuj winhaj Joás winh sreyal Israel chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'chajkot winh t'a Jerusalén. Ix smak'ankanem lanhnaj smuro'al jun chonhab' chi' heb' israel chi'. Ay am 180 metro'ok ix spojem heb', ix b'atnhej t'a puerta yik Efraín, masanto ix k'och t'a spuerta'il schikin jun smuro'al chi'.

Ix yik'anpaxb'at k'e'en oro heb', k'e'en plata yet' juntzanhxo tas ay t'a yol stemplo Dios, haton juntzanh stanhwej heb' yinhtilal winhaj Obed-edom. Ix yik'paxb'at jantaknhej b'eyumal ay t'a spalacio winh rey chi' heb'. Ix yik'anpaxb'at juntzanh anima heb' icha preso'al ayik ix pax heb' t'a Samaria. Ix ak'ji pural winhaj Amasías chi' yuj winhaj Joás yochkan wach'k'olal yet'ok.
Ha winhaj Amasías yuninal winhaj Joás sreyal Judá chi', 15 ab'ilto ix yak' reyal winh t'a Judá ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Joás yuninal winhaj Joacaz sreyal Israel.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj Amasías chi', ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Judá yet' heb' winh sreyal Israel.

Atax wal yik ix yik'anel sb'a winhaj Amasías t'a Jehová, ay juntzanh heb' aj Jerusalén chi' ix na'an smilcham winh. Yuj chi' ix b'atkan winh elelal t'a chonhab' Laquis, palta ix b'atnhej heb' t'a spatik winh t'a jun chonhab' chi', hata' ix cham winh yuj heb'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yik'anb'at sniwanil winh heb' t'a yib'anh jun nok' chej, haxo b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham winh ix mukchaji, haton t'a schonhab' winhaj David.

Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Amasías chi', haxo winhaj Uzías ix yak'och heb' aj Judá reyal sk'exulok winh smam chi'. Ayik ix scha'anel yich winh yak'an reyal, 16 ab'il sk'inal winh. 52 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jecolías sb'i ix snun winh, aj Jerusalén ix. Ayik ayoch winh reyal ix sb'o'anxik'e chonhab' Elat winh, ix kanxi yikok Judá.
Masanil tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Uzías chi', wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová, icha sk'ulejnak winhaj Amasías smam winh.

Ix yak' wal och spensar winh t'a Dios yakb'an pitzanto winhaj Zacarías. Ha winhaj Zacarías chi' ix k'ayb'an winh t'a tas syutej sk'anab'ajan Jehová. Yakb'an ix sk'anab'ajej winh, wach'nhej ix ajelk'och winh yuj Jehová.

Ha winhaj Uzías chi', ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh soldado yak' owal yet' heb' filisteo, ix smak'anem lanhnaj smuro'al chonhab' Gat heb' winh, Jabnia yet' Asdod. Ix sb'o'ank'e juntzanh chonhab' heb' t'a yol yik Asdod chi' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' yik heb' filisteo chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' winh ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' heb' filisteo chi' yet' heb' árabe kajan t'a Gur-baal yet' heb' amonita.
Ix yak'an k'e'en tumin heb' amonita t'a winh, haton k'e'en ix ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh heb' yak'ani. Ix yak'nhej yajalil winh masanto t'a smojonal Egipto, yujto ix yik' wal yip yopisio winh chi'.

Ix sb'oxik'e juntzanh b'aj tz'aj heb' soldado winh t'a yib'anh smuro'al Jerusalén chi' yet' t'a yib'anh spuerta'il t'a schikin yet' t'a yib'anh puerta t'a ch'olan yet' t'a juntzanhxo schikintak. Te wach' ix aj sb'o'anxik'e winh.

Ix sb'o'anpax juntzanh yet'tal heb' winh soldado winh t'a tzinan lu'um yet' pax b'aj tz'aj heb' soldado chi' t'a cha'anh. Ix schekanpax winh joychaj jantak ha uk'b'ila', yujto te niwan nok' smolb'etzal nok' winh t'a ak'liktak yet' t'a yichtak witz. Ay pax heb' smunlajwum winh smunlaj t'a awoj uwa yet' t'a juntzanhxo awb'en ay t'a tzalkixtak yet' t'a lum ak'liktak. Te ay wal och t'a sk'o'ol winh smunlaj t'a tas tz'awchaji.

Ay pax jun niwan nhilanh heb' soldado winh, ayik sb'at heb' t'a owal, pojkiltak yaj heb', icha tas makanhil yajek' sb'i heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Jeiel winh tz'ib'um yet' winhaj Maasías yajal. Ha winhaj Hananías sat yajal yaj t'a heb', ayoch yopisio winh yet' winhaj rey Uzías chi'.
Haxo masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' winh soldado chi' icha tas yinhtilal heb', ay 2 mil 600 heb'.
Haxo heb' soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb', ay 307 mil 500 heb', listaxo yaj heb' sb'at t'a owal, te tek'an heb' skolwaj t'a winh rey chi' yik syak'an owal winh yet' heb' ajk'o'ol.
Ix schekan winhaj rey Uzías chi' b'ojok juntzanh syamk'ab' heb' soldado chi': Haton maklab' jul-lab', k'e'en lanza, k'e'en xumpil, maklab' nhik'o'ol, yol jul-lab' yet' mejme'ech.

Ix sayan juntzanh heb' winh winak winh te jelan yik sb'o'an juntzanh k'e'en niwak máquina yik owal. Ix b'ochaj k'e'en b'ajtak ayk'e heb' soldado t'a cha'anh t'a yib'anhtak muro. Ha juntzanh k'e'en máquina chi', ha k'e'en sjulanb'at k'e'en niwak k'e'en. Ix te pukaxb'at yab'ixal winh t'a najat. Ix och wal Dios yet' winh, yuj chi' te ay smay ix aj sb'inaj winh.

Palta ayik ix tek'k'aj wal yopisio winh chi', ix yik'ancha'anh sb'a winh. Yuj chi' ix yik'kot winh t'a yib'anh. Ix spitej sb'a winh t'a Jehová Dios, haton sDiosal heb' smam yicham winh. Ix och winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová, ix snhusan incienso winh t'a altar.
Tzak'an yoch winhaj sacerdote Azarías yuj winh yet' pax 80 heb' winh sacerdote yik Jehová. Manh jab'ok ix xiw heb' winh yochi.

Haxo yik ix k'och heb' winh t'a winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik t'a winh: Mamin rey Uzías, ha hach tik manh opisio'ok ha nhusan incienso t'a Jehová, palta ha honh sacerdote honh yinhtilal honh winhaj Aarón tik, ha honh sik'b'ilonhkanoch t'a jun opisio tik. Yuj chi' mamin rey, wach' tzach el t'a jun lugar tik, yujto toxo ix och ha chukal t'a Jehová, yuj chi' manhxo ol hach ik'jokcha'anh yuj, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Ha winhaj rey Uzías chi', ayik linhan och winh t'a stz'ey jun altar yik incienso t'a yol templo chi' yet'nak jun chaynub' yik incienso winh. Ix kot wal yowal winh t'a heb' winh sacerdote chi', haxo wal t'a jun rato chi' ix elta yab'il lepra t'a snanhal sat winh.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj sat sacerdote Azarías yet' heb' winh ajun yet' winh chi' to toxo ix elta yab'il lepra t'a snanhal sat winh rey chi', ix yik'anelta winh heb' winh t'a elanhchamel. Ix snib'ej pax winh rey chi' tz'elta t'a elanhchamel, yujto toxo ix jawi yahelal t'a yib'anh winh yuj Jehová.

Ix kannhej jun lepra chi' t'a winhaj rey Uzías chi' masanto ix cham winh, yuj chi' sch'okoj winh ix aj t'a jun pat, majxo chajokochlaj winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová. Haxo winhaj Jotam yuninal winh ix ochkan sk'exulok, yik skan winh t'a spalacio yik syak'anpax yajalil winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Uzías chi', ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Isaías schekab' Dios, winh yuninal winhaj Amoz.

Ayik ix cham winh Uzías chi', ix mukji winh t'a smakb'en b'aj smukchaj heb' winh rey. Yujto ay lepra t'a winh, yuj chi' maj yal smukchaj winh t'a yet'tal heb' winh rey chi'. Ixlajwi chi' haxo winhaj Jotam yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi', 25 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix och winh reyal. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Jerusa sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Sadoc.

Ha tas ix sk'ulej winhaj Jotam chi', wach' t'a yichanh Jehová icha ix sk'ulej winhaj Uzías smam winh. Palta maj ochlaj winh t'a yol stemplo Jehová icha ix yutej sb'a winh smam winh chi'. Haxo masanil anima, te chuk tas ix sb'eyb'alej heb'.
Ha winhaj Jotam chi' ix chekan b'ojok jun spuerta'il templo t'a yib'anh. Tzijtum tas ix schek winh b'ojok t'a yib'anh smuro'al chonhab' b'aj mukb'il jun ch'olan.
Ix schekan winh b'ochajxik'e juntzanh niwak chonhab' t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Judá yet' yet'tal heb' winh soldado cha'anh yajk'e b'aj stanhwej heb' winh t'a kaltak te'.

Ix yak' owal winh yet' heb' amonita, ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ha t'a jun ab'il chi', ix yak' k'e'en tumin heb' ix ak'ji'och t'a yib'anh yak'an t'a winh. Ix yak' 75 quintal k'e'en plata heb' yet' 37 mil quintal ixim trigo. Hanheja' icha pax chi' ixim cebada ix yak' heb'. Icha chi' ix sk'ulej heb' t'a oxe' ab'il.
Te tek'an ix aj winh t'a sreyal chi', yujto te wach' sb'eyb'al winh t'a yichanh Jehová.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey Jotam chi' yet' tastak sk'ulejnak winh yet' jantak owal yak'nak winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' winh sreyal Israel yet' Judá.
Ayik ix och winh t'a reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh yet' heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj David. Ixlajwi chi', haxo winhaj Acaz yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.

Ayik ix och winhaj Acaz chi' reyal, 20 ab'il sk'inal winh. 16 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén, palta manh wach'ok tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yichanh Jehová, maj sk'ulej winh icha tas sk'ulejnak winhaj David smam yicham winh.
Ha sb'eyb'al heb' winh sreyal Israel ix sb'eyb'alej winh. Ix schekan winh b'ochaj k'e'en k'e'en yechel komon Dios Baal.
Ix snhusan incienso winh t'a sch'olanil yik Ben-hinom, ix snhusanpaxtz'a yuninal winh silab'il icha wal schuk b'eyb'al juntzanh chonhab' ix ik'ji'el yuj Jehová t'a yichanh heb' israel t'a lum chi'.
Hanhejtona', ix snhus pax silab' winh yet' incienso t'a juntzanh lugar b'ajtak cha'anh yet' t'a yichtak te te' k'ayum xi'il.

Yuj chi' ix ak'ji'och winh yuj Jehová sDiosal t'a yol sk'ab' winh sreyal Siria. Te niwan anima ix ik'jib'at t'a Damasco yuj heb' sirio chi'. Hanheja' ix ak'jipaxoch winh yuj Jehová t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Peka yuninal winhaj Remalías sreyal Israel. Ha t'a jun k'u, 120 mil heb' soldado te tek'an yik Judá ix smilcham heb', yujto ix yaktejkan Jehová sDiosal heb', haton sDiosal smam yicham heb'.

Ay jun winh soldado te tek'an t'a yinhtilal Efraín skuchan Zicri, ha winh ix milancham winhaj Maasías yuninal winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Azricam yajal t'a spalacio winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Elcana sat yajal yuj winh rey chi'.

Wach'chom yetchonhab' sb'a heb' yet' heb' israel chi', palta ix ik'jib'at 200 mil heb' yuj heb', haton heb' ix ix, heb' winak unin yet' heb' ix unin, ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a Samaria. Manhxo jantakok pax tas ix yik'b'at heb' israel chi'.

Ha t'a Samaria chi', ay jun winh schekab' Dios skuchan Obed. Ix elta winh scha heb' soldado wan sk'ochxi t'a Samaria chi'. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' icha tik: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal, sDiosal pax heb' ko mam kicham, ix kot yowal sk'o'ol t'a Judá, yuj chi' ix yak'och heb' t'a yol he k'ab'. Palta ha hexxo tik ix he milcham heb' yet' wal yowal he k'o'ol to ix k'e wal k'och t'a satcha'anh.
Haxo tikne'ik, tze na'a to tzeyak'och heb' aj Judá tik yet' heb' aj Jerusalén tik heyak'umalok serwil. Palta ¿tom malaj pax he mul ha hex tik t'a yichanh Jehová?
Ha tikne'ik, ab'ek tas ol wala': Ak'ek meltzaj masanil heb' ketisraelal ix heyik'kot chi' t'a tik, yujto ay wal kot yowal Jehová t'ayex, xchi winhaj Obed chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ay jaywanh heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Efraín, haton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Berequías yuninal winhaj Mesilemot, winhaj Ezequías yuninal winhaj Salum yet' winhaj Amasa yuninal winhaj Hadlai, ix och heb' winh t'a sat heb' winh wan sjax t'a owal chi'.

Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: --Manh heyik'kot heb' chi' t'a tik, yujto ha jun tik tz'och ko mulok t'a Jehová. ¿Tom tze say tas tz'aj swach' och ko mul t'ay? Te niwanxo ko mul tz'ochi, yuj chi' skot wal yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
Yuj chi', ix aktajel masanil heb' ix ik'jikot yuj heb' soldado chi' yet' pax masanil tastak ix yik'kot heb', ix yak'ankan heb' t'a yichanh heb' yajalil chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh masanil anima.

Haxo heb' winh ix b'inaj sb'i tik, ha heb' winh ix tanhwan heb' ix ik'jikot chi'. Ha t'a skal masanil tastak ix yik'ek' heb' soldado chi', hata' ix k'eta pichul ix ak'ji'och t'a heb' b'eraneli. Ix ak'ji'och xanhab' heb', ix ak'ji wa heb', ix yuk'an pax ha' heb'. Ix ak'ji'och aceite t'a heb' echen yaji. Haxo heb' maxtzak yal-laj sb'eyi, ix ak'jik'e heb' t'a yib'anh nok' b'uru yuj heb'. Ix kot heb' winh yajal chonhab' Samaria chi' yak'xikan heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' t'a Jericó, haton b'aj te ay te' palma. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajxi heb' winh t'a Samaria chi'.
Ha t'a jun pekti' chi', ix schekb'at heb' schekab' winhaj rey Acaz t'a winh sreyal Asiria, yik sk'anan kolwal winh t'a winh.
Yujto ha heb' aj Edom ix jawi heb' jun'elxo yak' owal t'a heb' aj Judá, ay heb' anima ix yik'b'at heb'.

Yakb'an chi' haxo heb' filisteo, ix ik'anpaxb'at tastak ay t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yichtak witz yet' t'a Neguev t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Bet-semes heb', Ajalón, Gederot, Soco, Timna yet' Gimzo yet' yaldea'il junjun juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Ixlajwi chi' haxo heb' filisteo chi' ix kajnaj ta'.
Emnakil ix ajkan heb' aj Judá chi' yuj Jehová, yujto ha winhaj Acaz sreyal heb', ha winh ix kuchb'anb'at heb' t'a chukal, ix spitej wal sb'a winh t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix jawi winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria chi' t'a Judá, maj kolwajlaj winh, palta to ix wach' lajwi'el yuj winh.

Wach'chom ixto smolb'ejelta juntzanh tastak caro stojol ay t'a stemplo Jehová winhaj Acaz chi' yet' tastak ay t'a spalacio winh yet' tastak ay t'a spat heb' winh yajal yaji, ix yak'an winh t'a winh sreyal Asiria chi', palta nab'anhej, majxo kolwaj jab'ok winh yet' winh.
Wach'chom niwan yahelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh winhaj Acaz chi', palta hanheja' ix ochnhej smul winh t'a Jehová.

Ix yak'an silab' winh t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' aj Damasco. Yujto toxo ix ak'ji ganar winh yuj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha juntzanh sdiosal heb' sirio tik skolwaji, yuj chi' ol wak' hin silab' t'ay yik wach' ol kolwaj wet'ok, xchi winh. Icha chi' ix aj skot wal t'a yib'anh winh yet' heb' yetchonhab' chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix smolb'an juntzanh yamk'ab' yik stemplo Dios winh, ix smak'anpoj winh. Ix smakankan templo chi' winh, ix schekan winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar t'a schikintak scalle'al Jerusalén chi'.

Ix schekanpax winh b'ojokk'e juntzanh altar b'ajtak cha'anh t'a yoltak chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá chi'. Hata' snhus incienso winh t'a komon Dios. Icha chi' ix yutej winh stzuntzankot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová sDiosal smam yicham.
Ha jantakto tas ix sk'ulej winh, ayik ix el yich masanto ix lajwi, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Judá yet' Israel.
Haxo yik ix cham winh, ix mukji winh t'a chonhab' Jerusalén, palta manhok t'a yet'tal heb' winh rey ix mukji winh. Haxo winhaj Ezequías yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ayik ix scha'anel yich winhaj Ezequías yak'an reyal, 25 ab'il sk'inal winh. 29 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Jerusalén. Abías sb'i ix snun winh, yisil ix winhaj Zacarías.
Ha tas ix sk'ulej winh, wach'nhej t'a yichanh Jehová, icha wal sb'eyb'al winhaj David smam yicham winh.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj yik b'ab'el ab'il yoch winhaj Ezequías reyal, ix schekan winh jakchajxi stemplo Jehová, ix schekan winh wach' b'ochajxi spuerta'il.
Ix schekan winh awtajkot heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita, ix molb'aj heb' winh t'a yamak'il templo chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Hex levita, ab'ek tas ol wala': Sakb'itejek he b'a, tze sakb'itan pax stemplo Jehová, haton ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Ik'ekelta masanil tas manh wach'ok ayoch t'a yo'ol.
Yujto ha heb' ko mam kicham, te pit yutejnak sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal, te chuk tas k'ulejnak heb' t'a yichanh. Aktab'ilkan yuj heb', yik'nakel spensar heb' t'a skajnub'.
Smakannakkan spuerta'il heb', spu'annak tup sk'ak'al candil heb', maxtzak snhus incienso heb', maxtzak yak' silab' heb' to snhusjitz'a masanil t'a stemplo ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik.

Yuj chi', ix kot wal yowal sk'o'ol Jehová t'a Judá yet' t'a Jerusalén tik, kuseltak ix honh ajkan yuj, te k'ixwelal pax ix honh ajkani, ix honh ochpaxkan sb'uchlab'ejok juntzanh chonhab', icha wal tz'aj heyilan tikne'ik.
Yuj chi', ay heb' ko mam kicham chamnak t'a owal. Manh jantakok heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' kalkuninal ik'chajnakb'at t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.
Ha tikne'ik ix hin na'a to ol hin b'o jun trato yet' Jehová ko Diosal ha honh israel honh tik, yik wach' syik'el yowal sk'o'ol t'a kib'anh.
Yuj chi', hex wetchonhab', manh heyik'ek' tiempo he b'o'an stemplo Jehová, yujto ha' hex sik'aneli, yik tzeyak'an serwil, tze nhusanpaxtz'a incienso t'a yichanh, xchi winh.

Haton sb'i heb' levita ix och t'a munlajel tik: Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Coat: Winhaj Mahat yuninal winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Azarías. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Winhaj Cis yuninal winhaj Abdi yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jehalelel. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Gersón: Winhaj Joa yuninal winhaj Zima yet' winhaj Edén yuninal winhaj Joa.
Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán: Winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Jeiel. Ha t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Asaf: Winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Matanías.
Haxo t'a skal yinhtilal winhaj Hemán: Ha winhaj Jehiel yet' winhaj Simei. Haxo t'a skal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún: Ha winhaj Semaías yet' winhaj Uziel.

B'ab'el, ix smolb'ej heb' sk'ab' yok heb' winh, ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh smasanil icha yalan ley. Ixlajwi chi' ix och heb' winh t'a yol templo chi', ix sakb'itanpax templo chi' heb' winh icha yalan ley, icha ix yutej winh rey yalani, icha syal scheknab'il Jehová.

Ixlajwi chi', ix och heb' winh sacerdote chi' t'a yol templo yik sakb'itan heb' winh. Masanil tas manh wach'ok ix ilchaj yuj heb' winh, ix laj yik'elta heb' winh, ix yik'anel heb' winh t'a yamak'il templo chi'. Haxo juntzanh heb' winh levita ix b'at julankanb'at t'a sch'olanil stitak ha' Cedrón.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj chi' ix syamoch heb' winh sakb'itan juntzanh yamak'il templo chi'. Haxo t'a swajxakil k'uhal ix elk'och heb' winh sakb'itan t'a sti' templo chi'. Wajxaketo k'uhal ix yak' pax heb' winh sakb'itan yol templo chi', yuj chi' 16 k'uhal ix yak' heb' winh sakb'itani, ix lajwi'elk'och smasanil.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'och heb' winh t'a spalacio winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Toxo ix ko sakb'itej stemplo Jehová yet' altar b'aj stz'a silab', smexa'il ixim pan tz'em t'a yichanh Jehová yet' syamk'ab'il junjun.

Hanhejtona' ix ko sakb'itej juntzanh yamk'ab' elnakkan t'a yopisio yuj winhaj rey Acaz, ayik yochnak spitalil winh. Haxo tikne'ik, toxo ix ko b'oxikanoch t'a yet'tal t'a yichanh yaltar Jehová, xchi heb' winh.
Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix pet k'e wan winhaj rey Ezequías chi', ix smolb'an masanil heb' yajal chonhab' chi' winh, ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ix yik'anb'at ukwanh nok' kelem wakax heb', ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak chiwa. Ha juntzanh nok' chi' ix yak' nok' heb' silab'il yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yet' masanil heb' aj Judá chi', yik sakb'ikan pax stemplo Jehová chi'. Ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón to snhustz'a silab' chi' heb' t'a yib'anh altar yik Jehová.

Ix smilancham nok' wakax chi' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix scha'an schik'il nok' heb' winh, ix stzikanem heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Hanheja' icha chi' ix yutejpax nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' heb' winh yet' pax nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Ix yik'anb'at nok' chiwa chi' heb' winh t'a yichanh winh rey yet' t'a yichanh heb' anima smasanil. Ix yak'ank'e sk'ab' heb' t'a sjolom nok' yik tz'ak'jikan lajwok smul heb'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix smilancham nok' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix sekanem schik'il nok' heb' winh t'a yib'anh altar. Ha jun chi' ofrenda yuj yak'ji tup smul heb' israel chi', icha ix aj yalan winh rey chi'.

Ix ak'jipaxoch heb' winh levita yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' t'a stemplo Jehová yet' syamk'ab' heb' winh yik b'it: Haton k'e'en platillo, salterio, cítara, icha yajkan stzolal yuj winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Gad, haton winh ak'um razón t'a winhaj rey David chi', icha pax yaj yalankan winhaj Natán schekab' Dios. Ha juntzanh cheknab'il chi' alb'ilkan yuj Jehová yuj heb' schekab'.
Linhanoch heb' winh levita yet' yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey David. Linhanpaxoch heb' winh sacerdote spu'an strompeta.

Yuj chi', ix yalan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' to snhusjitz'a silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'. Haxo yik ix el yich snhusantz'a nok' silab' chi' heb' winh, ix el pax yich sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', yik syik'ancha'anh Jehová heb' winh, ix spu'an strompeta heb' winh. Ix k'anjipax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ak'b'ilkan yuj winhaj rey David chi'.

Haxo masanil anima, nhojanem heb' ejmelal yakb'an wan sb'itan heb' winh sb'itan chi', wan spu'an pax strompeta heb' winh sacerdote. Masanto yik ix lajwi stz'ab'at silab' chi' ix och wa'an heb' winh sb'itani.
Ayik ix lajwi yak'ji silab' chi', ix em nhojan winh rey yet' masanil heb' ajun yet' chi' ejmelal.

Ix yalan winh yet' heb' winh yajal chonhab' chi' t'a heb' winh levita to syal wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová yet' juntzanh b'it sb'onakkan winhaj rey David yet' pax juntzanh yik winhaj Asaf schekab' Dios. Ix sk'anab'ajan heb' winh yet' wal stzalajk'olal, ix empax nhojan heb' winh ejmelal.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winh rey chi' t'a heb' anima: Yakb'an toxo ix he sakb'itej he b'a t'a yichanh Jehová icha yalan ley, kotanhek, ik'ekkot he silab' yet' heyofrenda yuj heyak'an yuj diosal t'a stemplo Jehová, xchi winh. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima chi', ix yik'kot silab' heb' yet' yofrenda yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb'. Haxo heb' ix el wal t'a sk'o'ol yak'ani, ix yak' silab' heb' snhusjitz'a smasanil.
Masanil nok' nok' ix yik'kot heb' anima chi' silab'il snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', 70 nok' mam wakax, 100 nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' 200 nok' kelemtak kalnel. Ix nhusjitz'a nok' silab'il t'a Jehová.
Ha sb'isul masanil nok' ix yak' heb' silab'il chi', 600 nok' mam wakax yet' 3 mil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa.

Yujto kennhej sb'isul heb' winh sacerdote, maj tzak'wanlaj heb' winh spatz'anel masanil nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil chi', yuj chi' ix kolwaj heb' winh yetlevita'il heb' winh, yakb'an sakb'itej pax sb'a juntzanhxo heb' winh sacerdote, yujto ha heb' winh levita elanhchamel ix yak'och heb' winh t'a sk'o'ol sakb'itan sb'a t'a yichanh juntzanh heb' winh sacerdote chi'.

Ayto nanhalxo nok' silab' chi' ix ak'chaji yet' pax xepu'al nok' silab' yik junk'olal yet' wino ix ak'chaj ofrenda'il yet' pax nok' silab' snhusjitz'a smasanil. Ichaton chi' ix aj yelxi yich yochxi ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová.
Ix te tzalaj winhaj Ezequías chi' yet' masanil heb' anima yuj tas ix sk'ulej Dios yet' heb', yujto elanhchamel ix yik' sb'a masanil tas ix uji chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekan winhaj rey Ezequías chi' alchajel t'a yol yik Israel yet' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yak'anpaxb'at yumal winh t'a heb' ay t'a yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Manasés, yik skot heb' t'a stemplo Jehová t'a Jerusalén, yik tz'och k'inh yik sna'ankot heb' ayik yelnak heb' smam yicham heb' libre yuj Jehová sDiosal Israel t'a Egipto.
Ayik ix lajwi slolon winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh yet' masanil heb' anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ix sna'an heb' to ha t'a schab'il uj ol och k'inh chi',
yujto maj yal-laj yoch k'inh chi' t'a sk'uhal aykani, yujto kennhej heb' winh sacerdote ix sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley, manta pax heb' anima smolb'ej sb'a t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Yujto ix scha sk'o'ol winh rey yet' masanil anima tas ix nachaj chi',

yuj chi' ix sna'a heb' to spukchaj yumal t'a masanil yol yik Israel. Schakot t'a Dan, masanto sk'och t'a Beerseba. Ix awtajkot heb' yik sjawi heb' t'a Jerusalén yik tz'och k'inh chi', yujto ha t'a yalanhtaxo, manh niwanok heb' smolb'ej sb'a yik syak'anoch jun k'inh chi' heb', icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' schekab' winh rey chi' t'a masanil yol yik Israel yet' t'a yol yik Judá, ix yik'anb'at yumal heb', haton ix schek b'ojok winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, b'aj syal winh icha tik: Hex ketisraelal, meltzajanhekxi t'a Jehová sDiosal winh ko mam kicham aj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel, yik ol ochxok heyet'ok ha hex manh hex kannakok t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sreyal Asiria.

Mokab' lajanok tzeyutej he b'a icha heb' he mam heyicham, icha pax heb' ketisraelal, ix spitej wal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová ko Diosal yet' heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Ha wal ko Diosal chi' ix satanel heb' icha wal tz'aj kilan tikne'ik.

Yuj chi' manh heyak' pitb'ok he b'a, icha yutejnak sb'a heb' ko mam kicham chi'. Ak'ekxi'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal, kotanhek t'a stemplo sik'b'ilel yuj t'a masanil tiempo, tzeyak'an serwil yik maxtzak kot yowal sk'o'ol t'ayex.

Tato ol heyak'xi'och Jehová t'a he k'o'ol, haxo heb' ajk'o'ol ik'jinakb'at heb' ketisraelal yet' heb' heyuninal t'a preso chi', ol ok' sk'o'ol heb' t'a heb', ol ak'jok meltzaj heb' t'a ko chonhab' tik. Yujto ha Jehová ko Diosal, te ay sniwank'olal, ay pax yok'elk'olal, manh ol hex spatikejkaneli tato ol heyak'xi'och he b'a t'a yol sk'ab', xchib'at winh rey chi' t'a heb'.

Ix b'at heb' chekab' chi' t'a masanil yol yik Efraín yet' t'a yol yik Manasés, ix b'atnhej heb' t'a junjun chonhab', masanto ix k'och heb' t'a yol yik Zabulón. Palta ha heb' anima chi', tonhej ix tzewaj heb', ix b'uchwaj pax heb' t'a heb' chekab' chi'.
Palta ay jaywanh heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Aser, t'a yik Manasés yet' t'a yik Zabulón ix och heb' ejmelal t'a Dios chi', ix jawi heb' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Ha Dios ix ak'an sna' masanil heb' anima t'a Judá chi', yik sk'anab'ajan heb' jun cheknab'il ix yal winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok, icha ix aj yalan Jehová.
Yuj chi' ha wal t'a schab'il uj, ix smolb'an sb'a jantak anima t'a Jerusalén chi', ix yak'anoch k'inh heb' yik ixim pan malaj yich.
Ix syamanoch heb' yik'anel masanil juntzanh altar yet' juntzanh lugar b'ajtak snhuschaj incienso t'a Jerusalén chi'. Ix syumankanem heb' t'a sch'olanil ha' Cedrón.

Ayik 14 yoch schab'il uj chi', ix smilancham nok' kelem kalnel heb' yik k'inh chi'. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita, ix te k'ixwik'e heb' winh, yuj chi' ix sakb'itej sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley. Ix yik'anb'at nok' silab' heb' winh snhusjitz'a smasanil t'a stemplo Jehová.
Icha chi' ix aj yochxi heb' winh t'a yopisio, icha yalan ley Moisés winh schekab' Dios. Ha heb' winh sacerdote ix tzikanem schik'il nok' silab' ix yak' heb' winh levita.

Yujto tzijtumto heb' t'a skal masanil anima chi' manto sakb'itejlaj sb'a, yuj chi' ha heb' winh levita chi' ix milancham nok' silab'il yik k'inh chi' yuj heb' anima chi', yik tz'och yopisio nok' t'a k'inh chi'.

Te niwan heb' t'a yinhtilal Efraín, t'a yik Manasés, t'a yik Isacar yet' t'a yik Zabulón ix komon chi'an nok' silab' yik k'inh chi', manh icha'ok yaj stz'ib'chajkani, yujto maj sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan ley. Palta ha winhaj rey Ezequías chi' ix lesalwi yuj heb', ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal hach yet' heb' ko mam kicham, te wach' ha pensar. Ak' niwank'olal heb' syak'och t'a sk'o'ol yalan sb'a t'ayach, wach'chom maj sakb'itej sb'a heb' icha yalan sleyal ha templo, xchi winh.
Ix yab' Jehová slesalwi winhaj rey Ezequías chi', yuj chi' ix yak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh masanil anima chi'.

Uke' k'uhal ix ek' heb' israel chi' t'a Jerusalén, te tzalajk'olal ix ek' k'inh yik ixim pan malaj yich chi'. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita, junjun k'u sb'itan heb' winh, syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová yet' masanil yamk'ab' yik b'it te wach' yik Jehová yaji.

Ha winhaj Ezequías chi', ix yak' yuj diosal winh t'a heb' winh levita, yujto ix sch'oxel sb'ekank'olal heb' winh yak'an serwil Jehová. Uke' k'uhal ix schi nok' silab' yik k'inh chi' heb', ix yak'anpax nok' silab' heb' yik junk'olal, ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová sDiosal smam yicham.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan heb' smasanil to syak' uke'okxo k'uhal k'inh chi'. Te tzalajk'olal ix aj yoch k'inh chi' yuj heb'.

Ha winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá chi', mil nok' mam wakax yet' 7 mil nok' kalnel ix si'ej winh t'a heb' anima chi'. Yet' heb' winh yajal t'a junjun chonhab' ix si'ejpax mil nok' wakax chi' heb' winh yet' 10 mil nok' kalnel. Niwan heb' winh sacerdote ix sakb'itej sb'a icha yalan ley.

Masanil heb' aj Judá chi' yet' heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita yet' masanil heb' ix laj kot t'a yol yik Israel yet' masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ix ja kajan t'a yol yik Israel chi', ma t'a yol yik Judá, ix te tzalaj heb'.
Jantak tzalajk'olal ix uji t'a Jerusalén chi', yujto atax yik yak'annak reyal winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj David, manta b'aj tzuji icha jun ix uji t'a Jerusalén chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e linhan heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita yik sk'anan swach'k'olal Jehová heb' winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima. Ix ab'chaj slesal heb' winh chi' t'a satcha'anh b'aj kajan Dios.
